title: A FERMENTED OAT BASED FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a non-dairy fermented food product comprising an oat derived material comprising dry matter in an amount of 1- 10% by weight of the food product, at least one vegetable protein present in an amount of 0.5-6% by weight of the food product, at least one starch present in an amount of 0–7% by weight of the food product, and live bacteria.

title: Plant product of the sausage type with increased antioxidant potential and method of producing plant product
abstract: The subject of the application is a plant product of the sausage type, containing legume protein, characterized in that it contains a protein-spice mixture and a gelling mixture, wherein the protein-spice mixture contains pea protein in an amount of 22% to 27% by weight of the product and 2% to 3% by weight of the product of microcapsules with anthocyanins, wherein the product contains a protein-spice mixture and a gelling mixture in a weight ratio of 1:25 to 1:2.75. The application also covers a method of obtaining the product.

title: Plant product of the sausage type with increased antioxidant potential and method of producing plant product
abstract: The subject of the application is a plant product of the sausage type, containing legume protein, characterized by the fact that it contains a protein-spice mixture and a gelling mixture, where the protein-spice mixture contains pea protein in an amount from 22% to 27% by weight of the product and from 2% up to 3% by weight of the product of microcapsules with anthocyanins, the product containing a protein-spice mixture and a gelling mixture in a weight ratio from 1:25 to 1:2.75. The report also includes how to receive the product.

title: Method of producing a pet food product as well as the food product produced
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing an intermediate and/or final food product for pets, comprising: providing a first type of organic side stream, a second type of organic side stream and a third type of organic side stream; reducing said organic side streams, thereby obtaining reduced organic side streams, whereby the reduced organic side streams have a homogeneous particle size of at least 0.5 cm and at most 10 cm; dosing, drying, mixing the reduced organic side streams. The invention also relates to an intermediate and/or final food product for pets, manufactured by means of the first aspect of the invention. Finally, the invention relates to a use of the food product according to the first or second aspect of the invention as an intermediate and/or final food product for pets, preferably for dogs and/or cats.

title: Method of producing a food product for domestic animals, as well as the food product thus produced
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing an intermediate and/or final food product for pets, comprising: providing a first type of organic side stream, a second type of organic side stream and a third type of organic side stream; reducing said organic side streams, thereby obtaining reduced organic side streams, wherein the reduced organic side streams have a homogeneous particle size of at least 0.5 cm and at most 10 cm; dosing, drying, mixing the reduced organic side streams. The invention also relates to an intermediate and/or final food product for pets produced by means of the first aspect of the invention. Finally, the invention relates to a use of the food product according to the first or second aspect of the invention as an intermediate and/or final food product for pets, preferably for dogs and/or cats.

title: CELL CULTURING SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: The invention relates to methods and apparatus for culturing cells. There is provided methods and apparatus for providing a seed train comprising a chemostat, turbidostat or auxostat and methods and apparatus for medium exchange during culturing using gravitational settling separation.

title: Cell culture system and method
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and devices for culturing cells. Methods and apparatus for providing seed culture, including chemostats, turbidimeters, or chemostats, and methods and apparatus for media replacement during culture using gravity settling separation are provided.

title: METHOD OF MAKING A COATED FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: A method of making a coated food product is described. The coated food product includes a core, a dust layer disposed on the core, a batter layer disposed on the dust layer, and breadcrumbs disposed on the batter layer. The method comprises spray-coating the breadcrumbs with an oil at a temperature between 50 °C and 90 °C, wherein the oil has a melting point of less than 0 °C.

title: Method of making a coated food product
abstract: A method of making a coated food product comprising a core 1, a dust layer, a batter layer 3, and breadcrumbs 4, wherein the method comprises spray-coating the breadcrumbs with an oil 5 having a melting point below 0°C, sprayed at a temperature of 50-90°C, preferably 60-80°C. Preferably, the method comprising freezing the product. Preferably, the method comprises a) the breadcrumbs are sprayed when on the batter layer or b) spray-coating the breadcrumbs before disposing the breadcrumbs on the batter. Preferably, up to 20 wt.% of the breadcrumbs have a particle size of at least 5.6 mm and at least 25% of the breadcrumbs have a particle size of at least 3.35 mm. Preferably, the oil is rapeseed oil and the breadcrumbs are spray-coated for 10-20 seconds at a frequency of 700-2100 g/min using at least 4 nozzles 150-250 mm from the breadcrumbs. Preferably, the core is fish. Preferably, the dust layer comprises rusk. Preferably, the breaded food product is 50–70 wt.% core, 2.5–5 wt.% dust layer, 16-20 wt.% batter layer, 11-14 wt.% breadcrumb layer and less than 5 wt.% oil layer.

title: METHOD OF MAKING A FISH FINGER
abstract:
Described is a method of making a fish finger, comprising
a) providing a fish finger core
b) providing a batter mixture comprising an acidulant, said batter mixture having a pH in the range of from about 2.5 to about 4.5,
c) disposing the batter mixture around the core to form a batter layer,
d) coating the batter layer with breadcrumbs, and
e) spray coating the breadcrumbs with an oil at a temperature of between 50 and 90 °C, wherein the oil has a melting point of less than 0 °C.

title: Method of making a fish finger
abstract: A method of making a fish finger, comprising: providing a fish finger core 1, a batter mixture 2 comprising an acidulant (the batter having a pH 2.5-4.5); coating the core with batter; coating the batter layer with breadcrumbs 3; and spray-coating the breadcrumbs with an oil 4 ,with a melting point of < 0°C, at a temperature of 50-90°C, preferably 65-80°C. Preferably, the method includes freezing the product. Preferably, the acidulant comprises 1-3 wt.% lemon juice concentrate and the batter mixture has a pH 3-3.5. Preferably, the breadcrumb layer comprises a mixture of two breadcrumb portions, wherein at least 40% of the first has a particle size ≥2.8 mm and/or wherein at least 20% of the second has a particle size <2.8mm. Preferably, the breadcrumb layer comprises 5-25 wt.% of the first breadcrumb and 75-95 wt.% of the second breadcrumb. Preferably, the oil is rapeseed or sunflower oil. The core may be a plant-based material. Preferably the fish finger has an oil layer that is less than 6 wt.% of the fish finger. Preferably, the oil layer has a peroxide value ≤7mEq of O2/kg.

title: FUNGAL INGREDIENTS AND DERIVED PRODUCTS
abstract: The present invention relates to mycelium ingredients derived from submerged fermentation of at least one fungal strain in three different mediums: a defined medium leading to ingredient A, a synthetic medium leading to ingredient B, or a complex natural medium comprising a sidestream extract originated from an agrifood sidestream leading to ingredient C. Such unique mycelium compositions are characterized chemically, biologically, physically, morphologically, nutritionally, and organoleptically. The three different fibrous mycelium mass of edible fungi obtained from at least one fungal strain are further used to produce characterized food products, including meat analogues, fish analogues, dairy analogues, beverages, or other food products. These three new mycelium ingredients can be used in the manufacturing of foods, foodstuffs, beverages, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, nutraceutical, biomaterials, and feed and industrial applications.

title: Fungal ingredients and derived products
abstract: The present invention relates to mycelial components obtained from submerged fermentation of at least one fungal strain in three different media: a defined medium to yield component A, a synthetic medium to yield component B, or a complex natural medium containing a sidestream extract from an agricultural food sidestream to yield component C. Such unique mycelial compositions are characterized chemically, biologically, physically, morphologically, nutritionally, and organoleptically. Three different filamentous mycelial masses of edible fungi obtained from the at least one fungal strain are further used to produce characterized food products, including meat substitutes, fish substitutes, dairy substitutes, beverages, or other food products. These three new mycelial components can be used in the production of food, foodstuffs, beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, dietary supplements, biomaterials, and feed, as well as in industrial applications.

title: FLAVONOID COMPOSITIONS AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of flavor or perfumery. More particularly, it concerns a liquid composition comprising a compound of formula (I) and/or a compound of formula (II), an oil comprising carvone, and optionally, a solvent. The present disclosure further relates to the use of the said composition in consumer products, such as flavored products and body care products.

title: Flavonoid composition and its use
abstract: This disclosure relates to the field of flavors or cosmetics. More specifically, the present invention relates to liquid compositions comprising a compound of formula (I) and/or a compound of formula (II), a carvone-containing oil, and optionally a solvent. The disclosure further relates to the use of such compositions in consumer products such as flavored products and body care products.

title: EXTRUSION METHODS AND FLAVORED PRODUCTS FORMED THEREBY
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to extruded food products that contain one or more aroma compounds. In some embodiments, the extruded food products are products that contain non-animal proteins, such as vegan analogues of meat products, dairy products, and seafood products. In some embodiments, the one or more aroma compounds are not distributed uniformly throughout the product but, instead, have a higher concentration at or near the external surfaces of the extruded food product. In certain related aspects, the disclosure provides methods of making such extruded food products. In some embodiments, the methods comprise introducing one or more aroma compounds following extrusion.

title: MEAT ANALOGUE PRODUCT COMPRISING YEAST SINGLE CELL PROTEIN PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a meat analogue product comprising a texturized vegetable protein, a binder, a flavor and 0.5 to 10% (w/w) of a yeast single cell protein product, wherein the yeast single cell protein product comprises Saccharomycetales yeast cells or parts thereof.

title: Meat analogue products comprising yeast single cell protein products
abstract: The present invention relates to a meat analogue product comprising an organized plant protein, a binder, a flavour and 0.5 to 10% (w/w) of a yeast single cell protein product, wherein the yeast single cell protein product comprises Saccharomycetales yeast cells or parts thereof.

title: METHOD FOR ENABLING HIGH-THROUGHPUT IMAGING OF INDUSTRIAL SAMPLES
abstract: The invention relates to a Method for automated non-invasive analysis of a predetermined feature in a multitude of industrial samples (100) of a predefined sample type, the method comprising the steps of: b) recording in a preparation MRI experiment first MRI data of the industrial sample (100) with the MR scanner (102) to obtain a navigator information comprising the recorded first MRI data, c) analysing the navigator information with an inference module (200) for deriving one or more MR experimental parameters for use in a subsequent MR experiment for the analysis of the predetermined feature in the industrial sample (100) using a machine learning module (202), d) recording in a subsequent MR experiment MR data of the industrial sample (100) with the MR scanner(102) using the derived one or more MR experimental parameters, and e) analysing the predetermined feature in the industrial sample (100) using the MR data of the industrial sample (100), wherein the machine learning module (202) is trained for deriving one or more MR experimental parameters for use in a subsequent MR experiment for the analysis of the predetermined feature in the industrial sample (100) by analysing navigator information using a training set comprising navigator information of different training samples and corresponding MR experimental parameters used in a subsequent MR experiment for the analysis of the predetermined feature in the training sample.

title: METHOD FOR ENABLING HIGH-THROUGHPUT IMAGING OF INDUSTRIAL SAMPLES
abstract: The invention relates to a Method for automated non-invasive analysis of a predetermined feature in a multitude of industrial samples (100) of a predefined sample type, the method comprising the steps of: b) recording in a preparation MRI experiment first MRI data of the industrial sample (100) with the MR scanner (102) to obtain a navigator information comprising the recorded first MRI data, c) analysing the navigator information with an inference module (200) for deriving one or more MR experimental parameters for use in a subsequent MR experiment for the analysis of the predetermined feature in the industrial sample (100) using a machine learning module (202), d) recording in a subsequent MR experiment MR data of the industrial sample (100) with the MR scanner(102) using the derived one or more MR experimental parameters, and e) analysing the predetermined feature in the industrial sample (100) using the MR data of the industrial sample (100), wherein the machine learning module (202) is trained for deriving one or more MR experimental parameters for use in a subsequent MR experiment for the analysis of the predetermined feature in the industrial sample (100) by analysing navigator information using a training set comprising navigator information of different training samples and corresponding MR experimental parameters used in a subsequent MR experiment for the analysis of the predetermined feature in the training sample.

title: EDIBLE PLANT-BASED PASTES FOR PREPARING DAIRY ANALOGUES
abstract: The invention relates an edible plant-based paste that can be reconstituted into an aqueous liquid to form a plant-based dairy analogue, preferably a plant-based dairy drink analogue. Said edible plant-based paste comprises i) at least one fat component, ii) at least one non-soy grain component having a protein content of less than 28wt.% and iii) at least one protein component having a protein content of more than 30wt.%. The invention also relates to a process for manufacturing such an edible plant-based paste and to a method for preparing a plant-based dairy analogue by reconstituting such an edible plant-based paste in an aqueous liquid.

title: PLANT-BASED EDIBLE PASTES FOR PREPARING DAIRY ANALOGUES
abstract: A plant-based edible paste that can be reconstituted in an aqueous liquid to form a plant-based dairy analogue, preferably a plant-based milk beverage analogue. The plant-based edible paste comprises (i) at least one fat component, (ii) at least one non-soy grain component having a protein content of less than 28% by weight, and (iii) at least one protein component having a protein content of more than 30% by weight. The patent also includes a process for preparing such a plant-based edible paste and a method for preparing a plant-based dairy analogue by reconstituting the plant-based edible paste in an aqueous liquid.

title: PAEDIATRIC FORMULATIONS FOR PHENYLKETONURIA AND TYROSINAEMIA AND SPECIFIC FREE AMINO ACID MIXTURE
abstract: This invention relates to infant formulae or follow-on formulae suitable for children under the age of 2 years, and their use in the dietary management of phenylketonuria and tyrosinaemia. In particular, the invention relates infant formulae or follow-on formulae comprising casein glycomacropeptide and free amino acids as well as their use in the dietary management of phenylketonuria and tyrosinaemia, and the symptoms thereof. The invention relates to a mixture of free amino acids for use in manufacturing the infant formulae or follow-on formula.

title: Pediatric formulations for phenylketonuria and tyrosinemia and specific free amino acid mixtures
abstract: The present invention relates to infant formulas or older infant formulas suitable for children under 2 years of age and their use in the meal esophagus for phenylketonuria and tyrosinemia. In particular, the invention relates to infant formulas or larger infant formulas comprising casein glycomacropeptide and free amino acids, and their use in the dietary management of phenylketonuria and tyrosinemia and their symptoms. The present invention relates to a mixture of free amino acids for use in the manufacture of infant formulas or larger infant formulas.

title: LIQUID OAT BASE OR OAT DRINK
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a liquid oat base or oat drink for coffee or tea whitening, comprising an oat derived material with 5-25% by weight dry substance, based on the weight of the liquid oat base or oat drink, characterized in having an oat protein deamidation degree of 15% or below, wherein the oat derived material comprises, by dry weight of the oat derived material, DP1 to DP2 sugars in an amount of 20-40%, and DP3 to DP8 oligosaccharides present in an amount of 15-45%.

title: Liquid oat base or oat beverage
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a liquid oat base or oat beverage for coffee or tea whitening comprising an oat derived material having 5% -25% by weight of dry matter based on the weight of the liquid oat base or oat beverage, characterized in that the oat protein deamidation degree is 15% or less, wherein the oat derived material comprises DP1 to DP2 saccharides in an amount of 20% -40% and DP3 to DP8 oligosaccharides present in an amount of 15% -45% by dry weight of the oat derived material.

title: VIRAL INTEGRITY ASSAY
abstract: Provided are compounds for use in viral integrity assays, the compounds comprising a nucleic acid binding dye moiety covalently bound to a water-soluble polymer moiety, wherein the water-soluble polymer moiety has a molecular weight of at least 2500 g/mol, a method for determining the viral integrity of a virus sample, the method comprising adding said compounds to said virus sample to form a test sample and measuring the fluorescence and/or absorbance of the test sample, and a use of said compounds in determining the viral integrity of a virus sample.

title: PROTEIN GELS RICH IN VEGETABLE CONTENT
abstract: A vegetable protein gel, wherein said gel comprises vegetable puree or re-hydrated vegetable powder; between 10 to 25 wt% of one or more plant protein isolate or plant protein concentrate; optionally 2 to 15 wt% of one or more vegetable oil; optionally 0.1 to 1 wt% of sodium bicarbonate; and optionally 0.1 to 1 wt% salt and spices; wherein the water content of the gel is at least 55 wt%, and wherein the water to plant protein wt% ratio is 6 or less.

title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS USING A COMBINATION OF AT LEAST ONE FIBER AND AT LEAST ONE PROBIOTIC FOR REGULATING GUT BACTERIA ASSOCIATION WITH CHOLESTEROL
abstract: A composition containing a combination of at least one fiber and at least one probiotic can be orally administered to a subject in an amount effective to regulate gut bacteria association with cholesterol levels in the blood of the subject. The method can achieve at least one result that is improvement of cholesterol levels in the blood, prevention and/or treatment of cardiovascular, circulatory, endocrine system and/or nervous system conditions and/or diseases.

title: Compositions and methods using a combination of at least one type of fiber and at least one type of probiotic to regulate the relationship between intestinal bacteria and cholesterol.
abstract: A composition containing a combination of at least one type of fiber and at least one type of probiotic can be orally administered to a subject in an amount effective in regulating the relationship between the target intestinal bacteria and blood cholesterol levels. This method can achieve at least one outcome, which is improvement of blood cholesterol levels, and prevention and/or treatment of cardiovascular, circulatory, endocrine, and/or nervous system conditions and/or diseases. title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING CASEIN AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The invention pertains to the food industry and relates to new methods for producing casein compositions by culturing transgenic microorganisms in presence of lactoserum, and limiting the environmental footprint.

title: SACCHARIDE IMPORTERS FOR LACTO-N-TRIOSE

title: AN ACIDIC SPORE-BASED PROBIOTIC COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention relates to methods for producing a heat-treated acidic probiotic beverage comprising viable Bacillus subtilis spores, and the heat-treated acidic probiotic beverage produced by the methods.

title: Acidic spore-based probiotic compositions
abstract: The present invention relates to methods for producing heat treated acidic probiotic beverages comprising viable bacillus subtilis spores, and heat treated acidic probiotic beverages produced by these methods.

title: COMBINATION OF PLANT PROTEINS AND OLEOGELS IN HIGH MOISTURE EXTRUSION
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for preparing a texturized plant-based food product, the process comprising the steps of a) feeding a chamber, for example an extrusion barrel, with a composition comprising plant protein, water, and an oleogel; b) conveying the composition from step a) through the chamber; and c) cooling the composition from step b).

title: TEXTURED PLANT PROTEIN PRODUCT WITH HIGH FIBRE CONTENT
abstract: The present invention relates to a textured plant protein product rich in dietary fibres and comprising syrup, to a method for the preparation thereof and to food products comprising the textured plant protein product.

title: TEXTURED PLANT PROTEIN PRODUCT WITH HIGH FIBRE CONTENT
abstract: The invention relates to a textured vegetable protein product rich in dietary fiber, a method for preparing the same, and foods containing the textured vegetable protein product.

title: AN EDIBLE FOOD PRODUCT AND A MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention relates to a method of manufacturing an edible food product comprising edible protein threads embedded in a fatty matrix, said method comprising the following steps: - Preparing a protein matrix (130), said protein matrix comprising proteins, - Preparing a fatty matrix (140), said fatty matrix comprising at least 20 % in weight of fat compared to the total weight of the fatty matrix, the protein matrix and/or the fatty matrix comprising one or more texturizing molecule capable of creating a heat-resistant thread, and - Contacting (160) the protein matrix with the fatty matrix to form edible protein threads, from the protein matrix, embedded into the fatty matrix.

title: Edible food and its manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing an edible food product comprising edible protein threads embedded in a fat matrix, said method comprising the following steps: - preparing a protein matrix (130), wherein said protein matrix comprises a protein; - preparing a fat matrix (140), wherein said fat matrix comprises at least 20% by weight of fat compared to the total weight of the fat matrix, and wherein said protein matrix and/or said fat matrix comprises one or more texturizing molecules capable of producing heat-resistant threads; - contacting (160) said protein matrix with said fat matrix to form from said protein matrix edible protein threads embedded in said fat matrix.

title: HIGH PROTEIN YEAST PRODUCT
abstract: The present disclosure concerns a method of obtaining a composition having yeast proteins derived from yeast protoplasts The present disclosure also includes compositions comprising yeast proteins derived from yeast protoplasts, edible products derived from said composition as well as usages thereof.

title: High-protein yeast products
abstract: This disclosure relates to a method for obtaining a composition having yeast protein derived from yeast protoplasts. This disclosure also includes compositions containing yeast protein derived from yeast protoplasts, edible products derived from such compositions, and their uses.

title: Insert
abstract: An insert 700 for culturing tissue comprising: a base 110 comprising a groove 140 to which cells are added; first and second pillars 120 upstanding from the base each configured to support an anchor (130 Fig. 2), wherein tissue is formed between the pillars using the anchors for support. The pillars may be upstanding from the groove. The pillars and anchors may be biocompatible and/or biodegradable and may be adjustable in position. The insert may be stackable and may comprise a force transducer. The insert may comprise further pairs of pillars 125 to which the anchors may be transferred during tissue growth. The tissue may be stretched during growth. The insert may comprise a recess (610 Fig. 6b) for co-culture. Also provided is a system for culturing tissue wherein the insert with hydrogel suspended therein is held in a plate well. The system may further comprise a secondary insert (800 Fig. 8) comprising a body with an aperture and two pairs of pillars and be configured to receive anchors from the primary insert during tissue growth. Also provided is an in vitro method of culturing tissue using the insert. The tissue may be muscle for use in medicine or food.

title: AN EDIBLE FOOD PRODUCT AND A MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention relates to a method (100) of manufacturing an edible food product, said method (100) using a protein matrix, and a fatty matrix, said method (100) comprising the following steps: Processing (140) the protein matrix to form one or more edible protein thread(s) (220) using a threading device (10); Guiding (150) the one or more edible protein thread(s) (220) on a collecting device (30) using a guiding device (50); And adding (160) the fatty matrix on the one or more edible protein thread(s) (220) using a dispensing device (60), so that the fatty matrix is positioned within the assembly of edible protein thread(s) (280). The invention also relates to a system (1) for manufacturing an edible food product and an edible food product obtainable by a method (100) according to the invention.

title: Edible food and its manufacturing method
abstract: The present invention relates to a method (100) for producing an edible food product, said method (100) using a protein matrix and a fat matrix, said method (100) comprising the steps of: processing (140) the protein matrix using a threading device (10) to form one or more edible protein threads (220); guiding the one or more edible protein threads (220) onto a collecting device (30) using a guiding device (50); and adding the fat matrix to the one or more edible protein threads (220) using a dispensing device (60) such that the fat matrix is located within the edible protein thread assembly (280). The present invention also relates to a system (1) for producing an edible food product and an edible food product obtained by the method (100) according to the present invention.

title: LOW SUGAR OAT BASE OR OAT DRINK
abstract: The invention relates to a liquid oat base or oat drink comprising an oat derived material with 1-25% by weight dry substance, based on the weight of the liquid oat base or oat drink, wherein the oat derived material comprises, by dry weight of the oat derived material, DP1 to DP2 sugars present in an amount of 7% or below, and DP3 to DP8 oligosaccharides present in an amount of 5-40%. The invention further relates to a method for production of a liquid oat base or oat drink.

title: Low sugar oat base or oat beverage
abstract: The present invention relates to a liquid oat base or oat beverage comprising an oat derived material, wherein the oat derived material has a dry matter of 1% -25% by weight based on the weight of the liquid oat base or oat beverage, wherein the oat derived material comprises DP1 to DP2 saccharides present in an amount of 7% or less and DP3 to DP8 oligosaccharides present in an amount of 5% -40% based on the dry weight of the oat derived material. The invention also relates to a method for producing a liquid oat base or oat beverage.

title: METHOD FOR PREDICTING THE RAW MATERIAL FUNCTIONALITY IN THE END PRODUCT
abstract: A method is proposed to predict how the incorporation of unknown raw materials affects the predictable and implementable properties of final products.

title: METHOD FOR PREDICTING RAW MATERIAL FUNCTIONALITY IN THE END PRODUCT
abstract: A method is proposed for predicting how the incorporation of unknown raw materials will affect the predictable and realizable properties of end products.

title: MYCOSUBTILIN IN BAKERY PRODUCTS
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preserving a bakery product, comprising providing a dough comprising mycosubtilin or a functional derivative thereof, shaping the dough and baking the shaped dough to obtain a bakery product and to a dough, a pre-mix and a bakery product comprising mycosubtilin or a functional derivative thereof.

title: IMPROVED ENZYME VARIANTS
abstract: A polypeptide, wherein the polypeptide has an amino acid sequence which, when aligned with the amino acid sequence set out in SEQ ID NO: 1, comprises at least a substitution of the amino acid residues corresponding to the amino acids in positions 50, 51, 126, 135 and 221, wherein said positions are defined with reference to SEQ ID NO: 1.

title: IMPROVED ENZYME VARIANTS
abstract: A polypeptide comprising: a) a chymosin activity with a C/P ratio of clotting activity (C) to proteolytic activity (P) equal to or higher than the C/P ratio of a polypeptide having an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 2; and b) an alpha-S1-I casein fragment formation activity equal to or higher than the alpha-S1- I casein fragment formation activity of a polypeptide having an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 2; and/or c) a clotting time at pH 6.1 of equal to or less than the clotting time of a polypeptide having an amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 2.

abstract: A polypeptide comprising a) chymosin activity, wherein the C/P ratio of clotting activity (C) to proteolytic activity (P) is equal to or greater than the C/P ratio of a polypeptide having the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO:2, and b) an alpha-S1-I casein fragment-forming activity which is equal to or greater than the alpha-S1-I casein fragment-forming activity of a polypeptide having the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO:2, and/or C) a clotting time at pH 6.1 which is equal to or less than the clotting time of a polypeptide having the amino acid sequence of SEQ ID NO: 2.

title: AN EDIBLE PROTEIN THREAD, AN EDIBLE FOOD PRODUCT AND A MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention relates to a method of producing an edible protein thread, said method comprising the following steps: - Preparing a first composition (130), said first composition comprising: - animal proteins, said animal proteins being from non-human cultivated animal cells, and - either a polyvalent ion or a polyelectrolyte; - Preparing a second composition (140), said second composition comprising: - the polyvalent ion when the first composition (130) preparation step comprises an addition of the polyelectrolyte, or - the polyelectrolyte when said the first composition (130) preparation step comprises an addition of the polyvalent ion; and - Contacting (160) the first composition with the second composition to form an edible protein thread, said first composition being at a temperature of at most 65°C.

title: AN EDIBLE PROTEIN THREAD, AN EDIBLE FOOD PRODUCT AND A MANUFACTURING METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing an edible protein thread, said method comprising the following steps: Preparing a first composition (130) comprising animal proteins being from non-human cultivated animal cells, and a polyvalent ion; Preparing a second composition (140) comprising a polyelectrolyte which is capable of complexing with the polyvalent ion of the first composition to form a heat-resistant complex; and Contacting (160) the first composition with the second composition to form the edible protein thread. The invention relates to an edible protein thread obtained from the method, a method of manufacturing an edible food product comprising this edible protein thread and the manufactured edible food product.

title: CELL COMPOSITIONS
abstract: Non-human animal-derived cell composition comprising a plurality of non-human animal- derived cells, wherein the cells comprise at least one exogenous supplement comprised in a carrier selected from the group consisting of nanocarriers, nanoparticles, micelles, liposomes or vesicles is described. The cell composition is characterized by having improved organoleptic properties, such as an improved flavour, colour, texture or mouthfeel and/or having a meat like flavour. Methods of producing the same and comestibles comprising the same are also described.

title: Cell composition
abstract: A non-human animal derived cell composition is described comprising a plurality of non-human animal derived cells, wherein the cells comprise at least one exogenous supplement contained in a carrier selected from the group consisting of a nanocarrier, a nanoparticle, a micelle, a liposome, or a vesicle. The cell composition is characterized by having improved organoleptic properties, such as improved flavor, color, texture or mouthfeel and/or having a meat-like flavor. Methods of producing them and edible products containing them are also described.

title: METHYLOTROPH BACTERIA AS FOOD AND FEED INGREDIENTS
abstract: The present invention provides the use of a protein composition comprising Methylotroph bacterial biomass or at least one fraction thereof for supplementing or substituting meat proteins in food or feed products. Also provided are food and feed ingredients, food and feed products and methods of making same.

title: METHYLOTROPH BACTERIA AS FOOD AND FEED INGREDIENTS
abstract: The present invention provides the use of a protein composition comprising Methylotroph bacterial biomass or at least one fraction thereof for supplementing or substituting meat proteins in food or feed products. title: FORMULATIONS FOR HIGH-PROTEIN, NON-DAIRY CHEESE ANALOG
abstract: The invention is based on a non-dairy cheese product composition, wherein the quantity of crude protein in the non-dairy cheese product composition is at least about 4 wt.%, or between about 4 wt.% and 20 wt.%, and wherein the non-dairy cheese product composition comprises an inactive yeast source, wherein the quantity of the inactive yeast source in the non-dairy cheese product composition is at least about 5 wt.%, at least about 10 wt.%, or between about 5 wt.% and 25 wt.%. The invention further provides a non-dairy cheese product, obtainable from a non-dairy cheese product composition according to this invention, wherein the non-dairy cheese product is a hard or a semi-hard cheese, such as a parmesan cheese, a cheddar cheese, a gouda cheese, or an aged gouda cheese, or wherein the non-dairy cheese product is a non-dairy cheese sauce. The invention also pertains to the use of an inactive yeast source in a non-dairy cheese product composition, wherein the quantity of the inactive yeast source in the non-dairy cheese product composition is at least about 5 wt.%, to increase the protein content in the non-dairy cheese product by facilitating the inclusion of a plant and/or a microbial protein concentrate or isolate in the non-dairy cheese product composition.

title: PROBIOTIC STRAINS TO IMPROVE HEALTH PERFORMANCE OF ANIMALS
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to compositions and methods for reducing the development and/or severity of respiratory disease using a novel combination of probiotic strains, thereby improving health performance of animals. Also, the disclosure relates to compositions and methods for inhibiting pathogenic growth using a novel combination of probiotic strains.

title: PROBIOTIC STRAINS TO IMPROVE ANIMAL HEALTH AND PERFORMANCE
abstract: This disclosure generally relates to compositions and methods for reducing the development and/or severity of respiratory diseases using a novel combination of probiotic strains, thereby improving animal health and performance. In addition, the disclosure relates to compositions and methods for inhibiting pathogen growth using a novel combination of probiotic strains.

title: TEXTURED WHEAT PROTEINS
abstract: The invention relates to a textured wheat gluten protein composition characterised in that it comprises wheat gluten proteins and sodium bicarbonate, to a method for producing same and to the use thereof.

title: Textured wheat protein
abstract: The present invention relates to a textured wheat gluten composition, characterized in that it comprises wheat gluten and sodium bicarbonate, a process for its production and its use.

abstract: Disclosed herein are methods of glucosylating an isoflavone glycoside, as well as methods of reducing off-flavor in a food product/precursor. Further disclosed are compositions comprising one or more glucosylated isoflavone glycosides, such as a food product/precursor.

title: MELTABLE PLANT-BASED CHEESE
abstract: The present invention relates to a plant-based cheese of the half hard type, preferably a pizza cheese that has improved optical properties (i.e. reduded translucency upon melting). The plant-based cheese of the invention comprises a combination of certain structuring vegetable fat, (modified) starches and optionally a mixture of beta carotene. The invention further relates to the use of such structuring vegetable fat as a (meltable) cheese ingredient, a food product comprising the plant-based cheese, and a method for the preparation of the plant- based cheese.

title: METHOD OF PRODUCING A FOOD PRODUCT, FOOD PRODUCT AND APPARATUS
abstract: It is disclosed a method of producing a food product for human consumption from undervalued parts of a fish material by using extrusion. The method comprises: providing a fish material containing hard tissues; optionally providing a stabilizing material; optional grinding the fish material with a grinder having a hole size of at most 2 mm to provide a fish mass; subjecting the fish material to a first colloid milling to provide a colloid milled fish mass; subjecting the colloid milled fish mass to an extrusion to provide an extruded fish mass; subjecting the extruded mass to a second colloid milling to provide a colloid milled extruded fish mass as a food product.

title: Method for producing a food product, food product and apparatus
abstract: A method for producing a food product for human consumption using extrusion from a less expensive portion of fish material is disclosed. The method includes the steps of providing fish material containing hard tissue, optionally providing a stabilizing material, optionally grinding the fish material in a grinder with a hole diameter of up to 2 mm to provide fish chunks, subjecting the fish material to a first colloidal grinding to provide colloidal-ground fish chunks, extruding the colloidal-ground fish chunks to provide extruded fish chunks, and subjecting the extruded chunks to a second colloidal grinding to provide colloidal-ground extruded fish chunks as the food product. (Selected Figure: Figure 1)

title: EXPRESSION OF MILK CASEINS IN NON-MAMMALIAN CELLS
abstract: The present invention relates to the animal-free production of casein proteins for human consumption by expression of such proteins in non-mammalian host cell. The invention relates to non-mammalian host cell modified for the production of caseins, and to methods wherein these cells are used for the production of caseins.

title: METHOD FOR CONTINUOUSLY DETERMINING THE LACTOSE, PROTEIN, AND FAT CONTENT OF MILK
abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining, in particular in a continuous manner, the lactose content a, protein content b, and fat content c of a flowable medium, in particular milk, a milk substitute, and/or a milk product, having the steps of: - ascertaining the frequency-based relative permittivity of the medium over a frequency range of a frequency spectrum, wherein the frequency spectrum has an upper limit of 50 GHz, in particular 25 GHz, preferably 14 GHz, and the frequency spectrum has a lower limit of 10 MHz, in particular 50 MHz, preferably 85 MHz; and - calculating the lactose content a, protein content b, and fat content c on the basis of the ascertained relative permittivity and on the basis of a lactose reference, a protein reference, and a fat reference. The invention additionally relates to a measuring assembly.

title: Method for continuously determining lactose, protein and fat content of milk
abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining the lactose content of a flowable medium, in particular milk, formula and/or dairy products, in particular in a continuous mannerProtein contentAnd fat contentThe method comprising the method steps of-ascertaining a frequency dependent relative permittivity of the medium in a frequency range of the frequency spectrum, wherein the upper limit of the frequency spectrum is 50 GHz, in particular 25 GHz, preferably 14 GHz, and the lower limit of the frequency spectrum is 10 MHz, in particular 50 MHz, preferably 85 MHz, and-calculating the lactose content based on the ascertained relative permittivity and based on lactose reference, protein reference and fat referenceProtein contentAnd fat content. The invention further relates to a measuring assembly.

title: PROTEIN PRODUCTION METHOD
abstract: Provided is a method of producing protein suitable for use in a human food product. The method comprises Solid-State Fermentation (SSF) of a carbon source using a fungus suitable for human food production, the carbon source optionally having at least 10% protein by dry weight (w/w); and extraction of protein from the fungal biomass and optionally the carbon source. Also provided is an isolated or extracted mixture of proteins and a human food product comprising the protein mixture.

title: Protein production method
abstract: A method suitable for producing a protein suitable for human consumption comprises solid state fermentation (SSF) of a carbon source such as Brewer’s Spent Grain (BSG) having at least 10% protein by dry weight w/w, and an edible fungus such as Aspergilus sp. The extraction of protein from both the fungal biomass and the carbon source is subsequently conducted. Other steps in the method may optionally include for example, the removal of allergens, gluten and peroxide (following bleaching). Associated food products comprising the protein mixture, such as vegan cheese, is also disclosed. Figure 3 illustrates the total extraction method.

title: PROCESS FOR MANUFACTURING A COFFEE PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for manufacturing a coffee product comprising the steps of: a) spraying an aqueous liquid onto a mixture of sugar and roast and ground coffee particles to wet the sugar and roast and ground coffee particles; b) adding one or more beverage ingredient powders to the mixture formed in step a) to attach the one or more beverage ingredients and sugar onto a surface of the roast and ground coffee particles; and c) drying the roast and ground coffee particles to form a coffee product comprising roast and ground coffee particles having one or more beverage ingredient powders and sugar attached on a surface thereof. The present invention also relates to a product obtainable by the above process.

title: Process for manufacturing a coffee product
abstract: A process for manufacturing roast and ground coffee particles having beverage ingredient powder(s) and sugar attached onto their surface. The method comprises the steps of: a) spraying an aqueous liquid onto a mixture of sugar and roast and ground coffee particles; b) adding beverage ingredient powder(s); and c) drying the product. Preferably, the beverage ingredient(s) is instant coffee powder, chocolate beverage powder, milk powder, dairy creamer, and/or non-dairy creamer powder. Preferably, the process further comprises the step of adding a flavouring. Preferably, the process further comprises the step(s) of densifying the coffee particles after and/or during step b) and/or filling a granulator with the coffee particles and sugar before step a). Preferably, the product comprises 15-65wt.% coffee, 1-35wt% sugar, 1-30wt% beverage ingredient and/or 0.1-1wt% flavouring. Preferably, the beverage ingredient powder(s) and sugar discontinuously cover the surface of the coffee particles. Preferably, the product has a mean density of 250-850g/l. Also claimed is a container comprising the product. Preferably the container is a pad or pod for use in a beverage preparation machine.

title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS
abstract: The invention provides methods of co-culturing organisms, and in particular methods of co-culturing a methanotroph and a methylotroph in the presence of urea which stimulates methanol production by methanotroph Methylosinus trichosporium which is then used by methylotroph yeast Komagataella phaffii to produce target protein. Also described are methods for the production of target products from said co-culture.

title: METHODS FOR CELL CULTURING
abstract: The present invention relates to a novel composition for cultivating animal biomass in vitro. Corresponding methods are also provided herein. Further, this invention relates to a cellular composite for cultivating animal biomass in vitro, wherein the cellular composite comprises a cellular substrate and the composition of the invention. Corresponding methods for generating the cellular composite are also provided herein. Finally, a method for cultivating animal biomass in vitro in serum-free or reduced-serum conditions using the composition and cellular substrate of the invention are also provided.

title: COLORING COMPOSITIONS FOR CONSUMABLES
abstract: A composition for effecting color change of a consumable, wherein the composition comprises a first color delivery system comprising first core particles at least partially coated with a first colorant, and wherein the at least partially coated first core particles are at least partially encapsulated by a first encapsulant, wherein the composition changes the color of the consumable in response to temperature, mechanical agitation, passage of time, or combinations thereof. A process for changing the color of a consumable, such as a beverage, using the composition, and consumables including the composition are also disclosed.

title: Coloring compositions for consumer goods
abstract: A composition for inducing a color change in a consumer product is disclosed, the composition comprising a first color delivery system comprising first core particles at least partially coated with a first colorant, the at least partially coated first core particles being at least partially encapsulated by a first encapsulating agent, and the composition changes the color of the consumer product in response to temperature, mechanical agitation, the passage of time, or a combination thereof. Also disclosed are methods of changing the color of a consumer product, such as a beverage, using the composition and a consumer product comprising the composition.

title: LEGUMINOUS PROTEIN EXTRACT HAVING IMPROVED ACID-GELLING PROPERTIES
abstract: The invention relates to a leguminous acid-gelling protein extract having a protein content, expressed on dry weight basis of the extract, of 75% or higher and a storage modulus of at least 1800 Pa, advantageously at least 2000 Pa when determined using TEST A, preferably at least 2500 Pa. The invention also relates to its method of preparation and its use in acid-gelling food products.

title: PLANT-BASED MEAT ANALOGUE
abstract: The invention relates to a meat analogue comprising 7-36 wt.% of plant protein and 40-88 wt.% of water, said meat analogue further comprising 2-pentyl-1,3-thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid and/or salts thereof. The inventors have discovered that the off-flavour note in plant-based meat analogues that is caused by the presence of aldehydes, such as hexanal, can be reduced by adding cysteine during the production of these meat analogues. Cysteine is capable of reacting with off-flavour- generating aldehydes under the formation of a reaction product that does not adversely affect the flavour of the meat analogue. An important example of such a reaction product is 2-pentyl-1,3- thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid, which is formed by the reaction between cysteine and hexanal. The invention also relates to a method of producing a plant-based meat analogue with reduced off-flavour, said method comprising adding at least 0.001 wt.%, calculated by weight of the meat analogue, of an aldehyde scavenger, said aldehyde scavenger containing at least 5 wt.%, calculated by weight of the aldehyde scavenger, of cysteine.

title: PLANT-BASED MEAT ANALOGUE
abstract:
The invention relates to a meat analogue comprising 7-36 wt.% of plant protein and 40-88 wt.% of water, said meat analogue further comprising 2-pentyl-1,3-thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid and/or salts thereof.
    The inventors have discovered that the off-flavour note in plant-based meat analogues that is caused by the presence of aldehydes, such as hexanal, can be reduced by adding cysteine during the production of these meat analogues. Cysteine is capable of reacting with off-flavour-generating aldehydes under the formation of a reaction product that does not adversely affect the flavour of the meat analogue. An important example of such a reaction product is 2-pentyl-1,3-thiazolidine-4-carboxylic acid, which is formed by the reaction between cysteine and hexanal.
    The invention also relates to a method of producing a plant-based meat analogue with reduced off-flavour, said method comprising adding at least 0.001 wt.%, calculated by weight of the meat analogue, of an aldehyde scavenger, said aldehyde scavenger containing at least 5 wt.%, calculated by weight of the aldehyde scavenger, of cysteine.

title: CHEESE ALTERNATIVE COMPRISING MYCOPROTEINS
abstract: The invention relates to a cheese substitute comprising 10 - 35 wt.% of a fat phase, 0 - 50 wt.% starches and/or modified starches, and 0.1 - 10 wt.% mycoprotein, the remainder (up to 100 wt.%) being water. The mycoprotein is comprised in fungal hyphae. The cheese substitutes have favourable melt stretch properties. The invention also relates to a method for preparing the cheese substitute.

title: A PROCESS FOR MANUFACTURING AN OAT BASE, OAT DRINK OR OAT PRODUCT
abstract: A process for manufacturing a liquid oat base, oat drink or oat product, the process comprises providing oat kernels, wherein the oat kernels each comprise at least two oat parts, comminuting the provided oat kernels, wherein the at least two parts are liberated, a first part comprising a major portion of the pericarp, and a second part comprising the rest of the oat kernel, processing at least the second part for manufacturing the liquid oat base, the oat drink or the oat product.

title: PROCESS FOR THE PRODUCTION OF HUMAN MILK OLIGOSACCHARIDES
abstract: Process for the production of a human milk oligosaccharide (HMO)-containing preparation via a microbial fermentation reaction with glucose as carbon and/or energy source, involving enzymatic treatment with at least one carbohydrase in order to hydrolyse carbohydrate impurities originating from said glucose source.

title: MEAT OR FISH SUBSTITUTE BASED ON SEAWEED
abstract: MEAT OR FISH SUBSTITUTE BASED ON ALGAE The present invention relates to an animal meat or fish substitute comprising: - at the nutritional level: between 30 and 70% water, between 1% and 30% proteins of plant and/or algal origin, between 5 and 30% fat of plant and/or algal origin, between 0 and 30% carbohydrates of plant and/or algal origin, between 0.001 and 10% aromatic agent of plant and/or algal origin, - at the ingredient level: at least 1% whole algae, algae extracts or a mixture, functionalized.

title: Beverage preparation device for preparing a beverage and method for operating a beverage preparation device
abstract: The present approach relates to a beverage preparation device (100) for preparing a beverage. The beverage preparation device (100) comprises at least one optical fiber (105a), by means of which a light signal can be guided from a measuring point (110a) in and/or on the beverage preparation device (100) to an optical sensor unit (115). The beverage preparation device (100) further comprises the optical sensor unit (115) for detecting a parameter of an ingredient of the beverage and/or a parameter of the beverage from the light signal in order to provide a sensor signal. Furthermore, the beverage preparation device (100) comprises an evaluation unit (120), by means of which a control signal can be determined from the sensor signal in order to control the beverage preparation device (100) using the control signal.

title: Beverage preparation device for preparing a beverage and method for operating a beverage preparation device
abstract: The approach presented here relates to a beverage preparation device (100) for preparing a beverage. title: FERMENTED FOOD PRODUCT AND METHODS OF PRODUCING
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of fermented food products, more specifically, to non-animal dairy substitutes. The application discloses a novel method of growing fungal inoculants on a vegetable feedstock. The obtained fermented food product comprises fungal biomass and fermented vegetable feedstock.

title: FERMENTED FOOD PRODUCT AND PRODUCTION METHODS
abstract: The invention relates to fermented foods, more specifically to non-animal dairy substitutes. The application describes a novel method for growing fungal inoculants on vegetable raw materials. The obtained fermented food product comprises fungal biomass and fermented vegetable raw material.

title: FUNCTIONAL NATIVE POTATO PROTEIN, AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING SAME
abstract: The invention relates to a method for the preparation of potato protein and a native functional potato protein with a molecular weight of 10-120 kDa (according to SDS-Page primary structure), producible from potato amniotic fluid, which is obtained by the mechanical solid/liquid separation of chopped, cleaned potato parts, comprising: a) Protein content of at least 84% by weight absolute dry; b) a humidity content as dried protein: max. 10% by weight; c) Product solubility/protein solubility in water of 75-100%; d) Ash content of max. 3% by weight, which can be produced by a) chopping the potato raw material; b) mechanical separation of the potato mash into solid phase and liquid phase (potato amniotic fluid); c) pH adjustment to 6-9; d) ultrafiltration of the liquid phase; d) diafiltration of the ultrafiltration retentate; e) optionally before or after step d) removal of undesirable flavors by adsorption techniques; f) sterilizing the resulting protein solution; g) optionally drying the protein solution.

title: FUNCTIONAL NATIVE POTATO PROTEIN, AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING SAME
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing potato protein and to a functional native potato protein with a molecular weight of 10 - 120 kDa (based on the SDS-PAGE primary structure), said potato protein being producible from potato fruit water which is obtained by means of a mechanical solids/liquid separation of comminuted, cleaned potato parts, comprising: a) a protein content of at least 84 wt.% (bone dry); b) a moisture content as a dry protein of maximally 10 wt.%; c) a product solubility/protein solubility in water of 75 -100%; and d) an ash content of maximally 3 wt.%. The potato protein can be produced by a) comminuting the raw plant material of the potatoes; b) mechanically separating the potato mash into a solid phase and a liquid phase (potato fruit water); c) setting the pH value to 6 - 9; d) carrying out an ultrafiltration of the liquid phase; d) carrying out a dialfiltration of the ultrafiltration retentate; e) optionally prior to or after step d), removing undesired flavoring agents using adsorption techniques; f) sterilizing the obtained protein solution; and g) optionally drying the protein solution.

title: THE FGF-2 POLYPEPTIDES WITH IMPROVED STABILITY, THE PROCESS FOR PREPARING THE FGF-2 POLYPEPTIDES AND USE THEREOF
abstract: of the Disclosure The invention relates to a Fibroblast Growth Factor 2 (FGF-2) polypeptides that have improved stability while maintaining biological activity compared to the wild-type of FGF-2. The invention provides the process for the preparation and the use thereof in biotechnological research and industrial applications, medicine, the pharmaceutical industry, cosmetics, clean meat industry, generation of organoids and 3D cell culture models and other related applications.

title: FGF-2 polypeptides with improved stability, methods for preparing FGF-2 polypeptides and uses thereof - Patent Application 20070122997
abstract: The present invention relates to fibroblast growth factor 2 (FGF-2) polypeptides that have improved stability while maintaining biological activity compared to wild-type FGF-2. The present invention provides processes for their preparation and use in biotechnology research and industrial applications, the pharmaceutical industry, cosmetics, the purified meat industry, the generation of organoids and 3D cell culture models, and other related applications.

title: FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: Disclosed is a method for preparing a food product comprising mycoprotein and a hydrocolloid, such as an alginate. The method comprises preparing a pre-mix by mixing at least a mycoprotein, a plant protein source, an alginate, and water; shaping the pre-mix to form a pre-mix shape; curing a skin part of the pre-mix shape by contacting the pre-mix shape from the outside with a first aqueous solution comprising calcium for a first contact time to obtain a skin-cured pre-mix shape; forming individual shapes from the skin-cured pre-mix shape while substantially preserving the cured skin part; and further curing the individual shapes by contacting the individual shapes with a second aqueous solution comprising calcium for a second contact time. Also disclosed is a food product obtainable by the method.

title: INSERT FOR CULTURING TISSUE AND METHOD OF CULTURING TISSUE USING SAID INSERT
abstract: There is provided an insert (100) for culturing tissue comprising: abase (110) comprising a groove (140) configured to provide a guide for adding cells to be cultured; a first pillar (120) upstanding from the base and configured to support a first anchor; and a second pillar (120) upstanding from the base (110) and configured to support a second anchor. The insert (100) is configured so that cells may be cultured to form tissue between the first and second pillars (120) using the anchors for support.

title: insert
abstract: An insert (100) for culturing tissue is provided, the insert (100) comprising a base (110) with a groove (140) configured to provide a guide for adding cells to be cultured, a first post (120) upstanding from the base and configured to support a first anchor, and a second post (120) upstanding from the base (110) and configured to support a second anchor. The insert (100) can be cultured so that cells form tissue between the first post (120) and the second post (120), using the anchors for support.

title: COMBINED METHOD FOR PRODUCING BIOETHANOL AND AN OILSEED PROTEIN PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a combined method, comprising a first method for producing bioethanol (10) and a second method for producing an oilseed protein product (31, 45), the first method comprising the steps of (a) providing a slurry (7), wherein the slurry (7) contains a carbohydrate-containing feedstock (1), in particular a grain, (b) fermenting the slurry (7) in order to obtain a fermented liquor (9) containing bioethanol (10), and (c) separating at least some of the bioethanol (10) from the fermented liquor (9); and the second method comprising the steps of (i) providing an oilseed feedstock (4), (ii) extracting the oilseed feedstock (4) using a first extraction agent (39), in order to obtain a first miscella (26) and a first extraction product (27), (iii) splitting the first extraction product (27) into a first mixture (30, 46) containing the oilseed protein product (31, 45) and a second mixture (32, 47) containing the oilseed secondary product (5), (iv) separating at least some of the oilseed protein product (31, 45) from the first mixture (30, 46), and optionally separating at least some of the oilseed secondary product (5) from the second mixture (32, 47); wherein the slurry (7) provided in step (a) of the first method contains at least some of the oilseed secondary product (5) obtained in the second method, wherein the first extraction agent (39) contains bioethanol (10) produced in the first method, wherein the first miscella (26) contains at least some of the first extraction agent (39), and wherein at least some of the first extraction agent (39) contained in the first miscella (26) is separated from the first miscella (26) and is used in step (c) of the first method.

title: COMBINED PROCESS FOR THE PRODUCTION OF BIOETHANOL AND AN OIL-FRUIT PROTEIN PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a combined process comprising a first process for producing bioethanol (10) and a second process for producing an oilseed protein product (31, 45), the first process comprising the steps of (a) providing a mash (7), wherein the mash (7) contains a carbohydrate-containing starting material (1), in particular a grain, (b) fermenting the mash (7) to obtain a fermented broth (9) containing bioethanol (10), and (c) separating at least part of the bioethanol (10) from the fermented broth (9); and the second method comprising the steps of (i) providing an oilseed starting product (4), (ii) extracting the oilseed starting product (4) with a first extraction agent (39) to obtain a first miscella (26) and a first extraction product (27), (iii) separating the first extraction product (27) into a first mixture (30, 46) containing the oilseed protein product (31, 45) and into a second mixture (32, 47) containing the oilseed by-product (5), (iv) separating at least a portion of the oilseed protein product (31, 45) from the first mixture (30, 46), and optionally separating at least a portion of the oilseed by-product (5) from the second mixture (32, 47); wherein the mash (7) provided in step (a) of the first process further contains at least a portion of the oilseed by-product (5) obtained in the second process, wherein the first extractant (39) contains bioethanol (10) produced in the first process, wherein the first miscella (26) contains at least a portion of the first extractant (39), and wherein at least a portion of the first extractant (39) contained in the first miscella (26) is separated from the first miscella (26) and used in step (c) of the first process.

title: EXTRUDER DEVICE WITH AT LEAST TWO SCREWS AND A COMMON COMPARTMENT
abstract: The invention relates to a extruder device (1) for 3D printing a viscous material, in particular plant-based foodstuff material, wherein the extruder device (1) comprises at least two compression screws (2), which are arranged within a common compartment (3), wherein the common compartment (3) comprises a nozzle (6) for each compression screw (2), a feeding section (FS) for feeding the viscous material to the at least two compression screws (2) and a compression section (CS) located between the feeding section (FS) and the nozzles (6) for the compressing viscous material.

title: EXTRUDER DEVICE WITH AT LEAST TWO SCREWS AND A COMMON COMPARTMENT
abstract: An extruder device for 3D printing a viscous material, such as a plant-based foodstuff material, where the extruder device includes two compression screws, which are arranged within a common compartment, and the common compartment includes a nozzle for each compression screw, a feeding section (FS) for feeding the viscous material to the two compression screws and a compression section (CS) located between the feeding section and the nozzles for compressing the viscous material.

title: METHOD FOR IMPROVING THE TEXTURE OF A DAIRY-SUBSTITUTE PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for improving the texture of an edible composition, said method comprising a step of incorporating a casein composition comprising casein in the sole form of non-animal origin to an edible composition.

title: PROCESS FOR PREPARING STRUCTURED PLANT-PROTEIN BASED MEAT ANALOGS
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for preparing meat analogs based on plant proteins that present advantageous organoleptic properties, in particular due to their lamellar or fibrillar structure. The process of the present invention comprises the steps of: (i) preparing a dough; (ii) shaping the dough into shaped pieces; (iii) statically cooking the shaped pieces to obtain cooked pieces; (iv) putting the cooked pieces of step (iii) in contact with each other, preferably by inserting the cooked pieces into a recipient and filling the recipient with an aqueous medium; then (v) heating the assembly of pieces, thereby converting the assembly of shaped and cooked pieces into a structured meat analog.

title: METHOD FOR IMPROVING THE FOAMING PROPERTY OF A LIQUID DAIRY-SUBSTITUTE PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for improving the foaming property of a liquid dairy- substitute product, said method comprising a step of incorporating a casein composition comprising casein in the sole form of non-animal origin to a liquid dairy-substitute product.

title: PRODUCING LIQUID OAT BASE FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION
abstract: A method of manufacturing a liquid oat base for human consumption is provided. By the method, a system is operated to produce the liquid oat base from oat raw material comprising at least one of oat kernels or whole oat flour. According to the method, the oat raw material is processed with water and one or more enzymes into a slurry (S22), and a hydrolyzation of the slurry is performed, by the one or more enzymes, during a hydrolyzation time period, HTP (S24). During at least part of the HTP, the slurry is processed by high-pressure homogenization (S25). At the end of the HTP, the slurry is processed for deactivation of the one or more enzymes (S26), whereupon the liquid oat base is obtained from the slurry. By performing the high- pressure homogenization during the HTP, the system produces minimum, or no, solid residue ("okara").

title: METHOD FOR CONFIGURING A BEVERAGE DISPENSING APPLIANCE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for establishing a control link (3) between a beverage dispensing appliance (1) and a supply appliance (2), wherein the supply appliance (2) is designed to supply at least one material flow, for beverage preparation, to the beverage dispensing appliance (1) and the beverage dispensing appliance (1) comprises an operating display (4) having an operating structure (5). The problem addressed by the invention is that of providing a method by means of which an additional dispensing option is provided in the beverage dispensing appliance (1) for an additional material flow from the supply appliance (2). The problem is solved in that at least one operating element (6a, 6b, 6c, 6d) for actuating the supply appliance (1) is automatically generated in the operating structure (4) by linking the supply appliance (2) to the beverage dispensing appliance (1).

title: DAIRY COOKING CREAM ALTERNATIVE
abstract: The invention relates to a liquid dairy cooking cream alternative composition comprising a vegetable fat, a plant-based protein (non-milk protein), an emulsifier other than an emulsifying starch, and a stabilizer, wherein the composition further comprises an emulsifying starch and a starch not being an emulsifying starch. It was found that the presence of an emulsifying and a starch not being an emulsifying starch and in particular a thickening starch, in combination with the further ingredients of the now invented composition results in a dairy cooking cream alternative that has a good consistency, taste, texture, appearance and creaminess, good stability in the food application it is used in, and a good shelflife stability. The invention also relates to a process for preparation of the liquid dairy cooking cream alternatives.

title: FUNGAL BIOMASS, METHOD FOR THE PREPARATION AND USES THEREOF, AND EDIBLE COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING SAID FUNGAL BIOMASS
abstract: Disclosed is a fungal biomass comprising one or more filamentous fungi each independently selected from the fungal family Trichocomaceae, Thermoascaceae, and/or Aspergillaceae, wherein the fungal biomass has high crude protein and high content of one or more polyunsaturated fatty acids. Further, an edible composition comprising the fungal biomass is disclosed. A method for the continuous preparation of a fungal biomass using one or more filamentous fungi each independently selected from the fungal family Trichocomaceae, Thermoascaceae, and/or Aspergillaceae is also disclosed, and further use of the fungal biomass and the edible composition as or in foodstuff is disclosed.

abstract: The invention relates to a jackfruit product made of young unripe jackfruit having the following characteristics: - a moisture content of 3-10%, - a rehydration ratio below 1:3, and - an excretion value below 20% of the rehydrated product. The invention also relates to a method for producing a jackfruit product and a food product including a jackfruit product.

title: RECOMBINANT WILD TYPE PATATIN-2 AND MUTANTS THEREOF
abstract: The invention relates a recombinant wild type patatin-2 or mutant thereof. It also relates to polynucleotide expression vector, host cell and method for producing such recombinant proteins. It also relates to composition and product comprising such recombinant proteins.

title: Food product and process for the production thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to an emulsified food product such as a mayonnaise comprising edible oil, water, enzymatically modified food starch, an acidifying agent in the form of edible acid, fava bean protein and cannellini bean milk, wherein the acidifying agent comprises edible acid and wherein the fava bean protein and the cannellini milk are present in an amount so as to act as emulsifiers. The fava bean protein may be present at 0.25-5 wt%. It may also have a protein content of approximately 85 wt% and a dry matter content of 91-99 wt%, based on the total weight of the fava bean protein. The cannellini bean milk may be present at 5-25 wt% with a protein content of approximately 2.1 wt%, based on the total weight of the cannellini bean milk. The food product may be eggless, be a vegan mayonnaise and may not contain allergens. Also claimed is a process for the production of such an eggless food product.

title: MILK PRODUCING CELLS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for preparing and/or isolating a cell population, which is enriched in lactating cells This method comprises a step of providing milk or mammary tissue, selecting a cell population comprising lactating cells based on specific cell markers, and obtaining said cell population being enriched in lactating cells. The present invention further refers to a cell culture comprising said lactating cells in an amount of at least 65% based on the total cells of the cell culture, and wherein the lactating cells are characterized by a specifically defined cell marker status. The present invention further refers to a container comprising said cell culture, as well as to a method of in vitro milk production, comprising the steps of providing and cultivating the cell population of the present invention, and harvesting the milk product.

title: EXTRUDER SYSTEM FOR FORMING A FOLDED EXTRUDATE WITH IMPROVED ORGANOLEPTIC PROPERTIES
abstract: Apparatus, systems, and methods for forming a folded extrudate with improved organoleptic properties. The apparatus for forming the extrudate includes a body defining a flow path extending from an inlet at an upstream end of the body to an outlet at a downstream end of the body. The inlet has a first cross-sectional area, and the outlet has a second cross-sectional area that is larger than the first cross-sectional area. Additionally, the flow path includes a transitional region at the upstream end of the body with a length L and a minimum cross-sectional expansion ratio of at least 2X for any continuous length L/2 over the length L of the transitional region, and the flow path includes a forming region extending from the transitional region to the outlet.

title: COACERVATE CORE-SHELL MICROCAPSULES
abstract: The present invention relates to plant-based coacervate core-shell microcapsules, wherein the shell comprises a Moringa oleifera extract, as well as methods and uses of the same.

title: Coacervate core-shell microcapsules
abstract: The present invention relates to plant-derived coacervate core-shell microcapsules, the shell of which comprises an extract of Moringa oleifera, and methods and uses thereof.

title: POWDER MIX FORMULATIONS WITH IMPROVED SENSORY PROFILE
abstract: The invention relates to a powder preparation for beverages comprising a leguminous protein extract, wherein the leguminous protein extract has a protein content, expressed on dry weight basis of the extract, of 75% or higher, a dry matter ranging from 90 to 100%, wherein the protein extract has a Turbiscan Stability Index TSI at the Middle Region TSIMR below 5.0 and a rheometer viscosity going from 0.40 to 0.75 Pa.s, the viscosity being determined at 20°C, with a shear rate of 40s-1, on an aqueous suspension having 15% weight of dry matter.

title: FOOD POWDER COMPRISING A FLUID GEL
abstract: The invention relates to a food powder. The food powder comprises a carrier matrix, and a dried fluid gel. The dried fluid gel comprises particles formed of polysaccharide-based hydrocolloid and optionally, a cation. The invention also relates to a process for preparing such food powder and, food product, beverage and food supplement comprising such food powder.

title: DIETARY SUPPLEMENT FOR COMPREHENSIVE WEIGHT LOSS SUPPORT
abstract: The invention relates to a dietary supplement that comprehensively supports the weight loss process, containing a mixture of active substances of plant origin, vitamins, and minerals. The selected components of the blend have a positive impact on energy metabolism, carbohydrate metabolism, fat metabolism, regulate the concentration of sugars and fats in the bloodstream, contribute to appetite control, and promote the utilization of fats for energy processes during physical activity.

title: BATCH PRODUCTION OF GRAIN-BASED BEVERAGES
abstract: A method of manufacturing a grain-based beverage for human consumption enables batch production and may implemented in a system of low complexity. The method comprises introducing water, grain material and one or more enzymes into a mixing chamber (10A) of a mixing apparatus (10); operating a mixing device (12) of the mixing apparatus during a first time period to generate a batch of slurry in the mixing chamber; operating, during a second time period after the first time period, a circulation arrangement (13) to transfer the slurry on an external circulation path from the mixing chamber through a homogenization device (16) and back to the mixing chamber; introducing one or more further ingredients into the mixing chamber of the mixing apparatus; and operating the mixing apparatus and/or the circulation arrangement to produce the grain-based beverage based on the slurry and the one or more further ingredients.
