title: FOOD PRODUCT AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING THEREOF
abstract: It is disclosed a sustainable method for producing a textur- ized fish product, comprising the steps of: providing a fish ma- terial; optionally providing a plant-based food material; de- riving a fish feedstock from the fish material; subjecting the fish feedstock to a texturizing step at most 100°C to provide a texturized fish product having a protein content of about 10% to about 25% based on the weight of the texturized fish prod- uct.

title: Food products and their manufacturing methods
abstract: [Abstract] Disclosed is a sustainable method for producing textured fish products, comprising the following steps: providing fish material; optionally providing plant-based food material; obtaining fish feed stock from the fish material; and subjecting the fish feed stock to a texturizing step at approximately 100°C to provide a textured fish product having a protein content of approximately 10% to approximately 25% based on the weight of the textured fish product. title: ACCESSORY FOR FILTERING A HOME-MADE BEVERAGE COMPRISING PARTICLES FOR A FROTHER
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an assembly (1, 1', 1'', 1''') for frothing a beverage comprising particles, the assembly (1, 1', 1'', 1''') comprising: a reservoir (4) comprising a wall which defines a cavity (9) for receiving the beverage comprising particles; a conveying duct (3) having a suction end (6), which is fluidically connected to the inside of the cavity, and a discharge end (7), which is intended to be connected to a frothing member (8) for frothing the beverage comprising particles; and a filtering wall (2, 2', 2'') which extends within the cavity (9), at a non-zero distance from the suction end (6), and is configured to filter the beverage comprising particles that circulates from the reservoir (4) to the frothing member (8), before it passes through the suction end (6).

title: Homemade plant-based beverage filtration accessory for frothing jug
abstract: This disclosure relates to an assembly (1, 1', 1'', 1''') for foaming a plant-based beverage, the assembly (1, 1', 1'', 1''') comprising: a reservoir (4) including a wall delimiting a cavity (9) for receiving the plant-based beverage; a conveying conduit (3) having a suction end (6) fluidically connected to the interior of the cavity and a discharge end (7) intended to be connected to a foaming element (8) for the plant-based beverage; and a filter wall (2, 2', 2'') extending within the cavity (9), at a non-zero distance from the suction end (6), and configured to filter plant-based beverage flowing from the reservoir (4) to the foaming element (8), before it passes through the suction end (6). title: PRODUCTION OF A DISACCHARIDE AND/OR MILK OLIGOSACCHARIDE BY A CELL WITH REDUCED SYNTHESIS OF UDP-GLCNAC
abstract: The present invention is in the technical field of synthetic biology, metabolic engineering and cell cultivation. The invention provides a cell for production of a disaccharide and/or an oligosaccharide like a milk oligosaccharide wherein synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine in said cell is rendered less functional. The invention also describes methods for the production of a disaccharide and/or an oligosaccharide like a milk oligosaccharide using said cell as well as the purification of said disaccharide and/or oligosaccharide like a milk oligosaccharide.

title: Production of disaccharides and/or milk oligosaccharides by cells with reduced synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc
abstract: The present invention falls within the fields of synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, and cell culture technology. The present invention provides a cell for producing disaccharides and/or oligosaccharides, such as milk oligosaccharides, wherein the synthesis of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine is impaired in said cell. title: Device for freezing and/or thawing and method for freezing and/or thawing
abstract: A device for freezing and/or thawing food products and/or biological substrates, said device comprising at least one compartment for housing at least one food product and/or at least one biological substrate, said compartment comprising at least one magnetic field generator for generating a unidirectional static magnetic field within said compartment, at least one radiofrequency (RF) generator for generating at least one electromagnetic radio wave within said compartment; and a temperature regulation system, for providing the at least one compartment: with a 10 relatively cold airflow having a subzero temperature to freeze the at least one food product and/or the at least one biological substrate housed within said compartment; and/or with a relatively hot airflow having a suprazero temperature to thaw the at least one food product and/or the at least one biological substrate housed within said compartment. 15 Method for freezing and/or thawing food products and/or a biological substrates. A food product that is frozen or thawed in said device and/or by said method.

title: GLAZED LAMINATED DOUGH PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a powdered instant bakery product glazing composition, to a bakery product glazing composition, to a method for preparing a freezer to oven laminated dough, to a laminated dough, to a method for preparing a glazed laminated dough product and to a glazed laminated dough product. The glaze contains at least trehalose and an emulsifier.

title: FERMENTED ESSENTIAL OILS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for modifying the odour profile of an essential oil, to an essential oil obtained or obtainable by such a method, to a fragrance composition comprising such an essential oil, to a perfumed product, preferably a pharmaceutical preparation, cosmetic preparation or preparation serving for nutrition or pleasure comprising such an essential oil or such a fragrance composition, and to the use of a yeast of the genus Yarrowia, for modifying the odour profile of an essential oil.

title: PROCESS FOR THE REFINEMENT OF ESSENTIAL OILS BY TREATMENT WITH NITRIC AND ACETIC ACID
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for modifying the odor profile of an essential oil or an extract thereof, to an essential oil or extract obtained or obtainable by such a method, to an aroma composition comprising such an essential oil and/or extract, to a perfumed product, preferably pharmaceutical preparation, cosmetic preparation or preparation serving for nutrition or pleasure, comprising such an essential oil and/or extract and to the use of a mixture of acetic acid and nitric acid for modifying the odor profile of an essential oil and/or extract thereof.

title: BIOTRANSFORMATION OF PLANT EXTRACTS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining a fragrance composition, to a fragrance composition obtained or obtainable by such a method and to a perfumed product, preferably a pharmaceutical preparation, cosmetic preparation or preparation serving for nutrition or pleasure comprising such a fragrance composition. The method for obtaining a fragrance composition comprises the steps of i) providing a plant extract comprising one or more fragrance(s), wherein said fragrance(s) in the plant extract provided in step i) are selected from the group consisting of alcohols, wherein the plant extract is an essential oil or an absolute, ii) providing an esterase, iii) providing an ester, iv) mixing the plant extract provided in step i) with the esterase provided in step ii) and the ester provided in step iii) to obtain a reaction mixture and reacting the fragrance(s) in the reaction mixture under conditions allowing a transesterification of the carboxylic acid moiety of the ester provided in step iii) to the fragrance(s), to obtain a mixture comprising an esterified fragrance, v) optionally: drying the mixture comprising an esterified fragrance obtained in step iv) to obtain the fragrance composition.

title: BIOTRANSFORMATION OF PLANT EXTRACTS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining a fragrance composition, to a fragrance composition obtained or obtainable by such a method and to a perfumed product, preferably a pharmaceutical preparation, cosmetic preparation or preparation serving for nutrition or pleasure comprising such a fragrance composition.

title: METHOD OF PRODUCING A HIGH-PROTEIN FOOD PRODUCT FROM BREWER'S SPENT GRAIN
abstract: The present invention provides a method of producing a grain derived high-protein food product, comprising the steps of: a) providing a biomass substrate, wherein said biomass substrate comprises at least one type of grain, preferably brewer's spent grain; b) subjecting said biomass substrate to a heat treatment in order to sterilize the substrate; c) inoculating the sterilized substrate obtained from step b) with a fungal strain; and preferably forming the substrate into a predetermined shape suitable for a solid flatbed culture; and d) incubating the inoculated biomass substrate obtained in step c) at 15-30 °C in an aerobic environment to grow a network of fungal mycelium into the biomass substrate in order to improve the structure and flavor of the product. The present invention also provides a novel Pleurotus ostreatus strain.

title: How to make a high-protein food from brewer's spent grain
abstract: The present invention provides a method for producing a grain-based high protein food product, the method comprising the steps of: a) providing a biomass substrate, the biomass substrate comprising at least one type of grain, preferably brewer's spent grain; b) subjecting the biomass substrate to a heat treatment to sterilize the substrate; c) inoculating the sterilized substrate obtained from step b) with a fungal strain and preferably forming the substrate into a predetermined shape suitable for solid flat-bed culture; and d) incubating the inoculated biomass substrate obtained in step c) in an aerobic environment at 15-30°C to grow a network of fungal mycelium into the biomass substrate to improve the structure and flavor of the food product. The present invention also provides a novel Pleurotus ostreatus strain.

title: GALACTOOLIGOSACCHARIDE, ITS PREPARATION AND APPLICATION
abstract: Beta-galactooligosaccharide composition comprising 2.0-20 wt% 3' -galactosyllactose, 2.0-20 wt% 6'galactosyllactose, 3.0-25.0 wt% 4'-galactosyllactose, and a total amount of the disaccharides gal-β-1,2-glc and gal-β-1,3-glc of at least 15 wt%, all based on the total weight of oligosaccharides other than lactose in the composition, its production and use.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR OPTIMIZING PERSONAL WELL-BEING
abstract: The invention relates to an apparatus for optically measuring substance concentrations or biomarkers in a sample, comprising a contact surface which can be brought into contact with the sample during a measurement process and optoelectronic components in the form of a plurality of optical emitters for emitting photons and a plurality of detectors for receiving at least some of the photons which have been emitted from the emitters and have passed through at least a partial volume of the sample, wherein the emitters and the detectors are located on a common plane, and at least nine emitters are provided, and at least three detectors are provided, and the emitters and detectors are mounted at a distance of less than 15 mm from the contact surface, and wherein at least three wavelength intervals exist which do not overlap and which have an interval length of between 2 nm and 20 nm, and in each of the wavelength intervals at least the peak wavelength of three of the emitters lies, and in each wavelength interval at least two of the emitters which both lie within the wavelength interval have a difference in the peak wavelength of at least 0.5 nm.

title: Apparatus and method for optimizing personal well-being
abstract: An apparatus for optically measuring the concentration of a substance or biomarker in a sample, comprising: a contact surface that can be brought into contact with the sample during the measurement process; an optoelectronic component in the form of a plurality of optical emitters for emitting photons; and a plurality of detectors for receiving at least one portion of photons emitted from the emitters and passing through at least one partial volume portion of the sample, wherein the emitters and detectors are on a common plane, and at least nine emitters and at least three detectors are provided, the emitters and detectors are assembled at intervals shorter than 15 mm with respect to the contact surface, and there are at least three wavelength intervals having interval lengths between 2 nm and 20 nm, where at least three peak wavelengths of each emitter are located within each wavelength interval, and within each wavelength interval, at least two of the emitters that are both located within the wavelength interval have a difference of at least 0.5 nm with respect to their peak wavelengths.

title: HIGH PROTEIN CHEESE SUBSTITUTE WITH IMPROVED FLAVOUR COMPRISING HYDROCOLLOIDS
abstract: The current invention relates to a cheese substitute comprising a vegetable oil and/or fat, a plant-based protein, starches and/or modified starches, and a low-methoxylated, preferably amidated, pectin. The invention further relates to a method for preparing the cheese substitute, the use of low- methoxylated, preferably amidated, pectin in a cheese substitute and a food product comprising the cheese substitute.

title: FOOD PRODUCT CONTAINING AN OLEOGEL
abstract: A food product containing an oleogel is proposed, wherein the continuous phase of the oleogel is a vegetable oil.

title: SPRAY DRIED MILK OR MILK-BASED POWDER COMPOSITION AND METHODS THEREOF
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to a spray dried milk or milk-based powder composition comprising galacto-oligosaccharides (GOS) and low levels of lactose, and a method of making said composition.

title: Spray-dried milk or milk-based powder composition and methods thereof
abstract: The present description generally refers to a spray-dried or powdered milk composition based on milk comprising galacto-oligosaccharides (GOS), and low levels of lactose, and a method for preparing said composition.

title: METHOD FOR IMPARTING OR INCREASING A FLAVOUR WITH MIXTURES
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for imparting or increasing a flavour of a product serving for nutrition or pleasure or a semi-finished product, to a mixture comprising one or more natural deep eutectic solvent(s) and one or more flavouring agent(s), to the use of such a mixture for imparting a or increasing the flavour of a product serving for nutrition or pleasure or a semi-finished product and to a product serving for nutrition or pleasure or semi-finished product, comprising such a mixture.

title: APPARATUS FOR FOLDING A FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: Apparatus (15; 15a) for folding a meat product comprises at least one conveyor (18; 18a – 18f) for conveying a meat fillet (16), that is to be folded, in a forward direction the apparatus (15; 15a) including disposed opposite one another along the conveyor (18; 18a – 18f) first and second upstanding walls (19, 21; 19a – 19f, 21a – 21f), the walls being spaced from one another in a common plane occupied by the conveyor (18; 18a – 18f) and the first wall (19; 19a – 19f) including or having secured thereto a folding element (26; 26a – 26f) The folding element (26; 26a – 26f) defines a curved wall portion that extends upwardly and laterally inwardly relative to the conveyor (18; 18a – 18f) such that a rear end of the folding element (26; 26a – 26f) is spaced from the second wall (21; 21a – 21f) by a distance greater than or approximately equal to the width of the conveyor (18; 18a – 18f)and a forward end of the folding element (26; 26a – 26f) is spaced from the second wall (21; 21a – 21f) by a distance that is less than the width of a said meat fillet (16) whereby on conveying 15 of a said fillet (16) forwardly using the conveyor (18; 18a – 18f) the folding element (26; 26a – 26f) engages a laterally disposed portion of the fillet (16) and folds it relative to the remainder of the fillet (16).

title: AMBIENT STORAGE ACIDIC DAIRY PRODUCTS OR PLANT BASED ANALOGUES THEREOF OR SYNTHETIC ANALOGUES THEREOF WITH CARBOHYDRATES DP3+ AND PROCESSES OF PRODUCTION
abstract: The invention relates to ambient storage acidic dairy products or plant-based analogues thereof with live lactic acid bacteria and with carbohydrates DP3+. The ambient storage acidic dairy products may be fermented or acidified. The invention also relates to processed for producing such ambient storage acidic dairy products or plant-based analogues thereof.

title: PREDICTION METHODS FOR FUNGAL CULTURE AND CHARACTERISTICS PREDICTION OF MYCELIUM DERIVED PRODUCTS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for preparing fungal biomass comprising the step of cultivating at least one fungal strain according to conditions of fungal biomass cultivation, wherein said fungal biomass is characterized by a target property, wherein the method further comprises predicting how to cultivate said fungal biomass to achieve said target property, and to relating prediction method. The present invention further relates to a method for preparing fungal biomass comprising the step of cultivating at least one fungal strain according to conditions of fungal biomass cultivation, wherein said fungal biomass is characterized by a target property, wherein the method further comprises predicting a target property of said fungal biomass based on the conditions of fungal biomass cultivation, and to relating prediction method. The present invention further relates to biomass obtainable according to the methods of the present invention.

title: Methods for predicting fungal culture and predicting the characteristics of mycelium-derived products
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing fungal biomass comprising the step of culturing at least one fungal strain according to fungal biomass culture conditions, wherein the fungal biomass is characterized by target characteristics, and the method further comprises the step of predicting how to cultivate the fungal biomass to achieve the target characteristics, and the related prediction method. The present invention also relates to a method for producing fungal biomass comprising the step of culturing at least one fungal strain according to fungal biomass culture conditions, wherein the fungal biomass is characterized by target characteristics, and the method further comprises the step of predicting the target characteristics of the fungal biomass based on the fungal biomass culture conditions, and the related prediction method. The present invention also relates to biomass that can be obtained according to the method of the present invention.

title: Beverage Foaming Apparatus
abstract: A beverage foaming apparatus, various embodiments of which may include a gas pump and a beverage pump connected to a tube which is connectable to an external beverage holder to collect and transport said beverage out of said beverage holder. The gas pump may be arranged to supply foaming gas to the tube. The beverage pump may be arranged to drive said gas together with the beverage through a restriction downstream of the beverage pump for the formation of a gas beverage foam mixture. Embodiments may include an exit line to an outlet for the gas beverage foam mixture and a first sensor downstream of the restriction to monitor the density and quality of the gas beverage foam mixture downstream of the restriction.

title: BEVERAGE FOAMING APPARATUS
abstract: Beverage foaming apparatus, comprising a gas pump (9), a beverage pump (12) connected to a tube (6) which is connectable to an external beverage holder to collect and transport said beverage out of said beverage holder, said gas pump (9) being arranged to supply foaming gas to the tube (6), wherein the beverage pump (12) is arranged to drive said gas together with said beverage through a restriction (13) downstream of the beverage pump (12) for the formation of a gas beverage foam mixture, wherein said apparatus further comprises an exit line to an outlet (20) for the gas beverage foam mixture, wherein the apparatus comprises a first sensor (7, 21) downstream of the restriction (13) to monitor the density and quality of the gas beverage foam mixture downstream of the restriction (13).

title: A METHOD FOR THE SELF-ORGANIZED PRODUCTION OF VASCULARIZED SKELETAL MUSCLE FROM UNGULATE EMBRYONIC STEM CELLS
abstract: The present invention relates to an in vitro method for the production of ungulate myocytes and muscle fibers from suitable ungulate stable ESCs based on an improved protocol in a suitable culture medium free from fetal bovine serum. The method further provides a 3D culture with self-organization of muscle fibers and vascular-like networks with innervation. The present invention furthermore relates to the method for producing a comestible meat product, a comestible meat product produced according to the invention, and respective uses thereof.

title: USE OF PROBIOTIC COMBINATIONS FOR ALLEVIATING MENOPAUSAL SYMPTOMS
abstract: The present invention relates to therapeutic and non-therapeutic use of combinations of bacterial strains. In particular the use is for preventing or alleviating symptoms of menopause or climacteric symptom in a female mammal. Also disclosed herein are specific combinations of bacterial strains and their use in, as well as methods for reducing the need for estrogen replacement therapy, or for use in combination with estrogen replacement therapy, or other menopausal hormone replacement therapies.

title: FOOD COMPRISING FISH MYOGLOBIN
abstract: The present invention relates to a fish or meat substitute or a pet food, comprising a myoglobin from or derived from eastern Pacific bonito, sword fish or Atlantic blue marlin.

title: PRODUCTION OF TISSUE-LIKE STRUCTURES AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to a method to create an artificial tissue-like structure, said method relying on the use of a first layer A and a second ECM layer B, into or on which is then introduced living cells, which are then cultured in a viscous cell growth medium layer C containing high molecular weight viscous water-soluble polymers formed on top of layer B. The invention also relates to an artificial tissue-like structure obtained from the method as defined above, said structure containing at least a gelled layer B of extracellular matrix (ECM) proteins comprising living cells, covered by a viscous cell growth medium layer C containing molecular weight water-soluble polymers.

title: CULTIVATED CELL PRODUCTS
abstract: A hybrid food product comprises: a substance of plant origin; and cultivated non-human cells, wherein the wherein the cultivated non-human cells comprise at least about 30 % (w/w) of the hybrid food product.

title: COLLAPSIBLE CONTAINER
abstract: A collapsible container (10) for transporting goods is provided, the collapsible container (10) comprising: a base (16); a first pair of walls (14) that attach to the base (16), the first pair of walls (14) comprising a first wall and a second wall adjacent to the first wall; and a second pair of walls (12) that attach to the base (16), the second pair of walls (12) comprising a third wall and a fourth wall adjacent to the third wall; a first locking flap (24) that attaches to the first wall; wherein the second wall comprises a corresponding first locking formation (38) that is configured to engage with the first locking flap (24); a second locking flap (24) that attaches to the third wall; wherein the fourth wall comprises a corresponding second locking formation (38) that is configured to engage with the second locking flap (24); wherein each locking flap (24) pivotably attaches to the respective wall (12, 14) and is configured to pivotably move between an unlocking position and a locking position.

title: MINERAL DELIVERY FORMATION
abstract: This invention relates to a mineral delivery formulation comprising filaments, said filaments comprising protein, mineral and biopolymer. The invention also relates to methods for producing such formulations. The method also contemplates uses of the formulations.

title: MEAT-ANALOGUE COMPOSITION
abstract: A meat analogue composition comprises from 2% to 23% by weight of a fat composition; from 5% to 30% by weight of a non-animal protein; and from 30% to 70% by weight of water; wherein the fat composition comprises from 10% to 40% by weight of palmitic acid (C16:0); from 1% to 15% by weight of stearic acid (C18:0); and from 35% to 70% by weight of oleic acid (C18:1); wherein said percentages of fatty acid residues refers to fatty acids bound as acyl groups in glycerides in the fat composition and being based on the total weight of C4 to C24 fatty acid residues bound as acyl groups present in the fat composition; and wherein the fat composition (i) has a saturated fatty acid content of from 25% to 50% by weight; (ii) comprises greater the 1.5% by weight of S3 triglycerides, wherein S refers to a saturated C14 to C20 fatty acid moiety present in the triglyceride molecule; and (iii) comprises less than 34% by weight of SUS triglycerides, wherein S refers to a saturated C14 to C20 fatty acid moiety and wherein U refers to a C14 to C20 unsaturated fatty acid moiety present in the triglyceride molecule; wherein said percentages of triglycerides refers to percentage by weight of glycerides present in the fat composition.

title: THERMOREVERSIBLE GELS USEFUL IN PLANT-BASED MEAT ALTERNATIVES
abstract: The technology described in this specification pertains to a thermoreversible gel comprising a starch component and a fat. The thermoreversible gel is designed to complete melting at temperatures above around 50° C. The gel is useful to deliver fat and one or more of colorants or flavoring to a food composition like a plant base meat alternative.

title: Thermoreversible gels useful in plant-based meat substitutes
abstract: The technology described herein relates to thermoreversible gels that include a starch component and a fat. The thermoreversible gels are designed to completely melt at temperatures above about 50°C. The gels are useful for delivering fat and one or more colorants or flavorants to food compositions, such as plant-based meat substitutes. (Selected Figures)

title: A DOUGH PRODUCT ENRICHED WITH PLANT PROTEIN
abstract: The invention relates to a potato product enriched in protein and fibre, and low in carbohydrate. The invention provides a versatile protein enriched potato food base which can suitably be used in the production of a variety of potato food products ranging from potato mash to French fries and meat alternatives. Due to the protein enrichment of the potato food base, the nutritional value of these potato food products is substantially increased.

title: A DOUGH PRODUCT ENRICHED WITH PLANT PROTEIN
abstract: The invention relates to a potato product enriched in protein and fibre, and low in carbohydrate. The invention provides a versatile protein enriched potato food base which can suitably be used in the production of a variety of potato food products ranging from potato mash to French fries and meat alternatives. Due to the protein enrichment of the potato food base, the nutritional value of these potato food products is substantially increased. The invention also relates to a process for preparing protein enriched potato food products which are low in carbohydrates.

title: MICROBIAL LIPID COMPOSITION
abstract: The current invention relates to a microbial lipid composition, wherein said microbial lipid composition has a solid fat content at 20°C of between 5 and 80% by weight. The invention further relates to a method of production of a microbial lipid composition and use thereof. The invention further relates to a yeast strain.

title: MICROBIAL LIPID COMPOSITION
abstract: MICROBIAL LIPID COMPOSITION ABSTRACT The current invention relates to a microbial lipid composition, wherein said microbial lipid composition has a solid fat content at 20°C of between 5 and 80% by weight. The invention further relates to a method of production of a microbial lipid composition and use thereof. The invention further relates to a yeast strain.

title: METHOD FOR OPERATING A BEVERAGE PREPARATION DEVICE, IN PARTICULAR A FULLY AUTOMATIC COFFEE MAKER WITH A MEMBRANE FOAM MODULE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a beverage preparation device (01), in particular a fully automatic coffee machine, with a foam module (20) comprising a foam operation, wherein the foam operation is characterized by the following method steps: - flowing through a preferably porous membrane (10) of the foam module (20) with a driving fluid from a first membrane surface to a second membrane surface of the membrane (10); - flowing through a fluid chamber in which the second membrane surface of the membrane (10) is arranged with a fluid to be foamed, preferably containing protein, wherein the fluid to be foamed is conveyed by a feed pump (15), in particular a roller pump, which engages a feed line (07) which connects a container (08), preferably a milk container, to the fluid chamber.

title: Method for operating a beverage preparation device, in particular a fully automatic coffee machine with a membrane foam module
abstract: Method for operating a beverage preparation device (01), in particular a fully automatic coffee machine, with a frothing module (20) comprising a frothing operation, wherein the frothing operation comprises the following process steps: - Flowing a propellant fluid through a, preferably porous, membrane (10) of the frothing module (20) from a first membrane surface to a second membrane surface of the membrane (10); - Flowing a fluid to be frothed, preferably containing protein, through a fluid chamber in which the second membrane surface of the membrane (10) is arranged, wherein the fluid to be frothed is conveyed by a feed pump (15), in particular a roller pump, which engages a supply line (07) that connects a container (08), preferably a milk container, to the fluid chamber, characterized in that, before the completion of the frothing operation, the supply line (07) is supplied with propellant fluid and the supply line (07) is vented.

title: METHOD FOR OPERATING A BEVERAGE PREPARATION DEVICE, IN PARTICULAR A FULLY AUTOMATIC COFFEE MAKER WITH A MEMBRANE FOAM MODULE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a beverage preparation device (01), in particular a fully automatic coffee machine, with a foam module (13) comprising a rinsing and/or cleaning operation, wherein the rinsing and/or cleaning operation is characterized by the following method steps:- flowing through a preferably porous membrane (10) of the foam module (13) with a rinsing or cleaning fluid from a first membrane surface to a second membrane surface of the membrane (10);- discharging the rinsing or cleaning fluid via a fluid chamber (15) of the foam module (13) surrounding the membrane (10) to a fluid outlet (33) of the fluid chamber.

title: METHOD FOR OPERATING A BEVERAGE PREPARATION DEVICE, IN PARTICULAR A FULLY AUTOMATIC COFFEE MAKER WITH A MEMBRANE FOAM MODULE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for operating a beverage preparation device (01), in particular a fully automatic coffee machine, with a foam module (13) comprising a rinsing and/or cleaning operation, wherein the rinsing and/or cleaning operation is characterized by the following process steps: - Flowing a rinsing or cleaning fluid through a membrane, preferably porous, (10) of the foam module (13) from a first membrane surface to a second membrane surface of the membrane (10); - Draining the rinsing or cleaning fluid through a fluid chamber (15) of the foam module (13) surrounding the membrane (10) to a fluid outlet (33) of the fluid chamber.

title: METHOD FOR OBTAINING INSECTS OR INSECT LARVAE RICH IN VITAMIN D
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for preparing insects or insect larvae rich in vitamin D, comprising raising insects or their larvae on an ergosterol-rich food substrate, for example fungi, in order to obtain ergosterol-rich insects or larvae and then exposing them to UV radiation. The present invention also relates to insects and insect larvae rich in vitamin D, and to compositions comprising same, in particular intended for human and/or animal food or for cosmetic use.

title: Equipment and method for roasting food
abstract: The invention relates to an apparatus for automatically roasting food. The apparatus comprises a housing (1) adapted for placement over a driven conveyor belt movable in a conveying direction (3), on which, in use, the food (2) to be roasted is placed, and an electric hot air generator (4) provided in the housing and connected to the housing, wherein, in use, the electric hot air generator is located above the conveyor belt. The electric hot air generator comprises a heating element and a blower nozzle (5). In use, the air heated by the heating element is blown out through the blower nozzle as the conveyor belt moves, in an outflow direction towards the food on the conveyor belt at an angle relative to the conveying direction, the angle having a value in the range of 30° to 85°.

title: YEAST OLEOSOME COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention relates to a yeast oleosome composition comprising yeast oleosomes and at least one isolated yeast cell wall component and preferably having specific particle size, density and zeta potential. The composition is characterized by good physical stability and sensory properties. The invention also relates to a process for producing a yeast oleosome composition of the invention, to products comprising the yeast oleosome composition of the invention and to the use of the composition for improving the sensory properties of a food composition or beverage or of an edible ingredient. Furthermore, the composition of the present invention has proven useful in reducing the intensity of astringency in food products and beverages.

title: Yeast oleosome composition
abstract: The present invention relates to a yeast oleosome composition comprising yeast oleosomes and at least one isolated yeast cell wall component, preferably having a specific particle size, density, and zeta potential. This composition is characterized by good physical stability and functional properties. The present invention also relates to a process for producing the yeast oleosome composition of the present invention, a product containing the yeast oleosome composition of the present invention, and the use of the composition to improve the functional properties of food compositions, beverages, or edible components. Furthermore, the composition of the present invention has been proven useful in reducing the intensity of astringency in foods and beverages. [Selected Figure] None

title: HUMAN MILK OLIGOSACCHARIDES FOR LOWERING THE RISK OF AN INFECTION IN THE GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT
abstract: The disclosure relates to a composition for use in reducing the risk of an infection in the gastrointestinal tract caused by a pathogenic E. coli in a human subject, said composition comprising at least one human milk oligosaccharide, wherein the human milk oligosaccharide is 3-fucosyllactose, 3'-sialyllactose, 6'-sialyllactose, and / or lacto-N-tetraose.

title: Human milk oligosaccharides for reducing the risk of infection in the gastrointestinal tract
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a composition for reducing the risk of infection in the gastrointestinal tract caused by pathogenic e.coli in a human subject, said composition comprising at least one human milk oligosaccharide, wherein the human milk oligosaccharide is 3-fucosyllactose, 3 '-sialyllactose, 6' -sialyllactose and/or lactose-N-tetraose.

title: MIXTURE OF FIVE HUMAN MILK OLIGOSACCHARIDES FOR REDUCING THE RISK OF AN INFECTION IN THE GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT CAUSED BY PATHOGENIC E.COLI
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a composition for use in reducing the risk of an infection of the gastrointestinal tract caused by a pathogenic E. coli in a human subject, said composition comprising an effective amount of 2´-fucosyllactose, 3-fucosyllactose, 3'-sialyllactose, 6´-sialyllactose, and lacto-N-tetraose.

title: Mixture of five human milk oligosaccharides for reducing the risk of gastrointestinal infections caused by pathogenic escherichia coli
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a composition for reducing the risk of infection of the gastrointestinal tract caused by pathogenic escherichia coli in a human subject, the composition comprising an effective amount of 2' -fucosyllactose, 3' -sialyllactose, 6' -sialyllactose and lactose-N-tetraose.

title: PROMOTING BUTYRATE-PRODUCING BACTERIA IN THE GUT MICROBIOME
abstract: The present invention relates to a bifidogenic prebiotic for use in promoting butyrate-producing bacteria in the gut microbiome of an infant or young child; wherein the bifidogenic prebiotic is administered to the infant prior to about 12 months of age; and the butyrate-producing bacteria are promoted in the gut microbiome of the infant or young child between about 1 and 5 years of age.

title: ENCAPSULATED COLORANT
abstract: The present invention is related to a method of improving the color stability of an oil soluble colorant in a consumable comprising adding to a consumable base an effective amount of an oil soluble colorant encapsulated with at least one of: a whey containing protein, a milk polysaccharide such as lactose and glycoprotein and/or a plant protein.

title: Encapsulated colorants
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of improving the color stability of an oil-soluble colorant in a consumer product, the method comprising adding to a consumer product matrix an effective amount of an oil-soluble colorant encapsulated with at least one of whey-containing proteins, milk polysaccharides such as lactose and glycoproteins and/or vegetable proteins.

title: NOVEL PET FOOD COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention relates to an aqueous pet food composition that comprises: (a) a vegetable protein selected from the group consisting of pea protein and soya protein, and mixtures thereof; (b) a flour or a starch selected from the group consisting of wheat flour, pea starch, potato starch, and corn starch, and mixtures thereof, and cultivated meat, and which is ideally meat-free other than the cultivated meat component. The aqueous pet food composition can be used to feed a companion animal, such as a cat.

title: ARABINOSE-CONTAINING AND GALACTOSE-CONTAINING FOOD COMPOSITION AND PROCESS OF PREPARATION
abstract: An arabinose-containing and galactose-containing food composition is disclosed. Said food food composition is liquid or semi-liquid or powdered. It comprises plant proteins, less than 5wt.%free uronicacid by dry weight and a free arabinose to free galactose weight ration of from 1:1.5 to 1:5. A process for preparing such a food composition is also disclosed. A method for selecting an enzyme comprising a pectinase activity suitable for the invention is also disclosed.

title: MICROPARTICLES CONTAINING ALGAL PROTEINS AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to microparticles containing algal proteins and their use in various applications. In some embodiments, the microparticles are precipitates. In some other embodiments, the microparticles are coacervates. In some embodiments, the microparticles are core-shell microcapsules having a hydrophobic core material encapsulated by a shell that contains an algal protein. In some embodiments, the hydrophobic core material comprises a flavor oil, a fragrance oil, or a combination thereof. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides the use of such microparticles to improve the texture, mouthfeel, perceived fattiness, or perceived creaminess of a comestible article. In some embodiments, the comestible article is a vegan dairy product, a vegan meat product, or a vegan seafood product. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides the use of the microparticles to provide a fragrance to a fragranced product, such as a personal care product, a laundry product, or a cosmetic product.

title: Microparticles containing algal protein and their use
abstract: This disclosure generally relates to microparticles containing algal proteins and their use in various applications. In some embodiments, the microparticles are precipitates. In some other embodiments, the microparticles are coacervates. In some embodiments, the microparticles are core-shell microcapsules having a hydrophobic core material encapsulated by a shell containing algal proteins. In some embodiments, the hydrophobic core material includes flavoring oils, fragrance oils, or combinations thereof. In certain embodiments, this disclosure provides the use of such microparticles to improve the texture, mouthfeel, perceived fattiness, or perceived creaminess of food products. In some embodiments, the food products are vegan dairy products, vegan meat products, or vegan seafood products. In certain embodiments, this disclosure provides the use of microparticles to provide fragrance to scented products such as personal care products, laundry products, or cosmetics.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A TEXTURATE AND PROTEIN-CONTAINING TEXTURATE
abstract: The invention relates to a protein-containing texturate which is characterised by a special anisotropy comparable to meat. The texturate comprises a first protein mixture with a non-legume protein, in particular wheat protein, with a proportion of between 10 wt.% and 90 wt.% of the dry mass, and a second protein mixture, in particular with a legume protein or a side-stream product, with a proportion of between 10 wt.% and 90 wt.% of the dry mass. The moisture content is less than 40 wt.% and in particular less than 35 wt.%; a protein proportion of the texturate is between 35 wt.% and 60 wt.% of the dry mass. According to the invention, the texturate has fibres with a preferred direction and a length of more than 10 mm and in particular more than 15 mm, and has an anisotropy index of greater than 1 and in particular greater than 1.4.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A TEXTURATE AND EXTRUDER ASSEMBLY
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a texturate, in which a protein mixture is provided, comprising at least one first protein mixture, in particular a pea protein mixture or a broad bean protein mixture, with a weight proportion of between 45 wt.% and 75 wt.% relative to a base mixture. Water is added in a weight proportion of between 25 wt.% and 50 wt.% in relation to the basic mixture to form a dough and the dough is then extruded at a maximum temperature of between 110°C and 160°C to form an extrudate. The extrudate undergoes an elongation deformation at a temperature of greater than 100 °C by feeding the extrudate through an elongation nozzle, wherein the geometry thereof changes over its length such that a longitudinal and/or transverse elongation strain is generated on the mass.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A TEXTURATE AND EXTRUDER ARRANGEMENT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a texturate, in which a protein mixture is provided which has at least a first protein mixture, in particular a pea protein mixture or a field bean protein mixture, with a weight proportion of between 45% and 75% by weight based on a base mixture. Water with a weight proportion of between 25% and 50% by weight based on the base mixture is added to form a slurry and the slurry is then extruded at a maximum temperature of between 110°C and 160°C to form an extrudate. The extrudate is stretch-formed at a temperature of greater than 100°C by driving the extrudate through a stretching nozzle, the geometry of which changes over the length so that a longitudinal and/or transverse stretching stress is generated on the mass.

title: TERNARY ANTI-SPOT COMBINATION TO LIGHTEN SKIN
abstract: The present invention relates to a ternary anti-spot combination to lighten skin comprising hydroxytyrosol, masilinic acid and vitamin C. It also relates to nanocapsules comprising said combination. The present invention also relates to the use of said combination and said nanocapsules for the dermocosmetic treatment of the skin, and to a dermocosmetic composition comprising said nanocapsules.

title: Anti-stain ternary combination to lighten the skin (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: Anti-dark spot ternary combination for skin lightening. The present invention relates to an anti-dark spot ternary combination for skin lightening. It also relates to nanocapsules comprising said combination. It also relates to the use of said combination and said nanocapsules for the dermocosmetic treatment of skin, and to a dermocosmetic composition comprising said nanocapsules.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING STRUCTURED FOOD PRODUCTS, IN PARTICULAR MEAT SUBSTITUTE PRODUCTS
abstract: The invention relates to a device and a method for producing structured food products, in particular meat products and/or meat substitute products, wherein the device has a housing with an inlet for a base mass flow, an outlet for the structured food products and a structuring device for producing a defined structure formed by an additional mass in the base mass, wherein the structuring device comprises: a first portion with at least one opening for the base mass flow for producing at least one base mass strand, a second portion with a plurality of channels which are connected to inlets for respective additional mass flows that are distributed in particular around the circumference of the housing and guide the additional mass flow to a respective specified position of the housing cross-section, and a third portion with a plurality of outlet openings which are connected to respective channels in order to produce a plurality of additional mass strands.

title: NUTRITIONAL COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR OPTIMIZING PROTEIN QUALITY IN PRODUCTS CONTAINING PLANT PROTEIN SOURCES
abstract: A method of manufacturing a composition having optimal protein quality includes determining a ratio of a first protein source to a second protein source with an optimal protein quality using an optimization model and manufacturing a composition with that ratio of protein sources. Preferably, the composition has a PDCAAS score of about 1. The composition can have protein sources with limiting amino acids and preferably different protein sources with different limiting amino acids. The composition may be administered to an individual to increase protein bioavailability of the protein consumed by the individual. Preferably, the individual consumes a plant based diet.

title: Nutritional compositions and methods for optimizing protein profiles in products containing plant protein sources
abstract: A method for producing a composition having optimal protein properties includes determining the ratio of a first protein source and a second protein source having optimal protein properties using an optimization model, and producing a composition having that ratio of protein sources. Preferably, the composition has a PDCAAS score of about 1. The composition may have protein sources having limiting amino acids, preferably different protein sources having different limiting amino acids. The composition may be administered to an individual to improve the protein bioavailability of the protein ingested by the individual. Preferably, the individual is on a plant-based diet. title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING MARBLED AND STRUCTURED FOOD PRODUCTS, IN PARTICULAR MEAT SUBSTITUTE PRODUCTS
abstract: The invention relates to a device (1) and a method for producing marbled and structured food products (2), in particular meat substitute products, comprising: a first housing (3) having an inlet (4) for a base mass flow (5), at least one nozzle, in particular a plurality of nozzles (7a, 7b, 7c), for injecting a plurality of additional mass flows (6) into the base mass flow (5), and an outlet (8) for the marbled base mass flow (5), which has a marbled structure produced by the additional mass in the base mass; a second housing (30) having an inlet (40) for the marbled base mass flow (50) and an outlet for the structured food product (2); and a structuring device (180) for producing a defined structure of an additional mass in the marbled base mass, said structuring device (180) comprising at least one opening (160) for the marbled base mass flow (50) in order to produce at least one base mass strand (500) and a plurality of inlets (70a, 70b, 70c) for other additional mass flows (9) in order to produce a plurality of additional mass strands (90).

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING MARBLED AND STRUCTURED FOODSTUFFS, IN PARTICULAR MEAT SUBSTITUTE PRODUCTS
abstract: The invention relates to a device (1) and a method for producing marbled and structured foodstuffs (2), in particular meat substitutes, comprising: a first housing (3) with an inlet (4) for a base mass flow (5), at least one, in particular several nozzles (7a, 7b, 7c) for injecting several additional mass flows (6) into the base mass flow (5) and an outlet (8) for the marbled base mass flow (5), which has a marbled structure of the additional mass in the base mass, as well as a second housing (30), with an inlet (40) for the marbled base mass flow (50) and an outlet for the structured foodstuff (2) and with a structuring device (180) for producing a defined structure of a further additional mass in the marbled base mass, wherein the structuring device (180) comprises at least one opening (160) for the marbled base mass flow (50) for producing at least one base mass strand (500) and several inlets (70a,70b,70c) for further additional mass flows (9) for generating several additional mass strands (90).

title: COMBINED PRE-TREATMENT AND HYBRIDIZATION OF NUCLEIC ACIDS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for analysis of a sample for the presence and/or quantity of cellular and/or viral target nucleic acids by means of hybridization between a hybridization agent and the target nucleic acids, the method comprises rendering cells or viruses in the sample permeable to hybridization agent including adding one or more enzymes to the sample to enzymatically degrade the sample and/or to contribute to rendering the cells or virus permeable to hybridization agent; adding one or more hybridization agents to said sample; facilitating hybridization between the one or more hybridization agents and the target nucleic acids to form hybridized target nucleic acids; and detecting, qualitatively or quantitatively, the hybridized target nucleic acids; wherein the one or more hybridization agents and the one or more enzymes are added to the sample so as to provide a mixture comprising the sample, the added one or more enzymes and the added one or more added hybridization agents, in which mixture the hybridization is facilitated.

title: Integrated Pretreatment and Hybridization of Nucleic Acids
abstract: The present invention relates to a sample analysis method for analyzing the presence and/or amount of a cell and/or virus target nucleic acid by utilizing hybridization between a hybridizing agent and a target nucleic acid, wherein the method comprises the steps of: enzymatically degrading the sample and/or adding one or more enzymes to the sample that contribute to making the cell or virus permeable to the hybridizing agent, thereby making the cell or virus in the sample permeable to the hybridizing agent; adding one or more hybridizing agents to the sample; promoting hybridization between one or more hybridizing agents and a target nucleic acid to form a hybridized target nucleic acid; and qualitatively or quantitatively detecting the hybridized target nucleic acid, wherein one or more hybridizing agents and one or more enzymes are added to the sample to provide a mixture comprising the sample, one or more added enzymes, and one or more added hybridizing agents, and hybridization is promoted in the mixture.

title: IMPROVED HYBRIDIZATION ASSAY WITH STRINGENCY BUFFER DILUTION
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for analysis of a sample for the presence of one or more target nucleic acids, the method comprising i) contacting the sample with one or more hybridization agents capable of hybridizing to said one or more target nucleic acids to obtain a mixture of the agent and the sample, ii) diluting the mixture obtained in i with a stringency buffer (such as a high-stringency buffer), in the presence of which specific hybridization between the one or more hybridization agents and their respective target nucleic acids is favored over non-specific hybridization events, iii) detecting, qualitatively or quantitatively, hybridization agent(s) hybridized to target nucleic acids in the mixture, which optionally is further diluted.

title: Improved hybridization assay using strictness buffer dilution
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing a sample for the presence of one or more target nucleic acids, wherein the method i) a step of contacting a sample with one or more hybridizing agents capable of hybridizing with one or more target nucleic acids to obtain a mixture of the hybridizing agent and the sample, ii) a step of diluting the mixture obtained in i with a stringency buffer (e.g., a high-stringency buffer), wherein, in the presence of this stringency buffer, specific hybridization between one or more hybridizing agents and their respective target nucleic acids takes precedence over non-specific hybridization events; iii) a step of qualitatively or quantitatively detecting the hybridizing agent(s) hybridized with the target nucleic acid in the mixture, wherein the mixture is optionally further diluted.

title: TASTE-MODIFYING COMPOSITIONS AND USES THEREOF
abstract: Described herein are taste-modifying compositions and their use for reducing the unpleasant taste of a flavored product. The present disclosure further provides flavored products containing such taste- modifying compositions and one or more unpleasant tastants. The taste-modifying compositions described herein are suitable for use in food products, beverage products, or oral care products, such as toothpaste, dental gels, mouthwashes, mouth sprays, toothpaste, tablets and toothpaste powder.

title: Flavor-modifying composition and its use
abstract: Flavor-modifying compositions and their use for reducing unpleasant tastes in flavored products are described herein. This disclosure further provides flavored products containing such flavor-modifying compositions and one or more unpleasant taste substances. The flavor-modifying compositions described herein are suitable for use in food products, beverage products, or oral care products, such as toothpaste, dental gels, mouthwashes, mouth sprays, toothpaste tablets, and toothpaste powders.

title: DAIRY PRODUCT FOR HUMAN CONSUMPTION AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SUCH A DAIRY PRODUCT
abstract: A dairy product for human consumption comprises a mixture of animal milk and plant-based milk from sorghum flour, in a ratio between 2 : 3 and 3 : 2. The taste and the mouth-feel of such a mixture are surprisingly similar to those of pure animal milk (products), and the overall composition is very advantageous in the human diet. However, the ground areal required for the animal feed is clearly smaller, and also the emission from dairy animals for the same quantity of dairy product is much smaller.

title: Beverage for human consumption and method for producing such a beverage
abstract: SUMMARY A beverage for human consumption comprises a mixture of animal milk and plant milk, fermented from plant material, in a ratio of between 2:3 and 3:2. The taste and mouthfeel of such a mixture are surprisingly similar to those of pure animal milk, and the overall composition is very beneficial in the human diet. However, the land area required for animal feed is significantly smaller, and the emissions from dairy animals for the same amount of beverage are also much lower.

title: METHOD FOR PREPARING AN UMAMI FOOD INGREDIENT FROM A HEMP-BASED PLANT SUBSTRATE
abstract: The invention relates to the field of plant protein-based food products. More particularly, the invention relates to a method for preparing an umami food ingredient obtained from a hempseed-based substrate. The method is based on the fermentation of the substrate by at least one strain of Bacillus subtilis. This method may comprise a second modification, in particular a second fermentation, in order to modify the organoleptic properties of the product resulting from the first fermentation. This method makes it possible to prepare a plant-based protein ingredient having a high nutritional value and advantageous organoleptic properties. The obtained food product can be used as a substitute for animal proteins from an organoleptic perspective.

title: PROCESS FOR PREPARING AN UMAMI FOOD INGREDIENT FROM A HEMP-BASED PLANT SUBSTRATE
abstract: The invention relates to the field of plant protein-based foods. More particularly, the invention relates to a method for preparing an umami food ingredient obtained from a hemp seed-based substrate. This method is based on the fermentation of the substrate by at least one strain of Bacillus subtilis. This method may comprise a second modification, in particular a second fermentation, in order to modify the organoleptic properties of the product resulting from the first fermentation. This method allows the preparation of a plant protein ingredient of high nutritional quality having interesting organoleptic properties. The food product obtained can replace animal proteins from an organoleptic point of view.

title: CYCLIC IRON (II) CITRATE MONOHYDRATE AND PRODUCTION METHOD THEREOF, PHARMACEUTICAL AND/OR NUTRACEUTICAL AND/OR FOOD COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING IT AND USES THEREOF IN THERAPY AND IN THE NUTRITIONAL FIELD
abstract: In an iron (II) citrate monohydrate, identified by the formula FeC6H6O7-H2O ( Ferrous citrate monohydrate or iron citrate (II) monohydrate), obtained according to a particular production method, citric acid and elemental iron are bound in a molecular complex where the iron is agglomerated in the citrate which moves to a cyclic form and the iron is bound to the O groups of the carboxylic groups 1 and 3 through ionic bonds, forming two enantiomers, D and L (R and S), both perfectly water-soluble and highly assimilable by the human body. Formula (L) & Formula (D). With a different absorption mechanism from traditional iron molecules, said iron citrate monohydrate is usable in pharmaceutical and/ or nutraceutical and/ or food compositions, in particular in the treatment and prevention of iron deficiency anemias and in general of all diseases and disorders associated with iron deficiency. The effectiveness is proven by several examples.

title: OLEOGEL BASED ON LINOLEIC OIL AND/OR HIGH OLEIC OIL, METHOD OF PREPARATION AND USES
abstract: The present invention relates to an oleogel based on linoleic oil and/or high oleic oil and food grade wax, in particular beeswax and candelilla wax, the method of preparation thereof and the use thereof as an ingredient in a food preparation, preferably as a total or partial substitute for fats and oils from other sources. According to a preferred aspect, the oleogel of the invention can be used as a functional ingredient in a food preparation, to supplement fats and oils from other sources. The invention also relates to a food preparation comprising the oleogel of the invention, said food preparation preferably being a biscuit, a baked confectionery product, preferably a brioche, a spread, a vegetable alternative to cheese, or a vegetable alternative to meat and meat products (e.g. hamburgers).

title: MACHINE FOR EXTRUSION OF FOODSTUFF MATERIAL
Strengthening-functionalizing composition and its application method and method of preparing the strengthening composition
abstract: The subject of the application is a poultry-based meat and plant-based product with increased nutritional and health-promoting value and reduced energy value, characterized by containing poultry and plant-based ingredients, wherein the plant-based ingredients include quinoa seeds, millet, psyllium seeds, teff flour, and linseed oil. The subject of the application also includes a method for obtaining the poultry-based meat and plant-based product.

title: Strengthening-functionalizing composition and its application method and method of preparing the strengthening composition
abstract: The subject of the application is a meat-plant product based on poultry meat with increased nutritional and health-promoting value and reduced energy value, characterized by the fact that it contains poultry meat raw material and plant raw material, where the plant raw material contains quinoa seeds, millet, psyllium seeds. , teff flour and linseed oil. The subject of the application is also a method of obtaining a meat-plant product based on poultry meat.

title: ENZYMATIC METHOD OF PRODUCING PLANT PROTEIN EXTRACT
abstract: A method of producing plant protein extract, which comprises treating plant protein raw materials under alkaline conditions, recovering the protein and spray drying the recovered protein, wherein protein deamidase is added before alkaline treatment or during alkaline treatment or after alkaline treatment. The obtained plant protein extract has improved solubility which can be used in the food or beverage.

title: ENZYMATIC METHOD OF PRODUCING PLANT PROTEIN EXTRACT
abstract: A method of producing plant protein extract,which comprises treating plant protein raw materials under alkaline conditions, recovering the protein and spray drying the recovered protein,wherein protein deamidase is added before alkaline treatment or during alkaline treatment or after alkaline treatment.The obtained plant protein extract has improved solubility which can be used in the food or beverage.

title: COCOA-FREE CHOCOLATE COMPOSITIONS AND PRODUCTS AND METHODS FOR PRODUCING SAME
abstract: The present invention provides cocoa-free chocolate compositions and products made from non-animal, or plant-based, ingredients, and methods for preparation thereof.

title: Cocoa-free chocolate compositions and products and methods for making same
abstract: The present invention provides cocoa-free chocolate compositions and products made from non-animal or plant-based ingredients, as well as methods for their preparation.

title: METAL FIBER
abstract: The present invention relates to a metal fiber having an anisotropic surface texture, comprising: a first end region on a first end of the metal fiber having a smooth surface; and a second end region on a second end of the metal fiber having a non-smooth surface.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A COMPOSITION COMPRISING AN OVALBUMINE
abstract: Method of producing a composition comprising an ovalbumin including: obtaining a microorganism to express an ovalbumin protein and a protein disulfide isomerase, a growth phase of the microorganism, a co-expression phase of the ovalbumin protein and the protein disulfide isomerase, the co-expression phase being concomitant and/or subsequent to the growth phase, stabilization of the tertiary structure of the ovalbumin protein by formation of disulfide bridge(s), catalyzed by the protein disulfide isomerase, an extracellular secretion phase of ovalbumin, purification of the ovalbumin.

title: BEVERAGE PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a product for preparing a beverage comprising a fibre containing ingredient coated with one or more beverage ingredient powders and a sugar. The present invention also relates to a process for manufacturing a product comprising the steps of: a) spraying an aqueous liquid onto a dry mixture comprising a fibre containing ingredient and one or more beverage ingredient powders and sugar to coat the fibre-containing ingredient with one or more beverage ingredient powders and a sugar. b) mixing the mixture formed in step a); and c) drying the coated fibre-containing ingredient to form a product comprising a fibre-containing ingredient coated with one or more beverage ingredient powders and a sugar.

title: Beverage product
abstract: A product for preparing a beverage comprising a fibre containing ingredient coated with beverage ingredient powder(s) and a sugar. Preferably, the fibre containing ingredient is cocoa with a particle size of 400-800μm. Preferably, the beverage ingredient is instant coffee powder, chocolate powder, milk powder, and/or a creamer. Preferably, the product contains 35–50wt.% of the fibre ingredient, 30-40wt.% beverage powder(s), and/or 15-25wt.% sugar. Preferably, the mean density of the product is 450-550g/l. Also claimed is a process for manufacturing a product comprising a) spraying an aqueous liquid onto a dry mixture of the fibre containing ingredient, beverage ingredient(s) and sugar to coat the fibre-containing ingredient, b) mixing and c) drying the coated fibre-containing ingredient to form the product. Preferably, the aqueous liquid is water or sugar solution. Preferably, the product is densified before step c). Preferably, the dry mixture is put in a granulator. Preferably, the product is packed in a beverage preparation machine insertable container, and a beverage is prepared by dissolving and/or suspending some of the product in a fluid.

title: PROCESS FOR MANUFACTURING A PRODUCT FOR PREPARING A BEVERAGE
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for manufacturing a product for preparing a beverage comprising the steps of: a) spraying an aqueous liquid onto a dry mixture comprising a fibre-containing ingredient and sugar to wet the mixture; b) adding one or more beverage ingredient powders to the wetted mixture to attach the one or more beverage ingredients and sugar onto a surface of the fibre-containing ingredient; and c) drying the mixture formed in step b) to form a product comprising a fibre-containing ingredient having one or more beverage ingredient powders and sugar attached on a surface thereof. The present invention also relates to a product obtainable by the above process.

title: Process of manufacturing a product for preparing a beverage
abstract: A process for manufacturing a product for preparing a beverage comprising: a) spraying an aqueous liquid (preferably water or sugar solution) onto a dry mixture comprising a fibre-containing ingredient and sugar; b) adding beverage ingredient powder(s) to the wetted mixture to attach the beverage ingredient(s) and sugar onto a surface of the fibre-containing ingredient; and c) drying the mixture. Preferably, the fibre-containing ingredient is cocoa with a 400-750μm particle size. Preferably, the beverage ingredient is instant coffee, chocolate powder, milk powder and/or creamer. Preferably, the process includes densifying the fibre-containing ingredient after and/or during step b) to at least 400 g/l. Also claimed is the product of the process, which preferably comprises 15–65wt.% fibre-containing ingredient, 1-60wt.% beverage ingredient(s), 1-35wt.% sugars and 0.1-1.0wt.% flavouring. Preferably, the beverage ingredient powders and sugar discontinuously cover the surface of the fibre ingredient and the mean density of the product is 400-750 g/l. Also claimed are a container for a beverage machine containing the beverage, a method of preparing it, a method of preparing a beverage, and a product for preparing a chocolate beverage.

title: COMPOSITION
abstract: Compositions comprising at least about 7 weight percent of rosmarinic acid and at least about 0.3 weight percent of Schizotenuin A. Consumables, such as foods and beverages, that include the compositions, methods of making the compositions and consumables, and uses of the compositions are also provided.

title: Plant analogue of cheese and method of its production
abstract: The subject of the application is a method for producing a plant-based cheese analogue (yellow, hard) using protein from potato juice in which coconut fat or a blend of vegetable oils in the amount of 10% - 20% by weight, preferably 15% by weight, is heated to a temperature of 50°C, and then lecithin is added to the heated fat, preferably liquid rapeseed lecithin in the amount of up to 5% by weight or HPX inulin in the amount of up to 10% by weight, and water in the amount of 18.9% to 73.49%, preferably 43.9% to 48.9% by weight, after which the mixture is homogenized for at least 2 minutes at a mixing speed of 10,000 rpm, until a water-oil emulsion is obtained, to which potato protein in the amount of 5% - 15% by weight, preferably 10% by weight, 0.5% by weight of salt, orange food coloring are added. in an amount of 0.3% by weight, 0.2% vegan cheese aroma, and vitamin and mineral additives in an amount of 0.1% by weight, after which the raw material mixture is homogenized again for at least 3 minutes at a mixing speed of 10,000 rpm, modified potato starch is added to the obtained first-stage cheese-like mass in an amount of 10% - 30% by weight, preferably 20% by weight, and the entire mixture is mixed for 20 minutes while heating it to 90°C, the obtained second-stage cheese-like mass is blended and shaped, then cooled at 4°C for 4 hours and then packaged. The subject of the application also includes a cheese analogue produced by the method according to the invention.

title: Plant analogue of cheese and method of its production
abstract: The subject of the application is a method for producing a plant analogue of cheese (yellow, hard) using protein from potato juice in which coconut fat or a blend of vegetable oils in an amount of 10% - 20% by weight, preferably 15% by weight, is heated to a temperature of 50°C and then lecithin, preferably liquid rapeseed lecithin in an amount of up to 5% by weight or HPX inulin in an amount of up to 10% by weight and water in an amount from 18.9% to 73.49%, preferably from 43.9% to 48.9% are added to the heated fat % by weight, then the mixture is homogenized for at least 2 minutes at a mixing speed of 10,000 rpm until a water-oil emulsion is obtained, to which potato protein is added in an amount of 5% - 15% by weight, preferably 10% by weight, 0.5% weight of salt, orange food coloring in the amount of 0.3% by weight, 0.2% of vegan cheese flavor and vitamin and mineral additives in the amount of 0.1% by weight, then the raw material mixture is homogenized again for at least 3 minutes at a mixing speed of 10 000 rpm, modified potato starch is added to the obtained first-degree cheese-like mass in an amount of 10% - 30% by weight, preferably 20% by weight, and the whole mixture is mixed for 20 minutes by heating it to 90°C, the obtained second-degree cheese-like mass is blended and formed, then cooled at 4°C for 4 h and then packed. The subject of the application is also a cheese analogue produced by the method according to the invention.

title: CHOCOLATE COMPOSITION COMPRISING A MILLET COMPONENT
abstract: The present invention is directed to a chocolate composition comprising a cocoa-based component and a millet component. The millet component consists of non-hydrolyzed millet flour, hydrolyzed millet flour, or mixtures thereof, and is present in the chocolate composition in an amount from 1 to 35 wt.-% with respect to the total weight of the chocolate composition.

title: Chocolate composition comprising millet component
abstract: The present invention relates to a chocolate composition comprising a cocoa-based component and a millet component. The millet component consists of unhydrolyzed millet flour, hydrolyzed millet flour or mixtures thereof and is present in the chocolate composition in a content of 1 to 35wt% relative to the total weight of the chocolate composition.

title: A BEVERAGE DISPENSING APPARATUS
abstract: A beverage dispensing apparatus (10) has a vessel (11), the vessel (11) having an outer wall (12), a sealable opening (13) located in the outer wall (12) and an air inlet port (14) located in the outer wall (12) at position (15). The beverage dispensing apparatus (10) also includes an air pump (16) connectable to the air inlet port (14). A lid (23) is sized to cover the sealable opening (13) in the outer wall (12) of the vessel (11). A beverage outlet port (25) is located in lid (23). A conduit (27) locatable in the vessel (11), in use, passing out of the lid (23) through an outlet port (25). In use, a supply of beverage is introduced into the vessel (11) through the sealable opening (13), and the air pump (16) is activated so as to raise the pressure in the vessel (11) to above the ambient air pressure, resulting in the dispensing of an aliquot of the beverage through the beverage conduit (27) by positive air displacement.

title: RECOMBINANT PHYTOGLOBINS
abstract: The present invention relates to a recombinant haem- or phytoglobin protein comprising a C-helix and a D-helix covalently joint into a CD-loop domain and comprising a hexa- or penta-coordinated prosthetic haem group, wherein the haem- or phytoglobin has an amino acid sequence which is at least 50% identical the haem- or phytoglobin comprised in anyone of SEQ ID NO: 1 to 55, wherein the CD-loop domain comprises one or more modifications compared to a parent CD-loop domain, whereby the modified CD-loop domain binds the prosthetic group stronger than the parent unmodified CD-loop domain and wherein the parent CD-loop domain, wherein the parent CD-loop domain is positioned in the recombinant haem- or phytoglobin protein corresponding to the position 52 to 78 of SEQ ID NO: 1, optionally position 52 to 72 of SEQ ID NO: 1 and wherein the CD-loop domain has an amino acid sequence which is at least 50% identical to the CD-loop domain comprised in anyone of SEQ ID NO: 56 to 147.

title: Recombinant phytoglobin
abstract: The present invention relates to a recombinant heme or phytoglobin protein comprising C-helices and D-helices covalently linked to a CD loop region, and comprising a hexa-coordinate or penta-coordinate prosthetic heme group, wherein the heme or phytoglobin has at least 50% identical amino acid sequence to the heme or phytoglobin contained in any one of SEQ ID NOs: 1 to 55, the CD loop region comprises one or more modifications compared to the parent CD loop region, thereby the modified CD loop region is more strongly bound to the prosthetic group than the parent unmodified CD loop region, the parent CD loop region is located at positions 52 to 78 of SEQ ID NO: 1 in the recombinant heme or phytoglobin protein, optionally corresponding to positions 52 to 72 of SEQ ID NO: 1, and the CD loop region has at least 50% identical amino acid sequence to the CD loop region contained in any one of SEQ ID NOs: 56 to 147. title: PRODUCING CELL CONTAINING FIBERS FOR ARTIFICIAL MEAT
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of tissue engineering, particularly the field of artificial meat production. The present invention provides a method for producing a cell-containing fiber comprising, providing a microcarrier, cells capable of interacting with the microcarrier, and a composition comprising a compound capable of crosslinking or solidifying, which are spun to generate a fiber, which is at least partially crosslinked or solidified. The present invention further provides cell-containing fibers. The present invention further provides an edible, cell-containing fiber for use as artificial meat. The present invention further provides a spinning system for producing a cell-containing core-shell hollow fiber. The present invention further provides a method for producing artificial meat. The invention further provides artificial meat comprising assembled and/or collected one or more edible, cell-containing fiber(s).

title: BETA-GLUCAN-RICH CEREAL PLANT-BASED BEVERAGE
abstract: The invention relates to a cereal plant-based beverage comprising an amount of beta-glucan of at least 1.2 g/100 ml of plant-based beverage. The invention further relates to a method for preparing such a plant-based beverage.

title: Plant-based cereal drink rich in beta-glucans
abstract: The invention relates to a cereal-based plant-based beverage containing at least 1.2 g/100 mL of beta-glucans. The invention also relates to a process for preparing such a plant-based beverage. Claim 1: A cereal-based plant-based beverage containing at least 1.2 g/100 mL of beta-glucans. Claim 9: A process for preparing a plant-based beverage according to any one of claims 1 to 8, comprising the following steps: providing a powdered cereal-based fraction containing starch and an amount of beta-glucans equal to or greater than 10% by weight of the total weight of the fraction; mixing said fraction with water to obtain a suspension; and hydrolyzing the starch in the suspension.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR CUTTING POULTRY MID-WINGS
abstract: The invention relates to a device for cutting pieces of meat, preferably pieces of poultry, in particular poultry mid-wings, into separate portions. The invention also relates to a drive system for use or used in said device according to the invention. The invention further relates to a method for cutting pieces of meat, preferably pieces of poultry, in particular poultry mid-wings, into separate portions, preferably by making use of the device according to the invention.

abstract: The invention relates to a device for cutting pieces of meat, preferably pieces of poultry, in particular poultry mid-wings, into separate portions.
