title: MYCOPROTEIN BASED MEAT-ANALOGUES
abstract: Food ingredient comprising a water drained biomass of a first filamentous fungus as a first component having a dry matter content of 18-30 (weight/weight) %, as measured by thermogravimetric principle by measuring the start weight of a biomass sample before water draining, and drying the biomass sample by a radiant heater while measuring continuously the biomass sample weight by scales.

title: Meat substitute based on fungal proteins
abstract: A food ingredient comprising as a first component a dehydrated biomass of a first filamentous fungus, said biomass having a dry matter content of 18-30% (weight/weight), wherein said dry matter content is determined by thermogravimetric principle, i.e. measuring the initial weight of the biomass sample before the dehydration treatment, and continuously measuring the weight of the biomass sample by means of a weighing device while drying the biomass sample with a radiation heater.

title: PHAGE DEFENCE GENES FOR STARTER STRAINS
abstract: The invention relates to the field of fermentation technology. The invention specifically relates to genes that are useful for protecting bacterial strains from phage infections, and to bacterial strains comprising such genes. Such strains can be used in methods to produce a fermented food product such as a fermented milk product. The invention also relates to food products produced using such strain or composition.

title: Phage defense genes for starting strains
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fermentation. The invention relates in particular to genes useful for protecting bacterial strains from phage infection, and to bacterial strains comprising such genes. Such strains may be used in a process for producing a fermented food product, such as a fermented milk product. The invention also relates to food products produced using such strains or compositions.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING VEGETABLE MILK
abstract: Apparatus and method for producing plant-based milk, comprising a raw material source, a decanter device downstream of the raw material source, and a sieve filtration device downstream of the decanter device.

title: EMULSIFYING COMPOSITION COMPRISING BREWER'S SPENT GRAINS AND METHOD OF PREPARING AND USE OF THE EMULSIFYING COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention relates to an emulsifying composition, wherein the composition comprises milled brewer's spent grains having a volume-weighted mean particle size of 160 µm or less, and preferably a particle size distribution with a 10% cumulative particle size (d10) of 10 µm or less and a 90% cumulative particle size (d90) of between 120 µm and 275 µm, and a protein content of between 15-30 wt.% with respect to the total weight of the brewer's spent grains. The present invention further relates to the use of the emulsifying composition of the present invention in the preparation of food products. Further, the present invention also relates to a method of preparing an emulsifying composition comprising milled brewer's spent grains, the method comprising the successive steps of: a) providing brewer's spent grains, b) milling the brewer's spent grains provided in step a), and c) optionally, sieving the milled brewer's spent grains.

title: Emulsifying composition comprising brewer's spent grains and method of preparing and use of the emulsifying composition
abstract: The present invention relates to an emulsifying composition, wherein the composition comprises milled brewer’s spent grains having a volume-weighted mean particle size of 160 pm or less. The present invention further relates to the use of the emulsifying composition of the present invention in the preparation of food products. Further, the present invention also relates to a method of preparing an emulsifying composition comprising milled brewer’s spent grains, the method comprising the successive steps of: a) providing brewer’s spent grains, b) milling the brewer’s spent grains provided in step a), and c) optionally, sieving the milled brewer’s spent grains.

title: CAF1 POLYMERS COMPRISING MODIFIED CAF1 MONOMERS
abstract: The present invention relates to novel Caf1 polymers, comprising modified Caf1 monomers or portions thereof. A hydrogel comprising the novel Caf1 polymers, a method of making the novel Caf1 polymers, and several uses for the Caf1 polymers are also provided herein.

title: HOLLOW FIBRES
abstract: The present disclosure provides extruded or spun, semi-permeable, porous hollow fibres, comprising covalent ester, thioester and/or amide crosslinked polypeptides as well as processes for their production. The hollow fibres may be produced from protein, protein extracts, and/or protein isolates derived from plants, animals, bacteria, algae, archaea, and/or fungi, and in certain embodiments are intended to be suitable for human and/or animal ingestion. In some embodiments, the hollow fibres may be designed to be used in the production of cartridges that are compatible with existing and/or novel bioreactor platforms, for harbouring cell cultures in cultured meat production.

title: Method for producing oak seed powder for use in food industry
abstract: The method of producing oak seed powder intended for use in the food industry consists in that oak seeds, dehulled and crushed, with a water content of 14 - 15% by weight, are subjected to alkalization using an aqueous solution of a mixture of ammonium carbonate and sodium hydroxide as an alkalizing agent, with the weight ratio of the mixture of carbonate and hydroxide to oak seeds not exceeding 1:5, at a temperature of 75 - 85°C for 15 - 30 minutes while stirring, and then the alkalized product is subjected to drying at a temperature not higher than 100 - 115°C for 60 - 80 minutes.

title: SYSTEM FOR MONITORING FISH TREATMENT
abstract: The invention provides a system and method of monitoring at least one characteristic and/or condition of a fish treatment operation. The method comprising obtaining image data of fish after and/or during a fish treatment operation and assessing a welfare score and/or at least one characteristic of parasites or lice on a treated fish from the image data. The method monitoring at least one characteristic and/or condition of a fish treatment operation based on the analysed image data.

title: Methods and system for monitoring fish treatment
abstract: Monitoring characteristics or conditions of a fish treatment operation, comprising: obtaining images of fish during or after treatment; assessing a welfare score or characteristics of parasites or lice on a treated fish from the images; monitoring characteristics or conditions of the fish treatment operation based on the analysed images. Treatment parameters may be adjusted to improve treatment efficacy. Fish treatment characteristics may include: fish collecting, handling, sorting, holding or transporting conditions; pipe orientation, angle, inclination, height, drop distance, water level; treatment type, chemical treatment eg. hydrogen peroxide, mechanical treatment (eg. brushing, flushing), exposure time; water quality, flow rate, temperature, oxygen level, pH, carbon dioxide, alkalinity, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate, salinity, freshness, pressure, contaminant content, hardness. Lice characteristics may include number, colour, swelling, shape, size. Fish welfare indicators may include dead fish, size, disease, cuts, skin colour, bleeding, reluctance to move, swim pattern, swim speed, breathing rate, fish behaviour, posture, mucus, opercular beat frequency. Monitoring treatment conditions may provide indications of long term effects on fish including death, prolonged stress, suppressed immune systems, reduced growth rates, impaired swimming performance, impaired reproduction and increased susceptibility to disease. Trained machine learning may be used to detect fish characteristics in images. [Fig. 6]

title: FOOD SUPPLEMENT
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a container containing a liquid food supplement, wherein the container containing the liquid food supplement can be placed in a domestic freezer in order to provide a frozen food supplement; and the use of a container containing a liquid food supplement to provide a frozen food supplement. The present disclosure further relates to a method of preparing a frozen food supplement, as well as a liquid food supplement, a chilled food supplement and a frozen food supplement.

title: Food supplement
abstract: A container contains a liquid food supplement and can be placed in a domestic freezer to provide a frozen food supplement. The liquid supplement may comprise, per 100 ml, 2-10g protein, 5-15g starch, and 20-50g water, and may further include 1-5g fibre, up to 8g fat and/or up to 3g vitamins and minerals. The total carbohydrate content of the liquid food supplement may be 25-45g per 100 ml, and the energy content may be 50-300 kcal per 100g. The protein may be derived from a non-animal source, e.g. pea protein, and the supplement may be dairy-free and/or vegan. The starch may be tapioca starch. Use of the container and a method of providing a frozen food supplement by placing the container in a freezer are also claimed. The liquid food supplement, the food supplement when chilled, and the food supplement when frozen are also claimed. The frozen food supplement may comprise a dispersion of ice crystals distributed in a freeze-concentrated liquid phase. The frozen food supplement may be in the form of a sorbet, iced smoothie or ice lolly. The liquid, chilled or frozen food supplement for use in maintaining or increasing body weight is also claimed.

title: PROCESS FOR PRODUCING PLANT-BASED FERMENTED FOOD OR FEED WITH UMAMI-RICH SENSORY PROFILE, REDUCED OFF FLAVOR AND MULTIFUNCTION, PRODUCTS OR INGREDIENTS OBTAINED THEREFROM AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for producing plant-based fermented food or feed containing plant protein with umami-rich sensory profile and improved nutritional profile, as well as products obtained therefrom and uses thereof. In particular the present invention relates to a process for producing fermented food or feed wherein the plant proteins are cross-fermented by the use of the combination of Propionibacterium spp., Lactobacillus spp., Aspergillus spp., and Saccharomyces spp. as well as products obtained therefrom and uses thereof. The process of the invention is based on the use of solid-state-fermentation (SSF) and submerged fermentation (SMF).

title: METHODS FOR MODIFYING TEXTURE IN FOODSTUFF VIA PREFERABLY IN SITU PRODUCED ALPHA-GLUCAN
abstract: Disclosed herein are methods of producing a food product or food precursor. These methods can comprise: (a) providing a food product/precursor that comprises at least water and sucrose, and (b) contacting the food product/precursor with at least one glucosyltransferase enzyme (GTF) and, in some aspects, a second enzyme that utilizes sucrose as a substrate, such as an invertase. One or more GTFs can be selected from (i) a GTF that synthesizes alpha-1,6-glucan, and/or (ii) a GTF that synthesizes alpha-1,3-glucan. Such enzymatic treatment typically results in alpha-glucan production in the food product/precursor. Treatment of a food product/precursor with a second enzyme that utilizes sucrose as a substrate can modify the effects that the GTF treatment has on the food product/precursor, such as with texture formation, sugar composition, and/or sweetness. Food products and food precursors produced by this methodology are also disclosed.

abstract: The invention relates to pasteurised meat analogues that comprise at least two differently coloured water-continuous phases that are distinguishable to the human naked eye, including a pale phase and a reddish phase. Despite the fact that the meat analogue of the present invention has been pasteurised, there is little to no migration of this combination of colouring agents from the reddish phase into the pale phase.

title: PROTEIN STRUCTURING MODULE, ARRANGEMENT AND METHOD FOR PROVIDING A STRUCTURED PROTEIN SUBSTANCE FOR MANUFACTURING OF A FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: The present document relates to a protein structuring module for a providing arrangement for manufacturing of a food product, using a protein constituent. The module establishes a shear stress for aligning molecules of the protein constituent, by including a first and a second solid part. The first solid parts are detachably connected to each other along their contact surfaces, and at least one of said contact surfaces includes a groove running across the surface. Together, as connected, the groove in the contact surfaces of the connected first and second solid parts define a shear channel of the cell having a first open end and a second open end. The open ends define an inlet and an outlet for conveying the structured protein substance.

title: Liquid distribution manifold
abstract: A liquid distribution manifold for an automated beverage preparation system. The manifold has a channel 120 with at least one branch 130. The channel 120 has an integral seal 150, aligned with the branch opening. The integral seal can be open (Fig. 2E), so the branch 130 is in fluid communication with the main channel 120; or the integral seal can be pinched closed (Fig. 2F), so that the branch 130 is closed. When the branch is sealed, liquid can still flow around the seal through the main channel 120, e.g., via flow paths 122. The manifold may have multiple branches and corresponding integral seals, and may be formed of an elastomeric material such as silicone. This manifold minimises dead-legs, in which stagnant liquid could be retained, and facilitates cleaning by flushing, thus aiding hygiene.

title: Apparatus for cleaning a liquid uptake conduit
abstract: An apparatus 1 for cleaning a liquid uptake conduit comprises a first conduit 3 for the flow of a first liquid in a first flow path. The first conduit 3 has an inlet and an outlet. A shroud element 4 is deployable between a first configuration and a second configuration. In the first configuration, the shroud element 4 is arranged to enclose a first portion 5 of the first conduit 3, such that a second portion of the first conduit 3 is uncovered by the shroud element 4 and corresponds with a storage volume for receiving a container 2. The inlet of the first conduit 3 is configured for the uptake of the first liquid from the container 2. In the second configuration, the shroud element 4 is arranged to enclose the first 5 and second portions of the first conduit 3, to provide a second flow path for the flow of a second liquid between an outer surface of the first conduit 3 and an inner surface of the shroud element 4, from the outlet towards the inlet of the first conduit 3.

title: Method for producing instant vegetable steaks based on beetroot flesh and a steak produced using this method
abstract: The subject of the application is an instant vegetable steak containing a mixture of at least one type of flour, dried vegetables, spices and roasted buckwheat flakes, textured pea protein, mushroom and roasted linseed, in which a functional additive made of beetroot pulp is added to the steak ingredients in the amount of 4 - 9% by weight in the form of crushed cubes or powder, and the amount of the remaining ingredients is in the range of 14 to 15% by weight of dried roasted buckwheat flakes, 15 to 16% by weight of dried textured pea protein, 15 to 16% by weight of pumpkin flour, 17 to 19% by weight of chickpea flour, dried onion 2% by weight, dried garlic 2% by weight, dried parsley 2% by weight, dried black pepper 0.2% by weight, dried lovage leaves 2% by weight dried cumin seeds 0.5% by weight, dried smoked paprika 3% by weight, dried boletus mushroom 8% by weight, roasted linseed 10% by weight and Himalayan salt 0.3% by weight. The application also covers a method for producing instant vegetable steak based on beet pulp, characterized in that in the first stage, fresh storage root (tuber) of beetroot is subjected to the process of washing, cleaning and peeling and it is crushed so that it is preferably shaped into cubes, preferably with dimensions not smaller than 2.0 x 2.0 cm, which are subjected to the process of freezing at a temperature of (-18°C) - (-30°C) for a period of 12 hours, then it is subjected to the process of osmotic dehydration and the obtained crushed pulp is immersed in an aqueous solution containing inulin and iron (II) sulfate 7-hydrate in a weight ratio of 6:1 (e.g. 300 g of solution + 50 g of beet pulp), placed in tightly closed, preferably glass vessels, in a heated water bath and shaken, and then the solution is removed from the beet pulp, which is then filtered on a filter with a weight of 87 [g/m<sup>2</sup>] and then frozen to a temperature of (-18°C) - (-30°C) for 24 hours, the dehydrated and frozen beet pulp is dried in a freeze-dryer, preferably at a temperature of +20°C on the heating shelf, maintaining a vacuum of 1,030 mBar and a maximum pressure of 1,600 mBar) for 22 hours, the drying process of the beet particles is carried out until the water content is in the range of 6 - 8%, after drying the beet pulp is ground in a cryogenic mill, during which the plant preparation is pre-frozen for about 10 minutes and kept at a low temperature, preferably at a temperature of (-194°C) throughout the entire grinding cycle (2-3 min) using a magnetic grinder and vibration frequency preferably 20 - 30 HZ, after which the obtained dried beetroot is mixed with dried vegetables, pumpkin flour, chickpea flour, roasted buckwheat flakes, textured pea protein, boletus mushroom and Himalayan salt, and the obtained mixture is preferably divided into portions of 150 g.

title: Reactor apparatus

title: ADVANCED NITRITE REPLACEMENT IN PROCESSED MEATS, FISH, AND DAIRY: MULTIFUNCTIONAL FOOD INGREDIENTS FOR ENHANCED PRESERVATION AND HEALTH BENEFITS
abstract: The present invention introduces innovative Multifunctional Food Ingredients (MFIs) designed to replace sodium nitrite in processed meats, fish and dairy. These MFIs are formulated from plant-based extracts of polyphenols, known for their antioxidant, and antipathogenic properties, efficacy in food preservation, colour stabilisation, and a broad spectrum of health advantages, further enhanced by dietary fibre. This invention directly addresses public health concerns linked to the consumption of nitrite food additives and their associated risks of colon cancer and cardiovascular diseases. Furthermore, the synergistic combination of polyphenols and dietary fibres provides enhanced benefits for gut health, marking a significant advancement in the formulation of food additives. Additionally, this invention aligns with the global shift towards sustainable, eco-friendly bioproducts, contributing to the reduction of agri-food waste.

    Further, the present invention relates to a method for manufacture of a chocolate product (1, 2), comprising the following steps:

b) adding melted cocoa butter to the mass to form a further mass,
c) milling the further mass for conching,
d) maintaining the milled further mass at a temperature of 40-45°C, and
e) tempering the milled and heated further mass in order to obtain the chocolate product (1, 2).

title: LIQUID OAT BASE OR OAT DRINK
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a liquid oat base or oat drink for coffee or tea whitening, comprising an oat derived material with 5-25% by weight dry substance, based on the weight of the liquid oat base or oat drink, characterized in having an oat protein deamidation degree of 15% or below, wherein the oat derived material comprises, by dry weight of the oat derived material, DP1 to DP2 sugars in an amount of 40-70%, and DPS to DPS oligosaccharides present in an amount of 10-40%.

title: UNGULATE PLURIPOTENT STEM CELL CULTURE MEDIUM
abstract: The present invention relates to an ungulate pluripotent stem cell culture medium, the use thereof and a method to culture ungulate pluripotent stem cells. In particular, the present invention relates to a culture medium comprising a Wnt pathway inhibitor and a SMAD2/3 activator, wherein said culture medium comprises less than or equal to 1,000 mg/L protein.

title: FERMENTED ROASTED CAROB
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for the preparation of a fermented roasted carob, in particular a fermented roasted carob powder which can be used as base ingredient characterized by a color, sensory profile, and volatile compounds similar to cocoa powder. Furthermore, the present invention relates to a fermented roasted carob obtained by the method of the invention. Moreover, the present invention relates to the use of the fermented roasted carob for replacing up to 100% of roasted cocoa and in products based on or containing cocoa and in various forms (powder, liquid, solid).

title: CHEESE ANALOGUE
abstract: The invention pertains to a cheese analogue comprising a protein, a gelling agent, a fat and water, wherein the cheese analogue is an emulsion-filled gel and wherein the cheese analogue comprises fat droplets having a size exceeding 20 μm.

title: CHEESE SUBSTITUTE COMPRISING YEAST PROTEIN
abstract: The current invention relates to a cheese substitute comprising a vegetable oil and/or fat, starches and/or modified starches, plant-based protein and yeast protein. The invention further relates to a method for preparing the cheese substitute, the use of yeast protein in a cheese substitute and a food product comprising the cheese substitute according to the present disclosure.

title: METHOD OF MAKING A FERMENTED PLANT-BASED FOOD PRODUCT AND PRODUCTS THEROF
abstract: The invention presented herein describes a fermented plant-based food product comprising a matrix of substrate interconnected by at least a filamentous fungus having a geometrical shape with one dimension longer than the other two orthogonal dimensions, with a length being the longest direction of the fermented plant-based food and the two other length are at least 3 cm each and preferably at least 7 cm each, the length is at least 3 cm and preferably at least 7 cm, wherein a cross section parallel or perpendicular to the longest direction of the fermented plant-based product presents a whiteness of 15% or more and preferably 20% or more.

title: MEAT ANALOGUE FOOD COMPRISING MYCOPROTEINS AND MICROALGAE (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: Meat analogue food that includes mycoproteins and microalgae. The meat industry generates a great environmental impact and is characterized by having a high price that many people cannot afford. Protein consumption is vital in the human diet, which in most cases depends on meat intake. Protein foods that do not contain meat in their composition are generally based on vegetable protein and are characterized by having a nutritional deficiency and not having an amino acid profile as complete as meat. The present invention is about a meat substitute made from mycoproteins and microalgae, rich in proteins and enriched with vitamin B12 and omega-3 oils, with a texture and flavor analogous to meat, which entails a significantly lower environmental impact than of the meat industry. title: Extrudate for the production of plant meat substitute and method of producing the extrudate
abstract: The subject of the application is an extrudate for the production of a plant-based meat substitute which consists of potato protein in an amount of 2.55% to 7.65% by weight, rice protein in an amount of 20.4% to 40.8%, preferably wheat gluten in an amount of up to 5.1%, preferably wheat flour type 500 in an amount of up to 18.7%, preferably wheat starch in an amount of up to 18.7%, preferably rice flour in an amount of up to 24.65%, corn semolina in an amount of 17% to 31.45% (22.95%), solid fat in an amount of 1.7%, preferably hardened palm oil, preferably low-methylated pectin in an amount of up to 4.25% and, if necessary, water to balance the mixture in addition to 100%. The subject of the application is also a method for producing an extrudate, in which a raw material mixture is prepared from potato protein in an amount of 2.55% to 7.65% by weight, rice protein in an amount of 20.4% to 40.8%, preferably wheat gluten in an amount of up to 5.1%, preferably wheat flour type 500 in an amount of up to 18.7%, preferably wheat starch in an amount of up to 18.7%, preferably rice flour in an amount of up to 24.65%, corn semolina in an amount of 17% to 31.45% (22.95%), solid fat in an amount of 1.7%, preferably hardened palm oil, preferably low-methylated pectin in an amount of up to 4.25% and, if necessary, to balance the mixture of water in addition to 100%, after selecting the recipe variant, a raw material mixture is prepared by weighing the individual ingredients and placing them in a mixer, and after measuring the moisture content, the mixture of ingredients is moistened to 12% - 18%, preferably to 15% moisture content and conditioned in a mixer with a ribbon agitator at 20 rpm +/- 3%, after which the mixture is subjected to the extrusion process in such a way that the extrusion process is carried out in a single-screw extruder with a plasticizing system L: D = 12: 1 and a nozzle in the range of 2-5 mm, preferably 3.5 mm, using the temperature parameters of the process: 135°C +/- 7°C - temperature of the first zone, 155°C +/- 7°C - temperature of the second zone, 135°C +/- 7°C - temperature of the head, at a screw rotational speed of 75 to 105 rpm<sup>-1</sup>, preferably 90 rpm<sup>-1</sup>.

title: Extrudate for the production of plant meat substitute and method of producing the extrudate
abstract: The subject of the application is an extrudate for the production of a plant meat substitute which consists of potato protein in an amount from 2.55% to 7.65% by weight, rice protein in an amount of 20.4% to 40.8%, preferably wheat gluten in an amount of up to 5 1%, preferably type 500 wheat flour in an amount up to 18.7%, preferably wheat starch in an amount up to 18.7%, preferably rice flour in an amount up to 24.65%, corn grits in an amount from 17% to 31.45 % (22.95%), solid fat in the amount of 1.7%, preferably hydrogenated palm oil, preferably low-methylated pectin in the amount of up to 4.25% and, if necessary to balance the mixture, water up to 100%. title: WET LEGUME PROTEIN CONCENTRATE
abstract: The present invention relates to a plant protein composition, preferably from legumes, more preferably from peas or faba beans, characterised by the presence of dietary fibres and a low content of antinutritional compounds such as galacto-oligosaccharides. Another aspect of the invention relates to a method for producing these novel legume proteins, preferably from peas or faba beans. The invention also relates to the use of the legume proteins, preferably from peas or faba beans, for the manufacture of food products.

title: WET PROTEIN CONCENTRATE FROM LEGUMES
abstract: The present invention relates to a composition of vegetable proteins, preferably from legumes, preferably from peas or field beans, characterized by the presence of dietary fibers and the low content of antinutritional compounds such as galacto-oligosaccharides. Another subject of the invention relates to a method for manufacturing these new legume proteins, preferably from peas or field beans. The invention also relates to the use of said legume proteins, preferably from peas or field beans for the manufacture of food products.

title: DIE FOR EXTRUDING A MATERIAL RICH IN PROTEINS AND WATER, AND SYSTEM FOR CONTINUOUSLY PREPARING AN EXTRUDED FOOD PRODUCT, COMPRISING SUCH A DIE
abstract: A tubular casing centered on an axis and a coaxial core mounted rotatably about the axis. An upstream part of the core extends into the casing so that a material flow channel is defined therebetween, which is annular in cross-section and centered on the axis. A downstream part of the core extends outside the casing and is coupled to a motor-drive for driving in rotation is fixedly secured to the casing and coaxially received in the casing so that a passage is delimited therebetween, connecting a central inlet of the casing and an upstream end of the channel. The passage is shaped so that the material advances through the passage forming a flow that diverges from the axis toward the downstream and is distributed around the axis. The male divergent part abuts axially against the upstream part of the core, supporting same and guiding same in rotation.

title: DIE FOR EXTRUDING A PROTEIN-RICH AND WATER-RICH MATERIAL, AND SYSTEM FOR CONTINUOUSLY PREPARING AN EXTRUDED FOOD PRODUCT, COMPRISING SUCH A DIE
abstract: This die (200) comprises a tubular casing (210), centered on an axis (X-X), and a coaxial core (220), rotatably mounted around the axis. An upstream portion (220.1) of the core extends into the casing so that a material flow channel (230) is delimited between them, with an annular cross-section and centered on the axis. A downstream portion (220.2) of the core extends outside the casing and is coupled to a rotational drive motor (250). A male divergent part (260) is fixedly secured to the casing and received coaxially in the casing so that a passage (270) is delimited between them, connecting a central inlet (211) of the casing and an upstream end (230A) of the channel. The passage is shaped so that the material progresses therein, forming a flow (6) which diverges from the axis downstream and is distributed around the axis. The male divergent is axially abutted to the upstream part of the core, supporting it and guiding it in rotation.

title: VITELLARIA PARADOXA EXTRACT COMPOSITION
abstract: The invention relates to a Vitellaria paradoxa extract composition comprising at least 5000 μg/g of gallic acid and at least 2500 μg/g of total flavan-3-ols. The invention also relates to a use of a Vitellaria paradoxa extract composition and an edible product or a cosmetic product comprising a Vitellaria paradoxa extract composition. Further, the invention also relates to a process for producing a Vitellaria paradoxa extract composition.

title: GRANULES BASED ON SODIUM IMINODISUCCINATE, METHODS FOR PREPARING SAME AND USES THEREOF IN SOLID COSMETIC COMPOSITIONS
abstract: The present invention relates to a granule comprising, or consisting of, the following components: - sodium iminodisuccinate, - at least one alkyl polyglucoside, wherein the alkyl chain is a carbon chain comprising from 4 to 20 carbon atoms, in particular 10 carbon atoms, the granule comprising a moisture content of 4.5 to 6%.

title: New granules based on sodium iminodisuccinate, their preparation processes and their uses in solid cosmetic compositions
abstract: The present invention relates to a granule comprising, or consisting of: sodium iminodisuccinate, at least one alkyl polyglucoside, wherein the alkyl chain is a carbon chain having from 4 to 20 carbon atoms, in particular 10 carbon atoms, said granule having a moisture content of 4.5 to 6%. (no figures)

title: PLANT PROTEIN CAVITATION AND PLANT-BASED FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a process for producing a cavitated plant-based protein preparation. The disclosure also relates to a cavitated plant-based protein preparation obtained by the process of the present disclosure. Furthermore, the disclosure relates to a food product containing the cavitated plant-based protein preparation.

title: Plant protein cavitation and plant-based food product
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing a cavitated plant-based protein preparation. The invention also relates to a cavitated plant-based protein preparation obtained by the method of the present invention. Furthermore, the invention relates to a food product containing a cavitated plant-based protein preparation.

title: IN VITRO METHOD OF PRODUCING MILK
abstract: The invention relates to a lactiferous unit adapted to be cultured in suspension in a bioreactor, to a method for producing said lactiferous unit and also to a method for producing a milk-like product therefrom.

title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING TRIGONELLINE FOR TREATING MUSCLE DECLINE AND A KIDNEY DYSFUNCTION
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to methods and compositions comprising trigonelline that treat or prevent a disease or condition associated with muscle decline and/or a kidney dysfunction. Moreover, methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for decelerate glomerular filtration rate (GFR) progression and/or decrease glomerular hyalinosis damage and/or to improve the lean mass of a muscle. In addition, methods and compositions comprising trigonelline to improve the lean mass of a muscle and/or to improve the muscle fiber size are disclosed. Also disclosed are methods and compositions comprising trigonelline to improve the level of at least one nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide. Also disclosed are methods and compositions comprising trigonelline to increase muscle stem cells and/or mitigate a decline of muscle stem cells.

title: Methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for treating muscle decline and kidney dysfunction
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for treating or preventing diseases or disorders associated with muscle decline and/or renal dysfunction. Furthermore, it relates to methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for slowing the progression of Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) and/or reducing glomerular vitreogenic injury and/or increasing lean body mass of muscle. Furthermore, methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for increasing lean body mass of muscle and/or increasing muscle fiber size are disclosed. Also disclosed are methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for increasing the level of at least one nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide. Also disclosed are methods and compositions comprising trigonelline for increasing muscle stem cells and/or reducing muscle stem cell decline.

title: FOOD BINDER AND METHOD FOR PRODUCING SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of foods. What is disclosed herein is a method of producing binders for non-animal foods, which comprises the mixing of processed and unprocessed Leguminosae flours having a high starch content until they are homogeneous, and imitates the effect of conventional food binders. The food binder can be used for breadcrumb coating of foods, as a binder in novel vegan matrices, and as a binder in baked and confectionery products. The food binder is also of very good suitability for cold applications.

title: A MEAT CULTURE CONSTRUCT FOR A MEAT CULTURING SYSTEM
abstract: The present disclosure provides a meat culture construct (400) for a meat culturing system, the meat culturing system having a housing adapted to receive the meat culture construct. The meat culture construct comprises a plurality of fibres (412) and an end support (404) in which ends of the plurality of fibres are embedded such that the plurality of fibres extend from the end support and into the housing when the meat culture construct is received in the housing of the meat culturing system. At a plane through the end support the plurality of fibres are arranged in a fibre distribution defined by an envelope (414) containing the plurality of fibres. The envelope has a first dimension (416) and a second dimension (418), and a ratio of the first dimension to the second dimension is at least 2:1 in order to enhance fluid access to fibres within the fibre distribution. Also disclosed herein is a harvesting system, a meat culturing system, a method of seeding a meat culture construct, a method of harvesting cultured meat, and a meat of culturing meat.

title: MODIFICATION OF PLANT-BASED DAIRY ANALOGUE
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of food technology, especially to a process of producing a plant-based dairy analogue food product. The disclosure also relates to a plant-based dairy analogue obtainable with the process as defined in the present disclosure.

title: Modification of plant-based dairy analogue
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of food technology, especially to a process of producing a plant-based dairy analogue food product. The disclosure also relates to a plant-based dairy analogue obtainable with the process as defined in the present disclosure.

title: COMPOSITION BASED ON COFFEE AND TEA
abstract: The invention relates to a composition based on coffee and tea, the composition comprising the following components: A1) roasted coffee in the form of solid particles or an aqueous solution; or A2) an extract of roasted coffee in the form of powder agglomerates; B) tea leaves in the form of solid particles or an extract of tea leaves in the form of a powder or an aqueous solution. The proportion by weight of component B in the composition, disregarding any water content, is: C1) 0.5% to 3.5%, preferably 1.0% to 2.5%, relative to component A1; or C2) 5% to 30%, preferably 9% to 21%, relative to component A2.

title: LOW-FAT PLANT MEALS CONTAINING AGGREGATED PLANT GLOBULINS, PLANT-GLOBULIN-ENRICHED PRODUCTS, AND RELATED PROCESSES
abstract: The invention lies in the field of alimentary plant protein extraction, in particular from oil-rich plant material frequently containing high polyphenol contents. Among other aspects, provided herein are methods for preparation of defatted plant meals, which involve treatment of comminuted raw, possibly cold-pressed, plant material with a solvent comprising a mixture of ethyl acetate, ethanol and water, and followed by an evaporative drying step. The treatment results in at least partial aggregation of plant globulins comprised within the thus obtained meals, which when enriched by performing additional process steps, e.g. comprising filtration, result in novel plant-globulin enriched products having specific characteristics that make them not only very suitable as ingredients in food, but in particular as ingredients for plant-based beverages like plant-based milks.

title: DAIRY-ANALOGUE COMPOSITION
abstract: The invention relates to dairy analogue compositions comprising from 1% to 90% by weight of a fat composition; and up to 99% by weight of water; wherein the fat composition comprises a blend of (a) a lauric vegetable fat; and (b) an interesterified blend of a lauric fat and non-lauric vegetable fat. In particular, the invention relates to the use of certain fat compositions in dairy analogue compositions to improve various properties of the dairy analogue compositions.

title: Artificial dairy composition
abstract: The present invention relates to an artificial dairy composition comprising 1 to 90 wt.% of a fat composition and at most 99 wt.% of water, wherein the fat composition comprises a blend of (a) lauric vegetable fat, and (b) a transesterified blend of lauric and non-lauric vegetable fat. In particular, the present invention relates to the use of certain fat compositions in artificial dairy compositions for improving various properties of the artificial dairy compositions.

title: CHOCOLATE ALTERNATIVE PRODUCT AND METHOD OF PREPARING SAID
abstract: The present invention relates to a chocolate alternative product comprising spent grains, edible fat and optionally sugar. The present invention also relates to a method of producing said chocolate alternative product and the use hereof.

title: Brine for injecting fatty fish meat, especially salmon
abstract: The brine for injecting fatty fish meat, especially salmon, is characterized in that it contains fatty fish protein isolate in the range of 10% to 50% by weight in relation to the weight of the brine, wherein the fatty fish protein isolate is obtained by the method of isoelectric dissolution and precipitation in an alkaline medium from by-products containing muscle tissue of the injected fatty fish before heat treatment or from by-products containing muscle tissue of the same fish species as the injected fatty fish before heat treatment.

title: Brine for injecting fatty fish meat, especially salmon
abstract: Brine for injecting fatty fish meat, especially salmon, is characterized by the fact that it contains fatty fish protein isolate in the range from 10% to 50% by weight in relation to the weight of the brine, and the fatty fish protein isolate is obtained by isoelectric dissolution and precipitation in an alkaline environment. from by-products containing muscle tissue of the injected fatty fish before thermal treatment or from by-products containing muscle tissue of the same fish species as the injected fatty fish before thermal treatment.

title: APPARATUS FOR FEEDING FOOD PRODUCTS TO PACKAGING MACHINE
abstract: A feeder for feeding a food product to a packaging machine, including a forming station for forming a food product into a pat of a desired configuration. An upper conveyor overlapping a lower conveyor for receiving a food product there between to conform the food product into a desired thickness and move the food product into the forming station. An elongated knife is disposed transversely to the discharge ends of the upper and lower conveyor belts for cutting the food product into a pat of a desired width and forming a first longitudinal side wall of the forming station. A movable wall located opposite to the knife to form a second longitudinal side wall of the forming station. A support conveyor forms the base of the forming station to support the food product while being formed into a pat and then advancing the formed pat to a takeaway apparatus.

title: A feeding device for feeding food products to a packaging machine
abstract: A feeding device is disclosed, which comprises a forming station for forming a food product into a pat of a desired specification, and supplies the food product to a packaging machine. An upper conveyor overlaps a lower conveyor to receive the food product therebetween, and forms the food product into a desired thickness and simultaneously moves the food product to the forming station. An elongated knife is arranged transversely to the discharge ends of the upper and lower conveyor belts to cut the food product into pats of a desired width, thereby forming a first longitudinal side wall of the forming station. A movable wall is arranged opposite the knife to form a second longitudinal side wall of the forming station. A support conveyor forms the floor of the forming station to support the food product while it is being formed into a pat, and then transports the formed pat to a discharge device.

title: RECOVERING INSECT BY-PRODUCTS
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for recovering organic waste in several stages, in the form of a reproducible cycle, allowing the production of biogas, biological fertilizer and proteins.

title: VEGAN MEAT SUBSTITUTE
abstract: A vegan meat substitute is described, comprising 30 - 60 wt.% based on the total weight of the meat extract of hydrated texturate with pieces of a certain minimum length. The invention further relates to the use of a corresponding vegan meat substitute as a component of an animal feed, in particular a dog or cat feed, and to a method for producing a vegan meat substitute according to the invention.

title: Vegan meat substitute
abstract: A vegan meat substitute is described, comprising 30 - 60 wt.% based on the total weight of the meat extract of hydrated texturate with pieces of a certain minimum length. The invention further relates to the use of a corresponding vegan meat substitute as a component of an animal feed, in particular a dog or cat feed, and to a method for producing a vegan meat substitute according to the invention.

title: VEGAN ANIMAL FEED
abstract: The present invention relates to a vegan animal feed comprising at least two phases, wherein one phase is a gel-like mass and the second phase is a lumpy mass and wherein the second phase consists of meat substitute mass and occupies 15 - 50% of the surface area of the animal feed. The present invention further relates to a method for producing a vegan animal feed according to the invention.

title: Vegan pet food
abstract: The present invention relates to a vegan animal feed comprising at least two phases, wherein one phase is a gel-like mass and the second phase is a lumpy mass and wherein the second phase consists of meat substitute mass and occupies 15 - 50% of the surface area of the animal feed. The present invention further relates to a method for producing a vegan animal feed according to the invention.

title: METHOD OF PROCESSING
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of processing a plant product, the method comprising processing the plant product to create a pomace portion and a juice portion then further processing at least one of the pomace portion and juice portion. Where the juice portion is further processed, the following additional steps are followed: a) heating the juice portion; b) adding flocculant to the juice portion; c) cooling the juice portion; and optionally, d) separating any resultant solids from the juice portion to produce a liquid portion and a solid portion, if solids are present. If the pomace portion is further processed, the pomace portion is fermented.

title: Method of processing
abstract: A method for processing a plant product comprises processing the plant product to create a pomace portion and a juice portion and then further processing at least one of the pomace portion and the juice portion. Further processing of the juice portion comprises heating, adding flocculant and cooling. Preferably any solids present are separated from the juice portion to produce a liquid portion and a solids portion, e.g. by centrifugation, pressing or sieving. Further processing of the pomace portion comprises fermenting. The method preferably does not include the addition of an acid. The plant product may be a Brassicaea, Apiaceae and/or Cannabaceae, e.g. broccoli, cauliflower, carrot, parsley, coriander and/or industrial hemp. The plant product may comprise a side stream product. Creating the juice and pomace portions may be achieved by pressing or maceration. The flocculant is preferably selected from sagina subulata, Chondrus crispus, polyglutamic acid, succinoglycan, sclerotium gum, chitosan, cellulose-based flocculants, starch-based flocculants and/or lignin. The pomace portion may be fermented by mixing in a culture comprising a bacteria selected from the genera bifidobacterium, staphylococcus, debaryomyces, penicillium, leuconostoc, lactobacillius, pediococcus and/or streptococcus.

title: Apparatus and method for forming an alternative meat product
abstract: The present invention relates to a device (1) for continuously forming an alternative meat product (P), comprising a mixing unit (2), a compression unit (3), a heating unit (5), and a cutting unit (7), wherein the mixing unit (2), the compression unit (3), the heating unit (5), and the cutting unit (7) are connected to one another via respective inlets and outlets, optionally via additional units, and wherein the heating unit (5) is a volumetric heating unit. The present invention further relates to a method for continuously forming an alternative meat product (P), which is carried out in this device.

title: Device for forming an alternative meat product and alternative meat product
abstract: Device (1) for continuously forming an alternative meat product (P), comprising - a mixing unit (2); - a compression unit (3), - a heating unit (5) and - a cutting unit (7), characterized in that the mixing unit (2), the compression unit (3), the heating unit (5) and the cutting unit (7) are connected to one another via respective inlets and outlets, optionally via additional units, and in that the heating unit (5) is a volumetric heating unit.

title: RNA MOLECULE
abstract: The present invention relates to RNA molecules, and particularly, although not exclusively, to methods for preparing RNA molecules, and to methods for translating RNA molecules into protein. The invention extends to improved methods for forming RNA by in vitro transcription, and to the resultant RNA molecules. Furthermore, the invention relates to novel methods for enhancing the expression and/or translation of RNA, i.e. protein expression, and to methods for improving the stability of an RNA molecule. The invention also involves reducing the activation of innate sensing, interferon generation and/or degradation of an RNA molecule in a host. The invention also incorporates the use of the RNA molecules in vaccines and other therapeutic pharmaceutical compositions, and their use in immunisation and therapy, such as RNAi, gene therapy, gene editing and protein replacement. In particular, the invention relates to locked nucleotides and locked nucleic acid (LNA)-RNA molecules, and the use or incorporation of such locked nucleotides and LNA-RNA molecules in any of the above applications.

title: METHODS FOR OBTAINING PLANT-BASED READY-TO-DRINK COFFEE OR TEA BEVERAGES
abstract: The present invention relates to the use of protein deamidase in obtaining plant-based ready-to-drink coffee or tea beverages with improved stability, in particular improved storage stability.

title: Method for obtaining a plant-based ready-to-drink coffee or tea beverage
abstract: The present invention relates to the use of protein deamidating enzymes for obtaining a plant-based ready-to-drink coffee or tea beverage with improved stability, in particular improved storage stability.

title: METHODS OF PREPARING A FOOD COMPONENT FROM PULSES
abstract: A method of preparing a food component from pulses is disclosed, comprising the general steps of providing a substrate from whole pulses with less than 35% protein content based on pulse dry matter and providing an aqueous slurry; enzymatically treating the slurry by adding at least one amylase, at least one protease and at least one tannase; and optionally removing insoluble fractions and finally collecting the food component. Also disclosed are non-dairy ready-to-use product comprising such food components and milk replacement products.

title: Method of Preparing a Food Component from Pulses
abstract: A method of preparing a food component from pulses is disclosed, comprising the general steps of providing a substrate from whole pulses with less than 35% protein content based on pulse dry matter and providing an aqueous slurry; enzymatically treating the slurry by adding at least one amylase, at least one protease and at least one tannase; and optionally removing insoluble fractions and finally collecting the food component. Also disclosed are nondairy ready-to-use product comprising such food components and milk replacement products.

title: FUNCTIONAL FAVA BEAN PROTEIN
abstract: The invention is directed to a process for manufacturing a denatured fava bean protein extract, a denatured fava bean protein extract, a denatured fava bean protein composition, a textured fava bean protein composition, and the use of said extract and said compositions.

title: Functional broad bean protein

title: Foodstuff
abstract: A vegan yoghurt comprises a filamentous fungus and mesophilic bacteria and/or its residue. Preferably, the bacteria is live lactic-acid producing bacteria, e.g., mesophilic Lactococci or Lactobacilli, i.e., Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis. Preferably, the yogurt includes thermophilic bacteria, preferably, lactic-acid producing bacteria, i.e., Streptococcus thermophilus, Pediococcus acidilacti, Lactobacillus delbrueckii spp bulgaricus; Lactobacillus acidophilus; Lactobacillus helveticus; and Bifidobacteria sp. Preferably, the yoghurt includes at least 106 CFUs of mesophilic bacteria and the fungus has filaments <50μm and/or comprises fungal mycelia. Preferably, the fungus is Fusarium venenatum A3/5. Preferably, the yogurt includes 5-10wt% filamentous fungus and 4-14wt% plant-based milk, preferably, coconut milk. Preferably, the yogurt has a protein content of 3-25g/100g. Also claimed is a process for making the yogurt, which may comprise inoculating the filamentous fungus and a plant milk with mesophilic bacteria culture at 37°C or more. Preferably, the fermentation process takes place at 38°C or less and may produce a mixture with pH 4.5 or lower. The use of such a mesophilic bacteria starter culture results in a reduction in off taste of the yoghurt.

title: A METHOD OF PRODUCING SINGLE CELL PROTEIN FROM WHEY
abstract: The present invention is generally concerned with the field of microbial fermentation of dairy or dairy alterative industry waste material and microbial protein production such as single cell protein (SCP). In particular the present invention is directed to microbial fermentation of dairy derived or dairy alternative derived whey for production of single cell proteins (SCP) or microbial biomass. More in particular, the present invention relates to a method of producing a single cell protein or biomass, comprising propagating a microbial culture in a large scale setting under suitable conditions and growth medium comprising dairy-derived whey to produce a single cell protein, where the microbial culture comprises microalgae, yeast and bacterial species (Figure 1). The present invention also relates to method of identifying a strain of microorganism, or mixture of strains of microorganisms, capable of efficiently using dairy-derived whey waste as a food source to produce biomass as a source of single cell protein. The present invention also relates to a propagated microbial culture or a composition and use of the culture in microbial fermentation. The present invention further provides a product or supplement comprising the composition of the present invention.

title: A method of producing single cell protein from whey
abstract: A method of producing single cell protein SCP or biomass comprises culturing microbial inoculum in a growth medium comprising dairy-derived whey. The method may comprise (i) inoculating growth medium comprising dairy-derived whey with a microbial inoculum to form an inoculated microbial mixture, (ii) incubating the inoculated microbial mixture at a first incubation temperature to generate a propagated starter culture, (iii) adding the starter culture to a growth medium comprising dairy-derived whey to form a fermentation mixture and incubating the fermentation mixture, and (iv) treating the fermentation mixture to produce a SCP. The fermentation mixture may be incubated at a second incubation temperature for at least 24 hrs. At least one of the strains in the microbial inoculum may be a microalga, a yeast, a fungi or a bacteria. The propagated starter culture preferably comprises a mixture of at least two strains of microalgae, at least two strains of fungi, at least two strains of yeast, and at least two strains of bacteria. A product or supplement comprising the biomass, a propagated microbial culture and use of the culture in microbial fermentation, and a method of identifying microorganisms capable of efficiently producing biomass using dairy-derived whey are also claimed.

Claim 32: An ingredient or composition of vegetable origin according to any of claims 1 to 22, or an alternative consumer product of any of claims 24 to 26, from a pea of a Pisum sativum plant, wherein a representative sample of seeds of said plant is deposited with NCIMB Ltd., with accession number NCIMB 44382, wherein the ingredient of vegetable origin provides an improved flavor profile compared to a vegetable ingredient of vegetable origin from a pea of a control or reference Pisum sativum plant.

title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR DIAGNOSING AND/OR TREATING CHRONIC KIDNEY DISEASE
abstract: Compositions and methods diagnose and/or treat chronic kidney disease (CKD) using one or more feline circulating proteins as markers for early-stage CKD. A method of diagnosing chronic kidney disease (CKD) in a feline can include measuring an amount of each of at least one circulating protein from the feline. The at least one circulating protein is one or more of adiponectin (ADIPOQ), cathelicidin (CAMP), kinesin-like protein (KIF12), plasma retinol-binding protein (RBP4), Ig-like domain-containing protein (ZKSCAN1), coagulation factor X (F10), fibronectin (FN1) and mixtures thereof. The method also includes performing comparison of the amount of each of the at least one circulating protein from the feline to a corresponding predetermined value or a corresponding predetermined range. The method also includes diagnosing the feline as having early-stage CKD or not having early-stage CKD, based on the comparison.

title: PLANT-BASED MICROFIBROUS SCAFFOLDS FOR CULTURING MEAT
abstract: The present disclosure relates to plant-based microfibrous scaffolds and a method for producing these scaffolds for culturing meat, providing a biocompatible, edible, and scalable 3D structure that supports high cell yield. The scaffold comprises plant-based proteins, polysaccharides, and carbohydrates, eliminating the need for synthetic polymers and toxic solvents. The method for producing these scaffolds comprises dissolving the components, creating a homogeneous solution, spinning the fibers using air volume and centrifugal forces, and heating to achieve crosslinking. The resulting scaffolds have controlled fiber diameters, thicknesses, and area densities, enhancing cell growth, nutrient diffusion, and structural integrity and provide an efficient and sustainable solution for large-scale cultured meat production.

title: TEMPERATURE-GELLING PEA PROTEINS
abstract: The invention relates to a functionalized pea protein having a gelling power, according to a TEST A, of at least 300 Pa, preferably in the range of 500 to 2000 Pa, most preferably in the range of 600 to 1800 Pa, and a determined viscosity of less than 0.65 Pa.s, the viscosity being measured at 15% by weight of dry matter, at a shear rate of 40s-1 and a temperature of 20°C, a method for obtaining such a protein, and the use thereof in food products or beverages.

title: Temperature-gelling pea protein

abstract: A blank forming a double-walled box, comprising: a rectangular inner bottom panel a first and a second inner end wall panel foldably connected to a respective one of two opposing transversally extending sides of the inner bottom panel, a first and a second inner side wall panel foldably connected to a respective one of two opposing longitudinally extending sides of the inner bottom panel, a rectangular outer bottom panel which is larger in size than said inner bottom panel (100), a first and a second outer end wall panel foldably connected to a respective one of two opposing transversally extending sides of the outer bottom panel, a first outer side wall panel comprising two opposing longitudinally extending sides, of which a first side is foldably connected to said first inner side wall panel and a second side is foldably connected to said outer bottom panel, a second outer side wall panel foldably connected to a longitudinally extending side of said second inner side wall panel, wherein the inner bottom panel, the first and second inner side wall panels and the first and second inner end wall panels define a box interior when formed into a box, and wherein the outer bottom panel, the first and second outer side wall panels, and the first and second outer end wall panels are configured to form an outer layer of said box when formed into a box, such that each side of the box comprises double walls. abstract: Disclosed herein is an ingredient composition in dry form encapsulated with a fat coating comprising from 20% to 85% by weight of saturated fatty acid residues; from 10% to 50% by weight of stearic acid residues (C18:0); and from 2% to 35% by weight of lauric acid residues (C12:0); wherein said percentages of fatty acid residues refers to fatty acids bound as acyl 5 groups in glycerides in the fat coating and being based on the total weight of C4 to C24 fatty acid residues bound as acyl groups present in the fat composition; wherein the fat coating has a specific solid fat content (SFC); and wherein the weight ratio of the fat coating with respect to the ingredient composition is of from 5,0:1,0 to 15,0:1,0.

abstract: Disclosed herein is a meat analogue composition comprising from 2.0% to 40.0% by weight of a fat composition; from 5.0% to 35.0% by weight of a non-animal protein; from 20.0% to 75.0% by weight of water; and from 0.1% to 5% by weight of one or more acidic ingredients, wherein the acidic ingredients are encapsulated.

title: GROWTH FACTOR-FREE STEM CELL EXPANSION AND DIFFERENTIATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a modified stem cell and an ex vivo method for preparing defined mature cells from genetic programming of said modified stem cell which can be carried out in absence of certain growth factors, as well as a kit allowing to transform stem cells, and the different uses of the mature cells, for example for in vitro drug screening and toxicology or as cultivated meat. The genetic programming involves a molecular switch between two mutually exclusive programs of stem cell expansion and differentiation. The invention may be used for stem cells or other progenitors cells of any type, from any eukaryotic organism, but finds particular application in pluripotent stem cells from humans and livestock animals.

title: CELL DIFFERENTIATION THROUGH MULTIMODAL TUNING OF GENE EXPRESSION
abstract: The present invention relates a kit for manipulating gene expression in a stem cell in an inducible way, regulating multiple genes simultaneously and in a multimodal manner (e.g., activation and inhibition), and in a manner compatible with the identification of new targets via single cell genomics. Moreover, the present invention relates to an isolated stem cell with a modified genome, and its uses for in vitro screening and discovery, tissue engineering, cultivated meat, and in therapy, as well as an ex vivo method for simultaneously activating and inhibiting one or more endogenous genes in a stem cell, for example in order to differentiate a pluripotent stem cell to a defined mature cell.

title: Plant drink and method of producing the plant drink
abstract: The subject of the application is a plant drink containing water, a source of protein and fat, including peas and a stabilizer, which is characterized in that it is a mixture of 90% by weight of water and 10% by weight of powdered peas, beans, sunflower seeds, sunflower oil and a polysaccharide stabilizer, in which the carbohydrate content is 2.9 to 3.38 g/100 ml, the protein content is 2.05 to 2.32 g/100 ml, the fat content is from 3.12 to 3.35 g/100 ml and is obtained by the method specified below. The application also covers a method for producing a plant drink, according to the invention, containing water, a source of protein and fat, including peas and a stabilizer, consisting in homogenization using cutting knives, filtering through a sieve, adding a stabilizer, characterized in that pea, bean and sunflower seeds dried and ground to obtain a size in the range of 100 - 500 micrometers in a weight proportion of 1.7:1.8:5.8 to 2.1:2.2:6.2 are combined with 0.1 to 3.2% by weight of sunflower oil and 85 to 95% by weight of water and homogenized using cutting knives at a speed of 5000 to 25000 rpm for a time of 1 to 3 minutes. The suspension is then filtered through a 0.5 mm sieve, and 0.5 to 1.0% of the stabilizer is added to the resulting filtrate. The mixture is homogenized using a knife homogenizer at 8,000 to 9,000 rpm, then pasteurized and re-homogenized using a knife homogenizer at 8,000 to 9,000 rpm.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR THE PRODUCTION OF FRESH ALMOND MILK
abstract: The invention concerns a device 20 for the production of fresh almond milk. The device comprises actuation means 24 and an extraction group 22 with a first constraint element 26 and a second constraint element 28. In the standby configuration, the two constraint elements are placed at a distance d the one from the other. The actuation means are configured for imposing between the two constraint elements at least a first relative translation movement and a second relative rotation movement. The invention then concerns an extraction bag 34 comprising a textile envelope 42 defining two constraint portions 48 arranged at a distance d the one form the other, and a central pocket 46 containing a preparation 44 based on unpeeled and ground almond seeds. The invention further concerns a kit 52, comprising the device and the extraction bag, as well as a method for the production of fresh almond milk by means of the kit.

title: AN AQUEOUS LEGUME SUSPENSION FOR A LEGUME-BASED FOOD PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to an aqueous legume suspension comprising alkali-soaked and disrupted legume fruits at a legume protein content of at least 40 g/L, a vegetable oil content in the range of 50 g/L to 350 g/L, and a pH in the range of 5 to 5.5. The present invention also relates to a method of producing the aqueous legume suspension. The aqueous legume suspension is useful as a starting material for manufacturing a legume-based food product, and the invention also relates to a process for the manufacture of a legume-based food product. In the process, the aqueous legume suspension is treated with a coagulating enzyme to coagulate legume protein and provide a coagulated legume protein suspension from which liquid is removed to provide the legume-based food product. The aqueous legume suspension and a coagulating enzyme is included in a kit of parts.

title: Method of improving the maturity of low-quality marinated herring meat using digestive proteases
abstract: The subject of the application is a method for improving the meat maturity of marinated herring of low technological quality (caught during the feeding season) using digestive proteases, which is characterized in that prior to marinating, fresh or frozen-thawed herring fillets of low technological quality are stored for 4 to 5 days in a raw digestive protease preparation (SPPT) and/or injected with a raw digestive protease preparation (SPPT). Storage is carried out under refrigerated conditions (preferably at a temperature of 0°C -2°C) for 1 to 24 hours (preferably no more than 4 - 8 hours), in a herring fillet to raw digestive protease preparation (SPPT) ratio of 2:1 to 1:2 (weight:weight). During injection, from 0.1% to 10% of the raw digestive protease preparation (SPPT) is used relative to the weight of the herring fillets. For storage and/or injection, a crude preparation of digestive proteases (SPPT) is used, obtained as described in Polish patent application No. P.443190. The SPPT production method involves mixing ground fish digestive tract with a 1%-10% aqueous ethanol solution in a 1:1-10 (weight:volume) ratio, homogenizing the mixture, and then separating the precipitate. Before adding the aqueous ethanol solution or after separating the precipitate after homogenization, NaCl is added to achieve a final concentration of at least 3%, mixing, and then separating the precipitate to obtain a crude preparation of digestive proteases from fish after both steps.

title: Method of improving the maturity of low-quality marinated herring meat using digestive proteases
abstract: The subject of the application is a method of improving the maturity of meat of marinated herring of low technological quality (caught during the feeding season) using digestive proteases, which is characterized in that before marinating for 4 to 5 days, fresh or frozen-thawed fillets of low technological quality are stored in a raw preparation of digestive proteases (SPPT) and/or injected with a raw preparation of digestive proteases (SPPT). Storage is carried out in refrigerated conditions (preferably at a temperature of 0°C -2°C) from 1 to 24 hours (preferably no more than 4 - 8 hours), in a ratio of herring fillets to raw preparation of digestive proteases (SPPT) from 2:1 to 1:2 (mass:mass). During injection, from 0.1% to 10% of raw preparation of digestive proteases (SPPT) is used in relation to the weight of herring fillets. In storage and/or injection, a crude preparation of digestive proteases (SPPT) obtained in a manner known from Polish patent application no. P.443190 is used. The method of producing SPPT consists in mixing the crushed digestive tracts of fish with 1% - 10% aqueous solution of ethanol in a proportion of 1:1-10 (mass:volume), homogenizing the mixture and then separating the sediment. Before adding the aqueous solution of ethanol or after separating the sediment after homogenization, NaCl is added to obtain its final concentration of at least 3%, mixing and then separating the sediment in order to obtain a crude preparation of digestive proteases from fish after both stages.

title: VEGAN CHEESE COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF MAKING THE SAME
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to non-animal proteins and their use in various comestible products, particularly cheese analogue products. In some embodiments, the disclosure provides an ingestible composition comprising pea protein, soy protein, or a combination thereof, along with a minor amount of an additional protein, such fava bean protein, mung bean protein, lentil protein, sunflower protein, canola protein, potato protein, rice protein, or combinations thereof. In some embodiments, the ingestible compositions also comprise certain fibers, which allows the blend to be suitable for addition to an ingestible composition useful for making products having the consistency of cheese. In some embodiments, flavorings or flavor-modifiers are combined with the non-animal proteins as well. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides methods of making such vegan cheese products, for example, by extrusion, molding, and the like.

title: CASCADE SYSTEM FOR THE FERMENTATION OF BIOMASS
abstract: The present invention relates to a cascade system for the fermentation of biomass, comprising a first pre-culture vessel, an optional second pre-culture vessel and a main-culture vessel, which are connected or can be connected to one another in this sequence by way of controllable valve couplings such that the content of one vessel can be transferred partially or completely into the next vessel, each vessel having an agitating, dispersing and/or cutting device, an inlet for the supply of nutrient medium, a pressure-equalizing valve and an inlet for compressed gas. The present invention also relates to a method for the fermentation of biomass, comprising (a) the provision of a starter culture, (b) the contamination-free transfer of the starter culture into a first pre-culture vessel, (c) the fermentation of biomass in the first pre-culture vessel, initiated by the starter culture, to obtain a first pre-culture, (d) the partial or complete transfer of the first pre-culture from the first pre-culture vessel into a main-culture vessel and (e) the fermentation of further biomass in the main-culture vessel to obtain a fermented biomass.

title: Cascade system for biomass fermentation
abstract: The present invention relates to a cascade system for the fermentation of biomass, comprising a first pre-culture container, an optional second pre-culture container and a main culture container, which are connected or connectable to one another in this order via controllable valve couplings in such a way that the contents of one container can be partially or completely transferred to the next container, wherein each container has a stirring, dispersing and/or cutting device, an inlet for supplying nutrient medium, a pressure equalization valve and an inlet for compressed gas. The present invention further relates to a method for fermenting biomass, comprising (a) providing a starter culture, (b) transferring the starter culture in a contamination-free manner into a first pre-culture container, (c) fermenting biomass in the first pre-culture container, which is initiated by the starter culture, in order to obtain a first pre-culture, (d) partially or completely transferring the first pre-culture from the first pre-culture container into a main culture container and (e) fermenting further biomass in the main culture container in order to obtain a fermented biomass.

title: METHOD FOR GENERATING IN PARTICULAR MILK FOAM, AND ALSO A DEVICE FOR IMPLEMENTING THE METHOD
abstract: In a method for generating in particular milk foam, superheated steam is supplied along with air, and with a controllable quantitative output, to a milk-containing receptacle (12) by a steam device, which dips into the milk (13) in the receptacle (12). During the heating-up stage, the temperature of the milk is measured and evaluated by at least one temperature probe (18) within the receptacle (12). When the stage of heating up the milk (13) contained in the receptacle (12) begins, steam is supplied with a predetermined quantitative output, and the supply of air is switched on. Once steam supply has begun, a difference in temperature (ΔT) of the measured milk temperatures (T1, T2) between a predetermined first and second defined point in time (t1, t2) is established for these points in time. On the basis of the difference in temperature (ΔT), at least the superheated steam is supplied either with the same quantitative output or with an altered quantitative output, and is switched off before or when the final temperature (T3) of the milk (13) is reached.

title: Method for producing, in particular, milk foam, and a device for carrying out the method
abstract: In a method for producing, in particular, milk foam in a container (12) containing the milk, hot steam is supplied at a controllable rate and with air through a steam device immersed in the milk (13) in the container (12). The milk temperature is measured and evaluated during heating by at least one temperature probe (18) within the container (12). When heating of the milk (13) filled in the container (12) begins, steam is supplied at a predetermined rate, and the air supply is switched on. After the steam supply has started, a temperature difference between the measured milk temperatures at a predetermined first and a second fixed time is determined. Based on the temperature difference, at least the hot steam is supplied either at the same or at a modified rate and is switched off before or when the final temperature of the milk (13) is reached.

title: METHOD OF REDUCING PHYTIC ACID FROM PLANT MATERIAL THROUGH FERMENTATION
abstract: A method for reducing the amount of phytic acid content in a plant material, a plant-derived ingredient for consumables having low or zero phytic acid content, and consumables comprising the ingredient. The plant-derived ingredient may be used to prepare plant-based consumables including plant-based foods and beverages. Methods for preparing consumables comprising the plant-derived ingredient having low phytic acid content are also disclosed. Methods and uses of the ingredient for taste modification in plant-based consumables, improving the mouthfeel properties of plant-based consumables containing the ingredient, and for conferring a health benefit to a subject with the plant-based consumables comprising the ingredient having low or zero phytic acid content.

title: LIQUID ANTIMICROBIAL COMPOSITION
LIQUID ANTIMICROBIAL COMPOSITION
abstract: A liquid antimicrobial composition is disclosed, comprising: (a) bacteriocin in a concentration of 2-50 ppm; (b) acetate in a concentration of 0.4-4 mol/L; (c) alkali metal cation in a concentration of at least 0.7 mol per mol of acetate; and at least 70 wt. % of water, wherein the antimicrobial composition has a pH in the range of 4.5-7.5. The antimicrobial composition is particularly suitable for reducing the bacterial load of Listeria on pieces of raw meat. The application also discloses methods of treating pieces of animal meat, the method comprising applying the antimicrobial composition of the present invention onto the surface of the pieces of animal meat.

title: FLAVANONE COMPOUNDS AND THEIR USE AS FLAVOR MODIFIERS
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to certain flavanone compounds and the use of such compounds to modify the flavor or taste of an ingestible composition. These flavanone compounds include 8-methylnaringenin (5,7,4'-trihydroxy-8-methylflavanone), 5,3'-dihydroxy-7,4'-dimethoxyflavanone, 5-hydroxy-7,3',4'-trimethoxyflavanone, 5,4'-dihydroxy-7,3'-dimethoxyflavanone, or any combinations thereof. In some embodiments, the use of these flavanone compounds includes their use to enhance a sweet taste, their use to reduce an off taste of a high-intensity sweetener, their use to enhance a salty taste, their use to enhance an umami or kokumi taste, or any combination thereof. In certain embodiments, such compounds are used in combination with other natural taste modifiers, such as flavonoids or dihydrochalcones. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides ingestible compositions that include such flavanone compounds. In some related aspects, the ingestible compositions are, or are included within, various flavored products, such as food products, beverage products, pharmaceutical products, oral care products, or animal feed products.
