The concentrate also has a high water binding capacity and is useful in a variety of food and drink products. An extrusion process for producing the legume protein concentrate is also provided.

title: Legume protein concentrates
abstract: A legume protein concentrate having a protein content of about 40-70%, preferably 50-60%. The concentrate exhibits trypsin inhibitor activity (TIA) at up to about 2mg/g and has a water binding capacity of at least about 2.0g/g. Preferably, the protein concentrate is obtained from fava beans, peas, lentils, or chickpeas. Preferably, the protein concentrate is not chemically or enzymatically modified. Preferably, the protein concentrate has a reduced off-flavour and low amounts of antinutritional factors. Preferably, the protein concentrate comprises <7mg/kg vicine and/or <5mg/kg convicine. The concentrate also has a high water-binding capacity and is preferably useful in a variety of food and drink products. An extrusion process for producing the legume protein concentrate is also provided where the material does not exceed ~115°C during extrusion and preferably includes the addition of water in an amount of from 0.05 to 0.2 L/kg.

title: RNA CONSTRUCTS WITH IMMUNE BLOCKING AGENTS
abstract: The invention relates to RNA constructs encoding a sequence of interest and a novel innate immune blocking agent. The innate immune blocking agents described herein enhance the expression of the sequence of interest by the cell and find utility in methods for the preparation of edible meat products and methods of cell culture.

title: PERFUSION CELL CULTURE APPARATUS
abstract: There is described a perfusion cell culture apparatus comprising a bioreactor, a spent-media separation member; and a pressure source. The bioreactor, separation member and pressure source are fluidly connected so that the pressure source is operable to actuate movement of a cell suspension into contact with the separation member from the bioreactor by effecting a change in air flow. The separation member is operable to retain cells and separate spent- media from the cell suspension. The pressure source is also operable to actuate return of the cell suspension from contact with the separation member to contact with the bioreactor by effecting a change in air flow. Also described is a method of cell culture perfusion using the perfusion cell culture apparatus and a kit of parts comprising the spent-media separation member and pressure source.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR RECYCLING AND LIBERATING MATERIAL
abstract: A versatile waste processing system that converts various waste materials into valuable products, such as syngas, oils, char, proteins, and glass fibres. The system includes advanced components for material separation, thermal treatment, and by-product recovery. It features reactors, gas cleaning units, separation systems, and handling lines for solids, along with cracking units for refining heavier hydrocarbons and reforming technologies to enhance hydrogen production. Additionally, it supports processes like protein extraction and glass fibre recovery, offering flexible configurations to handle a wide range of waste types while maximizing energy and material recovery in various industrial applications.

title: METHOD FOR GENERATING A SOYA PROTEIN TEXTURATE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing an anisotropic plant-based soya texturate, the texturate comprising a water proportion of less than 50 wt.% and more than 50 wt.% soya-based ingredients based on the dry mass, wherein a protein proportion comprises more than 30 wt.% based on the dry mass. In the method, a soya protein mixture with more than 50% of the dry mass is provided and from this a basic mixture is generated such that a water proportion of the basic mixture is in the range from 25 wt.% to 55 wt.%. The basic mixture is extruded. Then, a first axial and/or transversal stretch is exerted on the extrudate, in particular in a channel with a changing cross section, to generate a texturate. Finally, the texturate can be rolled or cut.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A SOY PROTEIN TEXTURATE
abstract: The invention relates to a process for producing an anisotropic vegetable soy texturate, the texturate comprising a water content of less than 50% by weight and more than 50% by weight of soy-based ingredients based on the dry matter, wherein a protein content of more than 30% by weight based on the dry matter is provided. In the process, a soy protein mixture with more than 50% by dry matter is provided and a base mixture is produced therefrom, such that a water content of the base mixture is in the range of 25% by weight to 55% by weight. The base mixture is extruded. Thereafter, a first axial and/or transverse stretching is exerted on the extrudate, in particular in a channel with a changing cross-section, to produce a texturate. Finally, the texturate can be rolled or cut.

title: NOVEL GABA-RICH MASKING PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural extract, preferably a yeast extract, which is rich in gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), to a product comprising such an extract and to the use thereof for masking flavours, in particular bitter and acid flavours, undesirable notes, in particular of sweeteners or proteins, and metallic notes, or trigeminal sensations such as astringency, in a product, advantageously a food, pharmaceutical or nutraceutical product, or an aromatic preparation.

title: NEW GABA-RICH MASK PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a natural extract, preferably extracted from yeast, rich in gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA), a product comprising such an extract and their use for masking flavors, especially bitter and sour, undesirable notes, especially sweeteners, proteins and metallic notes, or trigeminal sensations such as astringency, in a product, advantageously a food, pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, or flavoring preparation.

title: FOOD COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS OF PROCESSING FOOD COMPOSITIONS
abstract: The invention relates to a method for processing a food composition, which comprises providing a preferably vegan mixture comprising one or more proteins selected from vegetable proteins, microbial proteins, fungal proteins, recombinant proteins and combinations thereof, and forcing the mixture through a processing device penetrated by a plurality of openings from a retentate side towards a permeate side, wherein the mixture is forced through the processing device by means of a wiping device moved along a retentate-side boundary surface of the processing device. The invention further relates to food compositions and to the use of a device having a processing device permeable to a food composition from a retentate side towards a permeate side, characterized by a pushing device movable along the retentate side and thereby forcing the food composition towards the permeate side, wherein the processing device has a preferably rigid body penetrated by a plurality of openings of predetermined size and geometry, for processing a vegan food composition.

title: MUSCLE STEM CELL CULTURE
abstract: The present disclosure provides methods for culturing primary muscle stem cells, promoting self-renewal of primary muscle stem cells in cell culture, inhibiting the differentiation of primary muscle stem cells and increasing the clonogenicity of primary muscle stem cells, comprising culturing primary muscle stem cells in the presence of an inhibitor of mitochondrial maturation. Also provided are methods for promoting the differentiation of primary muscle stem cells, comprising culturing primary muscle stem cells in the presence of an promoter of mitochondrial maturation. The present disclosure also provides the use of inhibitors of mitochondrial maturation and promoters of mitochondrial maturation in such methods, and kits comprising the same.

title: AN INTEGRATED SYSTEM FOR THE AUTOMATED PASSAGING OF ANCHORAGE DEPENDENT CELL CULTURES
abstract: Disclosed is a system for automating passaging of anchorage dependent or adherent mammalian cells, having a fluid distribution cartridge where fluid channels each has an associated pneumatically controlled valve, and the valves can be selectively opened and closed to allow fluid which is pumped into channels in the cartridge to be selectively passed or interrupted. The channels are connected with a series of vessels each held in a housing structure, and a first frame rests on a surface and a second frame is attached with the first frame such that the second frame can tilt on a first axis with respect to the first frame, and the housing is attached to the second frame such that the housing can tilt on a second axis with respect to the second frame, and wherein the second axis is orthogonal to the first axis. A digital system that controls selective opening and closing of the valves by controlling the pressurized air provided to the valves, and also controls the movement of the frames and housing under feedback from the leveling system.

title: STABILIZED READY-TO-DRINK COFFEE BEVERAGES
abstract: The present invention relates to the use of a protein deamidase and an enzyme having mannanase activity for obtaining a ready-to-drink coffee beverage with reduced turbidity and/or gelation.

abstract: Described herein are novel methods for increasing the fat content of a cell or population of cells in culture. title: WET PET FOOD SYSTEMS

title: CELLULOSE AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to methods of producing bacterial cellulose from brewery waste sediment products (trub), and the use of bacterial cellulose as a cell culture scaffold, suitable to produce cultivated meat products comprising composites of cultured cells adhered to bacterial cellulose.

title: Fermented protein extract from milk thistle - Sylibum marianum and method of obtaining it
abstract: The subject of the invention is a fermented protein extract from milk thistle - Sylibum marianum for use in the food industry. Fermented protein extract from milk thistle - Sylibum marianum contains from 3.87 to 8.19 g dry matter/100 mL of extract; from 0.77 to 2.3 g protein/100 mL of extract; from 0.63 to 1.12 g digestible carbohydrates/100 mL of extract; from 0.65 to 0.89 g total sugars/100 ml of extract; from 1.19 to 3.32 g total fat/100 mL of extract and from 0.03% to 0.06% salt. The application also includes a method for obtaining a fermented protein extract from milk thistle - Sylibum marianum, which is characterized in that the raw material in the form of milk thistle is ground at a rotational speed of not less than 4400 rpm for 30 - 40 s, then water at a temperature of 4°C - 20°C is added to the ground raw material while maintaining the mass fraction of the raw material to water between 1:5 and 1:15, the whole is mixed intensively for 15 - 20 s at a rotational speed of min. 4400 rpm, in the next stage, anhydrous sodium carbonate is added to the mixture of water and crushed raw material in such an amount that the pH of the extraction mixture is in the range of 7.8 - 8.2 at a temperature of 37°C - 40°C and the milk thistle protein extraction process is carried out, after which the mixture is centrifuged at 3500 - 4500 rpm for 5 - 10 min, beet syrup is added to the centrifuged milk thistle (supernatant) in the amount of 20 - 30 g of syrup/1 L of centrifuged extract, and then the milk is pasteurized or sterilized, in the final stage, freeze-dried strains of lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and/or probiotic bacteria are added in the amount of 0.1 g of lyophilisate/1 L of milk, and then the incubation is carried out at the optimal temperature for the growth of the lactic acid bacteria used in the process lactic acid, wherein the fermentation process is carried out until the pH of the fermented milk thistle is in the range of 4.50 - 4.70, obtaining the final product in the form of a fermented protein extract from milk thistle - Sylibum marianum.

abstract: The present invention relates to an oat base with improved health-beneficial properties. title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR DIAGNOSING AND TREATING CARDIOMYOPATHY IN A FELINE
abstract: The present invention relates to methods and compositions for diagnosing and enabling treatment of cardiomyopathy (CM) in a feline. title: Method of producing a fermented plant drink based on walnut and fermented plant drink based on walnut

A dry pet food composition can comprise about 0.01 wt% to about 2 wt% of pentaphosphate, where the pentaphosphate is incorporated into at least one of a basal body of the dry pet food composition or a coating applied to the the dry pet food composition.

title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR INCREASING THE PALATABILITY OF DRY PET FOOD
abstract: Compositions and methods are provided to increase the palatability of dry pet foods. A dry pet food composition can comprise about 0.01 wt % to about 2 wt % of pentaphosphate, where the pentaphosphate is incorporated into at least one of a basal body of the dry pet food composition or a coating applied to the the dry pet food composition.

title: FLAVOR MODULATING COMPOSITIONS
abstract: A flavor modulating composition for improving the organoleptic properties of non-animal protein containing consumables, such as dairy analogues, is provided.

title: MILK MODULE WITH OPTIMIZED HEAT TRANSFER, OPERATION OF A MILK MODULE WITH OPTIMIZED HEAT TRANSFER, AND BEVERAGE PREPARATION DEVICE WITH OPTIMIZED MILK MODULE
abstract: The invention relates to a milk module for beverage preparation devices, in particular coffee and/or espresso machines, for heating milk with a milk pump (04) for conveying a volume flow from an inlet (02) to an outlet (03) of the milk module (01). According to the invention, the milk pump (04) is designed solely to generate the volume flow, wherein a swirl chamber (09) is provided in addition to the milk pump (04), wherein the inlet (02) is fluidically connected to an inlet opening (11) of the swirl chamber (09) and the outlet (03) is fluidically connected to an outlet opening (12) of the swirl chamber (09), and a supply line (20) opens into the swirl chamber (09), with which supply line a heat transfer fluid can be introduced into the swirl chamber (09), so that the volume flow flowing through the swirl chamber (09) is swirled by the heat transfer fluid and is thereby heated.

title: Milk module with optimized heat transfer, operation of a milk module with optimized heat transfer and beverage preparation device with optimized milk module
abstract: The invention relates to a milk module for beverage preparation devices, in particular coffee and/or espresso machines, for heating milk with a milk pump (04) for conveying a volume flow from an inlet (02) to an outlet (03) of the milk module (01). According to the invention, the milk pump (04) is designed solely to generate the volume flow, wherein a swirl chamber (09) is provided in addition to the milk pump (04), wherein the inlet (02) is fluidically connected to an inlet opening (11) of the swirl chamber (09) and the outlet (03) is fluidically connected to an outlet opening (12) of the swirl chamber (09), and a supply line (20) opens into the swirl chamber (09), with which supply line a heat transfer fluid can be introduced into the swirl chamber (09), such that the volume flow flowing through the swirl chamber (09) is swirled by the heat transfer fluid and is thereby heated.

title: A HORIZONTAL PLATE FREEZER
abstract: The invention concern a horizontal plate freezer comprising a plurality of freezing plates separated from each other to create a number of freezing compartments in-between each adjacent pair of freezing plates to receive a plurality of commodity holders, such as trays, said commodity holders comprising commodities to be frozen or which commodities are frozen, wherein the horizontal plate freezer further comprises: at least one first actuating arrangement configured for loading commodity holders into the freezing compartments and/or for emptying commodity holders from the freezing compartments; and at least one second actuating arrangement comprising one or more actuators, said second actuating arrangement being configured for impacting and thereby loosening all the commodity holders present in one freezing compartment before the at least one first actuating arrangement is activated for emptying commodity holders from said freezing compartment. The invention also concerns a method of emptying a plurality of frozen solid commodity holders, such as trays comprising frozen commodities from a horizontal plate freezer.

title: ORGANIC COMPOUNDS
abstract: There is provided a group of compounds of formula (I), in the form of any one of its stereoisomers or mixture thereof (I) or of formula (II) in the form of any one of its stereoisomers or mixture thereof (II) providing green galbanum odor and flavor notes.

title: ORGANIC COMPOUNDS
abstract: There is provided a group of compounds of formula (I), in the form of any one of its stereoisomers or mixture thereof wherein R1 and R4 are independently selected from H and Me; R2 and R3 are independently selected from H, iPr, isopropenyl, cyclopropyl and vinyl; n is 0 or 1; X is selected from -O-and -CH2-; and the dotted line together with the carbon-carbon bond forms a single bond or a double bond in the ring system; and the ring system has no double bonds, one double bond or two double bonds, or is an aromatic ring system; or of formula (II) in the form of any one of its stereoisomers or mixture thereof wherein R1 is H or Me; R5 is cyclopent-2-en-1-yl or but-2-en-1-yl; n is 0 or 1; X is selected from -O-and -CH2-; and the dotted line together with the carbon-carbon bond forms a single bond or a double bond, providing green galbanum odor and flavor notes.

title: IMMUNOTHERAPY FOR TREATMENT OF ALLERGY
abstract: This invention relates to methods of immunotherapy comprising administering allergen, such as peanut protein, to an individual in need thereof at regular time intervals. The dose of allergen increases incrementally by 1 to 10% at each administration from an initial dose to a maintenance dose. The maintenance dose of the allergen is then administered at regular time intervals. Also provided are compositions and dosing devices for use in such methods.

title: COLORING COMPOSITION, METHOD OF MAKING, AND CONSUMABLE
abstract: Coloring compositions comprising one or more pelargonidins selected from pelargonidin 3-glucoside, pelargonidin 3-(6''-malonylglucoside) and pelargonidin 3,5-dimalonylglucoside, and at least one red anthocyanin. Consumables, such as foods and beverages, that include the coloring compositions, methods of making the coloring compositions and consumables, and uses of the coloring compositions are also provided.

title: FAST-ACIDIFYING STREPTOCOCCUS THERMOPHILUS STRAINS IN SOY
abstract: The present invention relates to strains of Streptococcus thermophilus in which the cell-envelope proteinase (PrtS) or a homologue thereof is functionally inactive or absent, the use of these PrtS-negative strains for the fermentation of preparations derived from a plant, in particular fermented food or feed products based on a plant, as well as methods for the preparation of fermented products based on plants.

title: SULFONAMIDE DERIVATIVES AND USE THEREOF IN THE TREATMENT OF CRYPTOSPORIDIUM INFECTIONS
abstract: The invention relates to compounds of formula (I), and pharmaceutically acceptable salts thereof, which are highly potent inhibitors of parasitic infections. The invention also relates to pharmaceutical compositions comprising these compounds, and to the use of these compounds in the treatment or prevention of microbial infections and diseases in animal and in human, such as infections and diseases caused by apicomplexan parasites (e.g., Cryptosporidium infections) or other microbes.

title: MODULAR PERISHABLE FOOD TRANSPORTATION BOX, METHOD OF ERECTING BOX AND METHOD OF THERMALLY INSULATING A FOOD ITEM
abstract: According to a first aspect of the invention, there is provided a modular reusable box for transporting perishable food items comprising: a first cover member; and at least one side wall, wherein at least one of the first cover member and side wall is configured to rotatably engage the other and restrict movement of the first cover member in at least one direction relative to the side wall; and the box is moveable between: a first configuration wherein the first cover member and side wall are rotatably engaged such that movement of the first cover member in at least one direction relative to the side wall is restricted; and a second configuration wherein the first cover member and side wall are separate. According to a second aspect of the invention, there is provided an alternative modular reusable box for transporting perishable food items. According to a third aspect of the invention, there is provided a method of erecting a modular reusable box comprising the steps of: providing the modular reusable box according to the first or second aspects of the invention; and reversibly coupling the first cover member and the side wall to one another. According to a fourth aspect of the invention, there is provided a method of thermally insulating a perishable food item, comprising the steps of: providing a modular reusable box according to the first or second aspects of the invention; providing a perishable food item; erecting the modular reusable box; and placing the perishable food item in the modular reusable box.

title: PROTEIN RICH COMPOSITION, METHOD FOR PRODUCING PROTEIN RICH COMPOSITION AND FOODSTUFF
abstract: The present invention relates to a protein rich composition derived from oat comprising more than 57% of proteins by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a foodstuff, comprising a protein rich composition derived from oat, and the protein rich composition comprises more than 57% of protein by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a method for producing a protein rich composition, the method comprises providing an oat slurry comprising proteins and isolating a protein rich composition from the oat slurry.

title: PROTEIN RICH COMPOSITION, METHOD FOR PRODUCING PROTEIN RICH COMPOSITION AND FOODSTUFF
abstract: The present invention relates to a high protein composition derived from oats and containing more than 57% protein by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a food product comprising a high protein composition derived from oats, the protein-rich composition comprising more than 57% protein by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a method for preparing a high protein composition, the method comprising obtaining a protein-containing oat mass and separating the protein-rich composition from the oat mass.

title: FIBRE RICH COMPOSITION, METHOD FOR PRODUCING FIBRE RICH COMPOSITION AND FOODSTUFF
abstract: The present invention relates to a fibre rich composition derived from oat, the composition comprising dietary fibres in an amount of at least 35 % and carbohydrates in an amount of up to 6 % by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a foodstuff, comprising a fibre rich composition derived from oat, and the fibre rich composition comprises dietary fibres in an amount of at least 35 % and carbohydrates in an amount up to 6 % by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a method for producing a fibre rich composition, the method comprising providing an oat slurry comprising dietary fibres and isolating a fibre rich composition from the oat slurry.

title: FIBRE RICH COMPOSITION, METHOD FOR PRODUCING FIBRE RICH COMPOSITION AND FOODSTUFF
abstract: The present invention relates to a fiber-rich composition derived from oats, comprising at least 35% dietary fiber and up to 6% carbohydrates by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a food product comprising a fiber-rich composition derived from oats, and the fiber-rich composition comprises at least 35% dietary fiber and up to 6% carbohydrates by dry weight of the composition. The present invention further relates to a method for preparing a high-fiber composition, which method comprises providing an oat pulp containing dietary fiber and separating the high-fiber composition from the oat pulp.

title: Pet food and how to prepare pet food
abstract: The application relates to animal feed and a method for its production, wherein the raw material comprises meat and animal products in the range of 50% to 80% by weight; fish and fish products in the range of 4% to 36% by weight; molluscs and crustaceans in the range of 0% to 14% by weight; poultry eggs in the range of 3% to 7% by weight; starch in the range of 3% to 7% by weight; vegetables and/or fruits in the range of 0% to 10% by weight; glycerine of plant origin in the range of 0% to 8% by weight; mineral additives in the range of 0% to 2% by weight; oils in the range of 0.1% to 2% by weight; powdered cellulose in the range of 0.1% to 2% by weight; functional additives in the range of 0.01% to 0.8% of parts by weight; vitamin and mineral mixture in the range of 0.1% to 0.2% of parts by weight; herbs in the range of 0.01% to 0.05% of parts by weight; fat for coating, preferably with the addition of a natural antioxidant, preferably beef or chicken in the range of 1% to 6% of parts by weight.

title: Pet food and how to prepare pet food
abstract: The application relates to animal feed and a method of producing the same, wherein the raw material comprises meat and animal products in the range of 50% to 80% by weight; fish and fish products in the range of 4% to 36% by weight; molluscs and crustaceans in the range of 0% to 14% by weight; poultry eggs in the range of 3% to 7% by weight; starch in the range of 3% to 7% by weight; vegetables and/or fruits in the range of 0% to 10% by weight; glycerine of plant origin in the range of 0% to 8% by weight; mineral additives in the range of 0% to 2% by weight; oils in the range of 0.1% to 2% by weight; powdered cellulose in the range of 0.1% to 2% by weight; functional additives in the range of 0.01% to 0.8% by weight; vitamin and mineral mixture in the range of 0.1% to 0.2% by weight; herbs in the range of 0.01% to 0.05% by weight; fat for coating, preferably with the addition of a natural antioxidant, preferably beef or chicken in the range of 1% to 6% by weight.

title: RETENTION TIME AND MILD COAGULATION FOR OBTAINING A COAGULATED TUBER PROTEIN PRODUCT
abstract: The invention is directed to a method for obtaining a coagulated tuber protein product from a tuber fruit juice. The method comprises subjecting the tuber fruit juice to a first coagulation step to form a coagulated low-grade fraction, separating at least part of the coagulated low-grade fraction from the tuber fruit juice to obtain a lean tuber fruit juice, subjecting the lean tuber fruit juice to a second coagulation step and collecting at least part of the coagulated tuber protein product. The invention is further directed to a coagulated tuber protein product and to a food product comprising the coagulated tuber protein product.

title: BIOELECTRONICS FOR CULTIVATED MEAT
abstract: The present invention is directed to bioelectronic systems for monitoring, optimising, developing and/or controlling biological systems, especially cultivated meat products and methods for producing cultivated meat products. The measurement of electric current(s) passing through cells, tissues and/or areas surrounding the cells or tissues, including media, is used to estimate the number of cells and thus cell growth over time and can also be used to estimate the differentiation of cells which is the change of phenotype of cells, along with media composition, the presence of contaminants, viable cell density, and other characteristics of the cells, tissue and/or media that has been measured. Artificial intelligence, including machine learning algorithms may be used to analyze and process the data that has been measured. Additionally, an electrical stimulus can be used to promote cell growth, function, and/or differentiation.

title: A GRIME REMOVING UNIT FOR REMOVING GRIME FROM COMPARTMENTS IN-BETWEEN ADJACENT PAIR OF PLATES IN A HORIZONTAL THERMAL TREATMENT DEVICE
abstract: Disclosed herein is a grime removing unit for removing grime from compartments in- between adjacent pair of plates in a horizontal thermal treatment device and a method of removing grime from compartments in-between adjacent pair of plates in a horizontal thermal treatment device.

title: BIOPOLYMER COMPOSITIONS AND THEIR USE IN FOAMED COMPOSITIONS
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to biopolymer compositions that, among other things, are beneficially used in certain beverages where foam formation is desirable. In some embodiments, the biopolymer composition comprises a first biopolymer and a second biopolymer. In some embodiments, the first biopolymer is a protein, such as a plant protein. In some such embodiments, the first biopolymer is in the form of a microparticle, such as a precipitate or a coacervate. In some embodiments, the second biopolymer is a polysaccharide. In some embodiments, the biopolymer composition comprises a carrier, such as an aqueous medium. In some embodiments, the biopolymer composition comprises one or more flavorings or flavor-modifying compounds. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides the use of such biopolymer compositions to improve the taste or texture of a flavored article, such as a dairy product or a dairy analogue product. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides a flavored article comprising such biopolymer compositions. In some embodiments, the flavored article is a dairy product or a dairy analogue product, such as a foamed dairy analogue product.

title: SYSTEM FOR SECURING BOXES FOR TRANSPORTING, STORING AND/OR DISPLAYING GOODS TO A PALLET
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for anchoring transport, storage and/or display boxes of goods to a pallet, which comprises a structure or base made of mouldable material and having an unlimited height, open at the lower part thereof, which has at least two straight perimeter areas coinciding with the format of the pallet, which has on its lower perimeter, on at least one of the sides thereof, a plurality of die-cut tear lines (4) arranged to be torn, said lines (4), some vertically and others horizontally, being arranged crosswise and, when torn, define ductile and malleable wings (5) which, in turn, when moved laterally, create windows in said lower perimeter, wherein these wings (5) rub against the platform of a pallet, surrounding at least one of the sides of the pallet block.

title: SYSTEM FOR SECURING BOXES FOR TRANSPORTING, STORING AND/OR DISPLAYING GOODS TO A PALLET
abstract: The invention relates to cardboard walls for a pallet and the securing of same to a platform. The cardboard walls comprise, on the lower perimeter and at least one side, a plurality of perforated tear lines (4), some vertical and others horizontal. Tearing the tear lines (4) produces flaps (5) which, when folded, form openings in the lower perimeter. The flaps (5) surround at least one side of feet of the pallet.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEMS FOR PRODUCING SHELF STABLE PLANT-BASED HYDROGELS
abstract: Provided herein are shelf-stable, layered foods and systems and methods for producing the same. In at least one embodiment, the layered foods comprise a first layer comprising a first hydrogel component and a second layer comprising a second hydrogel component, wherein the first and second hydrogel components are formed from one or more biomaterials extracted from one or more plant-based sources.

title: LIQUID SEASONING PRODUCTS AND METHODS OF MANUFACTURING THEREOF
abstract: The disclosure relates to a liquid seasoning product with umami flavor and a rapid method of manufacturing thereof.

title: LIQUID SEASONING PRODUCT AND A METHOD OF MANUFACTURING THEREOF
abstract: The disclosure relates to a liquid umami-flavored seasoning product and a rapid method for preparing it.

title: Device and method for producing milk-air emulsions
abstract: A device for producing a milk-air emulsion is disclosed, which has at least one steam plant (1) which is designed to be immersed in a vessel (2) filled with milk, wherein with the aid of a steam system (7) and with the aid of an air system (8), steam and air can be guided through the steam plant (1) into the milk, wherein the steam system (7) and the air system (8) can each be controlled by a control device (9) on which a milk-air emulsion production program is loaded and can be executed, which has access to a memory on which at least one or more milk/air emulsion production profiles is/are stored, so that the steam and the air can be guided into the milk in accordance with a respectively selected milk/air emulsion production profile in order to automatically produce the milk/air emulsion in the vessel (2).

title: BEVERAGE DISPENSING UNIT OF A BEVERAGE MAKER, AND BEVERAGE MAKER
abstract: A beverage dispensing unit of a beverage maker is provided, comprising a first valve for controlling the dispensing of a beverage, which valve has two connections, an open switching position and a closed switching position, a first valve inlet fluid line with an inlet end that is connectable or connected to a first fluid line of a beverage maker, and an outlet end that is fluidically connected to a first connection of the first valve, and a first valve outlet fluid line with an inlet end that is fluidically connected to a second connection of the first valve and an outlet end that is suitable for dispensing a beverage into an external environment of the beverage dispensing unit, characterized in that the first valve outlet fluid line has a length of ≤ 5 cm and an inner diameter in the range from > 0 to ≤ 7 mm.

title: Beverage dispensing unit of a beverage maker, and beverage maker
abstract: A beverage dispensing unit of a beverage maker is provided, comprising a first valve for controlling the dispensing of a beverage, which valve has two connections, an open switching position and a closed switching position, a first valve inlet fluid line with an inlet end that is connectable or connected to a first fluid line of a beverage maker, and an outlet end that is fluidically connected to a first connection of the first valve, and a first valve outlet fluid line with an inlet end that is fluidically connected to a second connection of the first valve and an outlet end that is suitable for dispensing a beverage into an external environment of the beverage dispensing unit, characterized in that the first valve outlet fluid line has a length of ≤ 5 cm and an inner diameter in the range from > 0 to ≤ 7 mm.

title: Beverage preparation device for preparing a beverage and method for operating a beverage preparation device
abstract: The approach presented here relates to a beverage preparation device (100) for preparing a beverage. The beverage preparation device (100) comprises at least one optical waveguide (105a), by means of which a light signal can be guided from a measuring point (110a) in and/or on the beverage preparation device (100) to an optical sensor unit (115). The beverage preparation device (100) further comprises the optical sensor unit (115) for detecting a parameter of an ingredient of the beverage and/or a parameter of the beverage from the light signal in order to provide a sensor signal. The beverage preparation device (100) further comprises an evaluation unit (120), by means of which a control signal can be determined from the sensor signal in order to control the beverage preparation device (100) using the control signal.

title: Powdered preparation for making yogurt
abstract: Powdered preparation for the manufacture of a yogurt The invention relates to a preparation for the manufacture of a yogurt based on vegetable milk, which comprises, on the one hand, a powdered fermentation agent comprising at least one lactic ferment chosen from Lactococcus lactis, and on the other hand, a powdered texturing agent comprising at least one thickener soluble in said milk at room temperature. The invention also relates to a method for manufacturing a yogurt based on vegetable milk from said preparation, and the yogurt thus obtained.

title: ENZYMATIC TREATMENT OF A MATERIAL COMPRISING CORN PROTEIN
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of treating a material comprising corn protein with a protein deamidase. The enzymatically treated material has improved water holding capacity, emulsifying capacity, and/or improved corn protein solubility compared to a material obtained using the same method but without the use of a protein deamidase.

title: CELL-CULTIVATED MILK FOR CONFECTIONERY AND DAIRY PRODUCT USES
abstract: Cell-cultured milk generated in vitro in a reactor assembly is employed in the production of food products including chocolate, confections, ice cream, cheese, yogurt, cream, and non-food products such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and plastics. The processing used to generate the cell-cultured milk can be tailored to the specific type of product, including nutrient enhancement for food products and removal of undesirable components of traditional dairy milk.

title: 3-HYDROXYBENZOIC ACID AND ITS USE AS A FLAVOR MODIFIER
abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to 3-hydroxybenzoic acid (3HBA) and the use of this compounds to modify the flavor or taste of an ingestible composition. In some embodiments, the use of 3HBA includes its use to enhance a sweet taste, its use to reduce an off taste, such as an off taste of a high-intensity sweetener, its use to reduce a bitter taste, or any combination thereof. In certain embodiments, 3HBA used in combination with other natural taste modifiers, such as flavonoids or dihydrochalcones, or with other non-naturally-occurring sweetness enhancers. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides ingestible compositions that include such flavanone compounds or non-naturally-occurring compounds. In some related aspects, the ingestible compositions are, or are included within, various flavored products, such as food products, beverage products, pharmaceutical products, oral care products, or animal feed products.

title: METHODS FOR THE PRODUCTION OF PROTEIN HYDROLYSATES WITH LOW LEVELS OF NITROSAMINES
abstract: The invention relates to methods for the preparation of protein hydrolysates having low concentrations of undesired nitrosamines as well as the thus obtained protein hydrolysates, compositions containing them and uses thereof. The methods comprise the steps of (a) contacting at least one protein with at least one oxidant, preferably a peroxide, at a concentration of 10 to <500 ppm relative to the weight of the at least one protein, at a pH in the range of 2.0 to <7.0; and (b) subjecting the at least one protein of step (a) to a hydrolysis reaction to obtain a protein hydrolysate.

title: COMESTIBLE PRODUCTS HAVING HIGH FIBER AND LOW SUGAR
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to ingestible compositions that contain a fibrous bulking agent, such as a fiber derived from the hull material of a grain or legume. Suitable examples include pea hull fiber and oat hull fiber. In some embodiments, the ingestible compositions include one or more oligosaccharides, such as a galacto-oligosaccharide, a fructo-oligosaccharide, an isomalto-oligosaccharide, a xylo-oligosaccharide, or any combination thereof. In some embodiments, the ingestible composition comprises a sweetener, such as a saccharide sweetener, a high-intensity sweetener, or any combination thereof. In some embodiments, the ingestible composition comprises one or more enzymes, such as xylanases. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides comestible products, such as a food product, that include or are made from such ingestible compositions. Examples include various baked goods, such as cookies, cakes, and snack bars.

title: METHOD TO PRODUCE PHOSPHORYLATED MILK PROTEINS IN MICROBES
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods for production of phosphorylated recombinant animal proteins, phosphorylated phosphomimetic animal proteinsand phosphomimetic animal proteins, as well as the use of such animal proteins.

title: METHOD TO PRODUCE PHOSPHORYLATED MILK PROTEINS IN MICROBES
abstract: The present disclosure relates to methods for production of phosphorylated casein, phosphorylated phosphomimetic casein and phosphomimetic casein, as well as the use of such caseins.

title: COMPOSITION CONTAINING FISH BONE POWDER AND PLANT EXTRACT FOR EFFECTIVE IMPROVEMENT IN BONE JOINT HEALTH
abstract: The present invention provides a composition including plant extract and fish bone powder and use thereof in bone and joint health. The composition can repair cartilage, enhance the secretion of bone and joint lubricants, clear inflammatory cells, inhibit inflammatory factors, delay cartilage degeneration, improve bone density and strength, maintain bone density, strengthen bone firmness, and improve osteoporosis and alleviate arthritis.

title: PROCESS FOR PRODUCING A SAVOURY TASTE PRODUCT
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing a savoury taste product from an organic starting material, the method comprising a step of providing an organic starting material, preferably mushroom, chicken, lentil and / or beans, a step of fermenting the organic starting material in presence of a fungi composition, preferably Aspergillus sojae and Aspergillus oryzae and a step of enzymatic hydrolysis.

title: FERMENTED DIETARY PRODUCT, PROCESS FOR ITS PREPARATION AND USE
abstract:
The invention relates to a fermented dietary product, process of its preparation based on plant raw materials and including selected strains of probiotic microorganisms specific for their characteristics, which has a marked health effect and is suitable as a food for people on a vegetarian or vegan diet as well as in accordance with religious concepts of nutrition. The fermented dietary product includes the plant raw materials pea protein, coconut flour, coconut milk, pectin and carrageenan and also strains Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophillus, isolated from sources of the territory of Bulgaria, more precisely:
Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DXB, registered in CCM under Nº 9196,
Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DXA, registered in CCM under Nº 9197,
Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DSW, registered in CCM under Nº 9198,
Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DLP, registered in CCM under Nº 9199,
Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DDM1, registered in CCM under Nº 9200 and
Strain Streptococcus thermophilus DWT4, registered in CCM under Nº 7992.

title: PRODUCTION OF APPLE PECTIN AND DIETARY FIBER USING THE CAVITATION EXTRACTION METHOD
abstract: The method for producing pectin and dietary fiber from apple pomace using a cavitation vacuum extraction system is a technological process in which the apple pomace is first crushed into particles measuring 3–5 mm, subjected to steam blanching for 3–5 minutes and bleached with a 3.5–4% hydrogen peroxide aqueous solution at a temperature of 35–45 °C for 10–20 minutes, then washed with demineralized water at a hydromodule of 1:6, and the resulting suspension is subjected to ultrasonic cavitation by mixing with water in a ratio of 1:4 to 1:8 and subsequent extraction with a rotary cavitation disperser at a temperature of 45–50 °C, pH 4.2–4.8, with the addition of an extractant in an amount of 0.05–0.15% of the volume for a period of 30–60 minutes, followed by multi-stage purification by vacuum filtration, centrifugation, filtration through a diatomaceous filter, ultrafiltration and diafiltration at a pressure of 0.1–0.3 MPa and a pore size of 20 kDa, and the resulting extract is concentrated by vacuum evaporation at a temperature of 45–50 °C until 8–12% dry matter is reached and dried by spray drying at a temperature of up to 60 °C to a final moisture content of 6%, characterised in that the pectin obtained is standardised with dextrose and salts to a gelling strength of over 210 °SAG, and the dietary fibers are obtained by pressing and tunnel drying the solid phase. There are several stages in the production of pectin, which is the subject of the present invention, including: - coarse crushing stage, steam blanching, bleaching with hydrogen peroxide and washing of free sugars, processing and filtration to obtain a solid sludge. The solid sediment obtained from filtration with a moisture content of 55-60% from the storage bunker is fed by a screw conveyor or screw pump into the receiving tank of a membrane pneumatic press for dewatering by pressing to a residual moisture content of 50-55% and then fed into a tunnel-type dryer, where it is dried to 6-8%.

title: FERMENTED PLANT-BASED COMPOSITIONS AND PROCESSES OF PREPARING THE SAME
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a plant-based fermented composition and methods for preparing the same.

title: A PROCESS FOR PREPARING AN OAT-DERIVED BASE FOR OAT-BASED DAIRY ALTERNATIVE FOOD PRODUCTS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for making an oat-derived base, comprising treating a mixture comprising plant-derived substrate comprising whole oat flour and vegetable protein isolate and:or vegetable protein concentrate with an enzyme composition comprising a beta-glucanase and optionally at least one additional enzyme. The present invention further relates to use of the oat-derived base to produce an oat-based acidified dairy alternative food product.

title: METHODS OF PREPARATION OF FOOD COMPOSITIONS AND BEVERAGES BASED ON WHOLE ALMOND, PECAN OR WALNUT FRUITS AND RELATED PRODUCTS
abstract: Described is a method of processing nut fruits selected from almond fruits, pecan fruits and/or walnut fruits, comprising: a) off-ground harvesting of the nut fruits; b) subjecting a mass comprising kernels, inner shell and green outer hull of the nut fruits to grinding to an average particle size of 500 μm or less to provide a ground mass; and c) further processing the ground mass to edible nut fruit solids, edible nut fruit-based products and/or nut fruit beverages; wherein the nut fruits have not been subjected to drying before step b). The method provides an ecologically friendly and simple alternative for processing almond fruits, pecan fruits and/or walnut fruits to food and beverage compositions that are not only suitable for human consumption but simultaneously comprise high amounts of the natural antioxidants and bioactive materials present in the fresh fruits. Simultaneously, the method reduces risks related to both consumer health and the orchard environment, does not require extensive use of herbicides and/or pesticides, and reduces dust generation and tree water stress. In addition, edible products and beverages obtained by the aforementioned method are described.

title: CLEANING METHOD FOR CLEANING A MILK-CONDUCTING SYSTEM OF A BEVERAGE MACHINE
abstract: A cleaning method, by way of which a milk-conducting system of a beverage machine, in particular a coffee machine, is cleaned, is characterized by comprising at least the following steps: A) providing the beverage machine (1) comprising a milk-conducting system (20) having a milk container (21, 21') which can be filled with milk; B) starting a cleaning process; C) emptying the milk from the milk container (21, 21') if it is not already completely empty at the point in time at which the cleaning process is initiated, D) filling the milk container (21, 21') with a cleaning fluid, and E) conducting the cleaning fluid from the milk container (21, 21') through the milk processing section (22).

title: CELL CULTURE CONSTRUCT
abstract: A food product cell culture construct for a food product bioreactor module (102) that is attachable to a food product cell culturing system (100). The food product cell culture bioreactor module (102) has a housing (108) adapted to receive the food product cell culture construct for culturing cells on the food product cell culture construct within the housing. The food product cell culture construct comprises a plurality of fibres (120) and an end support (126). The plurality of fibres (120) have external surfaces for cell adhesion and culturing, and ends embedded within the end support (126) and extending from the end support (126) such they extend into the housing (108) when the food product cell culture construct is received in the housing of the food product cell culture bioreactor module (102). At a plane coincident with the end support (126) the plurality of fibres (120) are arranged in a fibre distribution defining an envelope. The fibre distribution comprises a Fibre Distribution Parameter, FDP, of between 9 cm3 and 24 cm3, the FDP being the product of the sum of the circumferences of the plurality of fibres within the envelope and the area within the envelope not occupied by the plurality of fibres.

title: PULSE SEED PROCESSING
abstract: The present invention relates generally to removing the plant tone of starchy Fabaceae pulses consisting of chickpea (Cicer arietinum), yellow pea (Pisum sativum), common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) and fava bean (Vicia faba) as hulled or de-hulled pulses whole pulses, as split pulses or as chopped solids thereof with a Feret diameter (Dmax) of 1 to 4 mm whiling transforming these in an emulsifying and emulsion stabilizing matter suitable for fermentation the emulsion thereof in fermented milk derivatives with a desired texture or form fermenting such hulled or de-hulled pulses whole pulses or split pulses into melt-in-mouth or self-disintegrating-in-mouth snacks or breakfast cereal analogues. To achieve these technical effects the pulses have been pre-treated with an aqueous bicarbonate solution or bicarbonate/carbonate solution made of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3), of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3) and carbonate salt (M2CO3), or of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3) and hydroxide salt (MOH), whereby M is an alkali metal cation, and with a pH between pH 7 and 10, preferably a pH between 7, 5 and 10.

title: BETAINE AS MASKER FOR UNDESIRABLE OFF-NOTES IN A DAIRY AND/OR PLANT-BASED FOODSTUFF

Further, the invention relates to a foodstuff, wherein the foodstuff comprises or consists of a processed dairy product, preferably full-fat milk or low-fat milk, and/or a fortified milk product and/or a plant-based product, wherein the foodstuff comprises betaine, wherein at least one undesirable off-note is reduced, modified and/or masked by betaine compared to the same foodstuff lacking betaine, wherein the at least one off-note is not a bitter off-note. title: EFFICIENT PRODUCTION OF RECOMBINANT CASEIN
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for production of recombinant casein, wherein the method comprises the steps of: (a) adding a microbial strain to a first bioreactor, wherein said microbial strain has the capacity to express casein, and said microbial strain comprises means for deactivation of cell division; (b) culturing said microbial strain in the first bioreactor, wherein the cell division is active, thereby forming a continuously growing biomass comprising cells of said microbial strain; (c) deactivating cell division; (d) inducing expression of casein; (e) after sufficient expression of casein, lysing said cells, thereby forming a lysis broth, and separating said lysis broth so that casein can be separated into a casein containing phase; (f) optionally treating the casein containing phase to induce formation of casein micelles; (g) optionally further purifying and/or treating the casein micelles, and (h) optionally producing caseinate. In other aspects, the invention also relates to a bioreactor system, a recombinant casein, and products including a recombinant casein.

title: Container for the fermentation of biomass
abstract: The present invention relates to a container for the fermentation of biomass, comprising a housing with an aseptically sealable lid, a stirring, dispersing, and/or cutting device, a sterile coupling, a pressure equalization valve, and an inlet for compressed gas. The present invention further relates to a method for producing a starter culture for the fermentation of biomass, comprising (a) filling a starter culture container with a nutrient medium that can be cured by heat treatment, (b) closing the starter culture container, (c) sterilizing the filled starter culture container by heat treatment to obtain a cured and sterile nutrient medium, and adding an inoculum to the starter culture container via a sterile coupling to inoculate the cured and sterile nutrient medium to thereby initiate fermentation and obtain a starter culture. Finally, the present invention also relates to a starter culture produced by this method and to a method for the fermentation of biomass.

title: Process for the fermentation of biomass
abstract: The present invention relates to a process for the fermentation of biomass, comprising (a) providing a fermentation reactor comprising a dispersing and/or cutting device, (b) filling the fermentation reactor with biomass and a starter culture, and (c) fermenting the biomass in the fermentation reactor, which is initiated by the starter culture, for a period of at least 24 hours to obtain a fermented biomass, characterized in that the contents of the fermentation reactor are comminuted or homogenized at least once for a period of at least 10 seconds by means of the dispersing and/or cutting device during the fermentation. The present invention further relates to a fermentation reactor for fermenting biomass according to the method according to the invention, comprising a housing, a dispersing and/or cutting device, which is preferably arranged in a branching line system flanged to the fermentation reactor, a sterile coupling, a pressure equalization valve and an inlet for compressed gas.

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for cultivating food and beverages in a bioreactor (1) wherein the method comprises the steps of; - preparing a media, the media being any one of; a basal media, a growth media or a differentiation media; - sterilizing the media prepared in step a); - sterilizing a culture tank (4) and one or more ports (2,3,22) of a bioreactor (1) by using one or more UV light sources (17,18); - providing the media into the culture tank (4) of the bioreactor (1) via the one or more port(s) (2,3); - adding meat cells or non-photosynthetic cells to the sterilized media, either prior to introducing the sterilized media into the culture tank (4) or alternatively by combining the meat cells or non-photosynthetic cells and the sterilized media in the sterilized culture tank (4), or in equipment in connection with the sterilized culture tank; - optionally adding growth factors or differentiation factors to the media, if the media is a basal media for preparing either a growth media or a differentiation media; - allowing the meat cells or non-photosynthetic cells provided in the sterilized media to proliferate or differentiate within the culture tank (4) to provide a cell product; - harvesting and preparing a precursor or final food product and/or beverage from the cell product.

FISH CUTTING APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CUTTING FILLETS OF FISH
abstract: The present invention relates to a fish cutting apparatus and a method for cutting fish fillets from the bones of the fish, wherein the fish cutting apparatus may reduce the initial costs and maintenance costs, but still be easy to operate and provide a substantially satisfactory filleting result. The present invention addresses this by providing a fish cutting apparatus for cutting fillets of fish, wherein the fish cutting apparatus comprises a conveying system for conveying at least one fish through the cutting apparatus, in a conveying direction through a cutting zone. At least one set of two cutting blades is arranged adjacent to each other in said cutting zone, wherein a blade distance is provided between the cutting blades. Each of the cutting blades are arranged on a first and second side of the conveying system. At least one adjustable arrangement is configured to adjust said blade distance by displacing said cutting blades relative to each other according to a pre-set cutting program configured to perform a cutting task. A user interface is configured to receive a batch information related to a batch of fish to be cut. A control unit configured to retrieve said batch information from said user interface, wherein the control unit is configured to control said adjustable arrangement when executing the pre-set program based on said batch information, such that each fish in the batch is cut according to a predetermined cutting pattern, when each fish in the batch of fish in continuation of each other is being conveyed through the cutting zone.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR RAPID LIQUID BIOPRINTING
abstract: Methods for fabricating three-dimensional (3D) constructs from a mixture of cells, culture medium, and a scaffold material with a controlled calcium chloride concentration is disclosed. The process involves positioning a nozzle within a gel composed of alginate solution. The nozzle is then moved within the gel, releasing the cell-media-scaffold mixture in a controlled pattern. As the mixture is deposited, it becomes surrounded by the gel, which provides structural support until it solidifies through the cross-linking reaction between the calcium chloride in the cell-media-scaffold mixture and the alginate solution. This results in the formation of a solid 3D structure that incorporates the cells and their supporting scaffold. The presented method offers a versatile platform for generating intricate cell-based 3D constructs with precise control over their composition and structure. This method can be used to produce cultivated meat with complex 3D structures as well as organelles and fully functional organs.

title: METHODS AND COMPOSITIONS FOR TREATING AGE-RELATED NEURODEGENERATIVE DISEASE ASSOCIATED WITH DYSBIOSIS
abstract: Described are methods of treating a neurodegenerative disease, such as an age- related neurodegenerative disease in a patient in need thereof, comprising administering a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of at least one human milk oligosaccharide (HMO). Also described are methods of treating Parkinson's Disease (PD) in a patient in need thereof comprising administering to said patient an effective amount of an HMO.

title: LIPID PARTICLES AND THEIR COMESTIBLE USE
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to lipid particles and their use in ingestible compositions. In some embodiments, the lipid particles comprise a solid plant-based fat. In some embodiments, the lipid particles comprise one or more flavor compounds, such as compounds that impart certain tastes or aromas. In certain aspects, the disclosure provides uses of such lipid particles to flavor food products that contain non-animal proteins, such as dairy analogue products.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A TEXTURATE AND PROTEIN-CONTAINING TEXTURATE
abstract: A protein-containing texturate is proposed that is characterized by a special anisotropy comparable to that of meat. The texturate comprises a first protein mixture with a non-legume protein, in particular wheat protein, with a proportion of between 10% and 90% by weight of the dry matter, and a second protein mixture, in particular with a legume protein or a sidestream product, with a proportion of between 10% and 90% by weight of the dry matter. The moisture content is less than 40% and in particular less than 35% by weight; the protein content of the texturate is between 35% and 60% by weight of the dry matter. According to the invention, the texturate has fibers with a preferred direction and a length of more than 10 mm and in particular more than 15 mm, and has an anisotropy index of greater than 1 and in particular greater than 1.4.

title: COOLING COMPOSITION
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the field of flavor or perfumery. More particularly, it concerns a liquid composition comprising a compound of formula (I), an oil comprising carvone, and optionally, a solvent. The present disclosure further relates to the use of the said composition in consumer products, such as flavored products and body care products.

title: Food product containing fish meat and mushrooms and method of producing the food product containing fish meat and mushrooms
abstract: The subject of the application is a food product containing comminuted fish meat, mushrooms according to the invention and spices, flour, eggs, which is characterized in that it is a homogeneous mixture of 0.5% - 2.0% by weight of dried oyster mushroom fruiting body powder rehydrated in 2.5% - 10% by weight of water, 73% - 82% by weight of comminuted fish meat, 3.0% - 5.0% by weight of flour, 0.6% - 1.2% by weight of egg powder rehydrated in 1.8% - 3.6% by weight of water, 3.0% - 5.0% by weight of oil and 3.0% - 5.0% by weight of tomato concentrate. The application also includes a method of producing a food product containing minced fish meat, mushrooms, according to the invention, which consists in mixing fish meat with mushrooms and spices, flour, eggs, forming into the desired shape and then subjecting it to heat treatment. The essence of the invention consists in that 0.5% - 2.0% by weight of dried oyster mushroom fruiting bodies powder rehydrated in 2.5% - 10% by weight of water is combined with 73% - 82% by weight of minced fish meat, 3.0% - 5.0% by weight of flour, 0.6% - 1.2% by weight of egg powder rehydrated in 1.8% - 3.6% by weight of water, 3.3% - 5.0% by weight of oil and 3.0% - 5.0% by weight of tomato concentrate. All ingredients are mixed until a homogeneous mass is obtained and the resulting product is molded.

title: METHOD FOR THE CONVERSION OF INSECTS INTO INSECT PULP AND NUTRIENT STREAMS, INSECT PULP  OBTAINABLE BY THIS METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for converting insects into a nutrient stream, such as a puree, an enzymatically hydrolysed puree, a fat fraction and a protein fraction. The invention further relates to the (hydrolysed) puree and to the fractions obtainable by said methods and to their use as a food or feed product or as an ingredient therefore. The invention also relates to a method for converting insect larvae into a composition with anti-oxidant properties. Thus, the invention also relates to a method for converting insect larvae into an antioxidant composition. In addition, the invention relates to a composition with anti-oxidant properties obtainable by said method and to the use of the composition as a health promoting food ingredient or as a feed ingredient.

title: METHOD FOR THE CONVERSION OF INSECTS INTO INSECT PULP AND NUTRIENT STREAMS, INSECT PULP OBTAINABLE BY THIS METHOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for converting insects into a nutrient stream, such as a mash, an enzymatically hydrolyzed mash, a fat fraction, and a protein fraction. abstract: The invention is a device, shown in Fig 1., comprising at least one well with integrated electrodes, layers forming plates and at least two integrated electrodes positioned in at least two different planes inside the well, for electrical measurements of in vitro culture of biological constructs such as cells layer, 3D tissue constructs or organoids. The apparatus comprises at least one well with at least two integrated electrodes with at least one suspended electrode of the at least two electrodes integrated into the well at different planes, or with the plurality of suspended electrodes realized on multiple suspended layers in different combinations, Fig 4., The invention is a measurement instrument, capable for electrical measurements of in vitro culture of biological construct.
