FLAVOUR MODIFYING INGREDIENT
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for making a flavour modifying ingredient, wherein the method comprises subjecting tomato pomace to enzymatic hydrolysis and/or fermentation to form a treated tomato pomace that is useful for modifying the flavour and/or mouthfeel of food products, such as meat analog products, high-moisture extruded food products, and ketchup products.

title: FLAVOUR MODIFYING INGREDIENT
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for making a flavour modifying ingredient for a carbonated soft drink, wherein the method comprises (i) subjecting tomato pomace to enzymatic hydrolysis and/or fermentation to form a treated tomato pomace; and (ii) extracting at least a portion of the treated tomato pomace with a solvent. The present disclosure also relates to flavour compositions and beverages comprising the flavour modifying ingredients in amounts effective to improve the sweetness, mouthfeel and/or taste of beverages.

title: A PLANT-BASED CHEESE AND A PROCESS OF MANUFACTURING THE SAME
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a plant-based cheese, and particularly to a plant-based cheese comprising enzymatically treated protein. The present disclosure further concerns a process for producing the plant-based cheese, use of the plant-based cheese and food products comprising the plant-based cheese.

title: PET FOOD, METHODS AND DEVICES FOR PRODUCING PET FOOD
abstract: The present invention relates to a method of preparing pet food using components made from metazoan cells.

title: METHOD FOR INTRODUCING BLOCKS OF FOOD INTO A FOOD PROCESSING SYSTEM, AND PROCESSING LINE OR DEVICE FOR CARRYING OUT SUCH A METHOD
abstract: The invention relates to a method for introducing starting products (1) in the form of packaged blocks of food (2) into a food processing system. Deep-frozen blocks of food (2) are usually delivered in a waxed starting product packaging (3). During the unpacking process, some packaging can be left on the unpacked blocks of food (2). For quality control purposes, the invention uses scanning means (6) which, after the starting product packaging (3) has been removed, check the starting product packaging (3) for intactness and release the unpacked block of food (2) for further processing only in the event of a positive result.

title: Method for introducing food blocks into a food processing and processing line or device for carrying out such a method
abstract: The invention relates to a method for introducing food blocks (1) into a food processing facility. Deep-frozen food blocks (1) are typically delivered in waxed incoming goods packaging (3). During unpacking, residues may remain on the unpacked food blocks (2). For quality control, the invention utilizes scanning means (6) that, after removing the incoming goods packaging (3), check the incoming goods packaging (3) for damage. Only if the result is positive does the unpacked food block (2) pass on for further processing.

title: Process for the preparation of a plant extract, in particular from rye, and its use as a food or as an additive to a food
abstract: In order to provide a plant extract for the production of milk substitutes that has a smooth mouthfeel and a neutral odor profile, the invention provides a process comprising the following steps: a) heat treatment of the plant starting material obtained from at least one seed selected from the group comprising cereals, pseudocereals, and mixtures of these seeds, and b) first enzymatic treatment of the starting material from step a) to obtain a slurry in which starch is almost completely or completely, preferably completely, hydrolyzed, c) second enzymatic treatment of the slurry from step b) using at least one enzyme selected from the group comprising xylanase, beta-glucanase, or mixtures thereof, to obtain an extract, and d) optionally concentrating the extract to a final dry matter content of 30 to 70 wt.%, preferably 50 wt.%, based on the total weight of the extract, to obtain a plant-based concentrated extract. which can also be called syrup.

title: PLANT-BASED SUBSTITUTES
abstract: A non-animal derived fat composition comprises a non-interesterified blend of (a) an interesterified oil composition of one or more oils; and (b) a further composition comprising one or more oils; wherein the non-animal derived fat composition comprises from 2% to 10% by weight of a total amount of butyric acid (C4:0) and caproic acid (C6:0) residues; from 0.5% to 10% by weight of a total amount of caprylic acid (C8:0) and decanoic acid (C10:0) residues; from 25% to 50% by weight of palmitic acid (C16:0) residues; from 5% to 20% by weight of stearic acid residues (C18:0); and from 18% to 40% by weight of oleic acid residues (C18:1); wherein said percentages of fatty acid residues refers to fatty acids bound as acyl groups in glycerides in the fat composition and being based on the total weight of C4 to C24 fatty acid residues bound as acyl groups present in the fat composition.

title: FAT DELIVERY SYSTEM, FAT DELIVERY METHOD AND FOOD PRODUCT CONTAINING THE FAT DELIVERY SYSTEM
abstract: A fat delivery system includes an emulsified plant-based fat, plant-based protein and a vegetarian flavor agent at least partially encapsulated within the emulsion.

title: COMPOSITION COMPRISING A PLANT-DERIVED CARBOHYDRATE FIBER THAT IS NOT A BETA-GLUCAN FIBER AND A BETA-GLUCAN FIBER AS MOUTHFEELIMPROVING ADDITIVES FOR A CONSUMABLE
abstract: A composition including plant-derived carbohydrate fiber that is not a beta-glucan fiber and a beta-glucan fiber as mouthfeel-improving additives for a consumable is disclosed. A consumable containing the composition of the plant-derived non-beta-glucan carbohydrate fiber and beta-glucan fiber as mouthfeel-improving additives, and methods for preparing a consumable including the mouthfeel-improving composition and for improving the mouthfeel of a consumable by adding the mouthfeel-improving composition to a consumable base are also disclosed.

title: MICROENCAPSULATES AND USES THEREOF
abstract: A slow-release microencapsulate comprises a FODMAP encapsulated within a denatured protein matrix. The microencapsulate is gastric-resistant and ileal-sensitive, and configured to release the FODMAP slowly in the ileum of the subject to inhibit or prevent gas formation and bloating. A method of preventing or inhibiting gastrointestinal gas formation or bloating associated with consumption of FODMAP in a subject is also described.

title: CHEESE-ANALOGUE COMPOSITION
abstract: A cheese analogue composition comprising water, starch, sugar, gum, and a fat composition; wherein the fat composition comprises from 1.0% to 20% by weight of butyric acid residues (C4:0) and caproic acid residues (C6:0); from 40 to 95% by weight of C14 to C18 fatty acid residues; wherein said percentages of fatty acid residues refers to fatty acids bound as acyl groups in glycerides in the fat composition and being based on the total weight of saturated and unsaturated C4 to C24 fatty acid residues bound as acyl groups present in the fat composition.

title: METHOD OF CULTURING AN ANIMAL CELL
abstract: The invention relates to methods for culturing cells, and cultured animal cells for use in described method. Also provided is a modified animal cell and guide RNAs targeting genes to be modified in the modified and cultured cells of the invention.

title: PULSE SEED PROCESSING
abstract: The present invention relates generally to removing the plant tone of starchy Fabaceae pulses consisting of chickpea (Cicer arietinum), yellow pea (Pisum sativum), common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) and fava bean (Vicia faba) as hulled or de-hulled pulses whole pulses, as split pulses or as chopped solids thereof with a Feret diameter (Dmax) of 1 to 4 mm whiling transforming these in an emulsifying and emulsion stabilizing matter suitable for fermentation the emulsion thereof in fermented milk derivatives with a desired texture or form fermenting such hulled or de-hulled pulses whole pulses or split pulses into melt-in-mouth or self-disintegrating-in-mouth snacks or breakfast cereal analogues. To achieve these technical effects the pulses have been pre-treated with an aqueous bicarbonate solution or bicarbonate/carbonate solution made of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3), of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3) and carbonate salt (M2CO3), or of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3) and hydroxide salt (MOH), whereby M is an alkali metal cation, and with a pH between pH 7 and 10, preferably a pH between 7, 5 and 10.

title: BUTTER FAT SUBSTITUTES
abstract: A dairy-analogue fat composition comprising a blend of an interesterif ied vegetable oil blend and an animal fat; wherein the dairy-analogue fat composition comprises from 2% to 6% by weight of a total amount of C36 containing triglycerides; from 2% to 8% by weight of a total amount of C38 containing triglycerides; from 20% to 40% by weight of a total amount of C52 containing triglycerides; and from 12% to 20% by weight of a total amount of C54 containing triglycerides; wherein said percentages of C-containing triglycerides refers to total carbons present in the triglycerides in the fat composition and being based on the total weight of C12 to C66 triglycerides present in the fat composition.

title: PLANT-BASED BUTTER FAT SUBSTITUTES
abstract: A non-animal derived fat composition comprises an interesterified oil blend of three or more plant derived oils; wherein the non-animal derived fat composition comprises from 1% to 10% by weight of a total amount of butyric acid (C4:0) and caproic acid (C6:0) residues; from 25% to 50% by weight of palmitic acid (C16:0) residues; from 2.5% to 15% by weight of stearic acid residues (C18:0); and from 20% to 45% by weight of oleic acid residues (C18:1); wherein said percentages of fatty acid residues refers to fatty acids bound as acyl groups in glycerides in the fat composition and being based on the total weight of C4 to C24 fatty acid residues bound as acyl groups present in the fat composition.

title: MATURED CHEESE-ANALOGUE COMPOSITION
abstract: A matured cheese analogue composition comprises water, starch, sugar, gum, culture and a fat composition; wherein the fat composition comprises from 1.0% to 20% by weight of butyric acid residues (C4:0) and caproic acid residues (C6:0); from 40 to 95% by weight of C14 to C18 fatty acid residues; wherein said percentages of fatty acid residues refers to fatty acids bound as acyl groups in glycerides in the fat composition and being based on the total weight of saturated and unsaturated C4 to C24 fatty acid residues bound as acyl groups present in the fat composition.

title: A METHOD OF FORMING BIOPOLYMER FIBRES
abstract: The invention provides a method of forming biopolymer fibres, the method comprising; (i) providing a first and a second aqueous solution, wherein one of the first or the second aqueous solution comprises at least one water-soluble polycationic biopolymer and the other first or second aqueous solution comprises at least one water-soluble polyanionic biopolymer; and (ii) adding the first aqueous solution to the second aqueous solution to form a complexation mixture, wherein the complexation mixture comprises polyelectrolyte biopolymer complexes formed by complexation of the polycationic and polyanionic biopolymers of the first and second aqueous solutions; and (iii) effecting laminar fluid flow of the complexation mixture, which applies shear stress to the polyelectrolyte complexes to form biopolymer fibres.

title: EXOSOMES AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present invention concerns isolated human breast milk exosomes, and compositions thereof, and uses of said exosomes and compositions for promoting immunity and treating and/or preventing mucosal immunity and inflammation.

title: EXOSOMES AND USES THEREOF
abstract: The present invention concerns isolated human breast milk exosomes, and compositions thereof, and uses of said exosomes and compositions for promoting systemic immunity and treating and/or preventing systemic inflammation.

title: YEAST FOR INCREASED LIPID PRODUCTION
abstract: The present invention relates to a Yarrowia lipolytica CBS 8108 strain for producing lipids, comprising one or more chimeric gene constructs, for overexpression of ACC1, MCE2 and/or DGA1 chimeric genes. In a second aspect, the invention relates to a method for producing lipids using said Y. lipolytica strain. The invention further pertains to lipids obtainable by the method, a composition comprising said lipids, a composition comprising Y. lipolytica strain, and a food product obtainable therefrom.

title: PRODUCTION OF AN UMAMI INGREDIENT
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for producing an umami enhancing ingredient and to an umami enhancing ingredient. The method comprises suspending the high protein plant seed in water, cyclically switching the aqueous suspension between a heating step and a cooling step, which is repeated at least twice; disrupting the high protein plant seed; adding hydrolytic enzymes to the heat processed aqueous suspension and maintaining the heat processed aqueous suspension at the hydrolysis temperature to provide a hydrolysed plant protein product; and drying the hydrolysed plant protein product to provide the umami enhancing ingredient.

title: COMPOSITIONS COMPRISING TRUNCATED CASEIN POLYPEPTIDES
abstract: The invention relates to a truncated casein polypeptide (TCP), said truncated casein polypeptide being preferably selected from alpha S1-casein (αS1-casein), alpha S2-casein (αS2-casein), beta-casein (β-casein), or kappa-casein (κ-casein) polypeptide or a mixture thereof, and compositions comprising thereof. The invention further relates to a dairy product or dairy-like product comprising said truncated casein polypeptide (TCP). Such composition can also be used for the preparation of nutritional product. Finally, the invention further relates to methods of making the truncated casein polypeptide (TCP) of the invention and methods of making the dairy product or dairy-like product of the invention.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A MEAT SUBSTITUTE PRODUCT, AND MEAT SUBSTITUTE PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a meat substitute product, wherein a raw mass is heated and then cooled. An intermediate mass is then produced by adding a bacterial mass to the raw mass. The mass thus produced is fermented, whereby the finished meat substitute product is produced. The invention also relates to a meat substitute product which is produced using such a method.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A CHEESE SUBSTITUTE PRODUCT, AND CHEESE SUBSTITUTE PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a cheese substitute product, wherein a raw mass is heated and then cooled. An intermediate mass is then produced by adding a bacterial mass to the raw mass. The mass thus produced is fermented, whereby the finished cheese substitute product is produced. The invention also relates to a cheese substitute product which is produced using such a method.

title: Frying fat composition
abstract: Frying fat composition for combined shallow frying and seasoning of fried food, comprising a fat base and a powdered salt, wherein the powdered salt is evenly distributed in the fat base.

title: PRODUCTION OF ENGINEERED SKELETAL MUSCLE IN A BIOREACTOR
abstract: This invention is in the field of skeletal muscle engineering. The present invention relates to a method for producing an engineered skeletal muscle tissue from pluripotent stem cells, comprising five defined steps, thereby producing contractile engineered skeletal muscle tissue, and the method is characterized in that the steps (i)-(iii) are carried out in a bioreactor under suitable conditions, and wherein the method does not include the use of a solubilized basement membrane preparation extracted from the Engelbreth-Holm-Swarm mouse sarcoma. Furthermore, an engineered skeletal muscle tissue obtainable by a method disclosed herein is also disclosed wherein said engineered skeletal muscle tissue generates a contraction force of at least 0.5 millinewtons (mN) upon a stimulus from 1 Hz to 150 Hz, wherein said engineered skeletal muscle tissue is serum-free, and wherein said engineered skeletal muscle tissue does not comprise a transgene. Medical and non-medical uses of the engineered skeletal muscle tissue are also described.

title: Production of artificial skeletal muscle in a bioreactor
abstract: This invention is in the field of artificial skeletal muscle. The present invention relates to a method for producing artificial skeletal muscle tissue from pluripotent stem cells, comprising five defined steps, by which contractile artificial skeletal muscle tissue is produced, and the method is characterized in that steps (i) - (iii) are carried out in a bioreactor under suitable conditions, and wherein the method does not include the use of a solubilized basement membrane preparation extracted from Engelbreth-Holm swarm mouse sarcoma. Furthermore, artificial skeletal muscle tissue obtainable by a method disclosed herein is disclosed, wherein the artificial skeletal muscle tissue generates a contraction force of at least 0.5 millinewtons (mN) upon stimulation from 1 Hz to 150 Hz, wherein the artificial skeletal muscle tissue is serum-free, and wherein the artificial skeletal muscle tissue does not include a transgene. Medical and non-medical uses of the artificial skeletal muscle tissue are also described.

title: STABILIZED LIQUID DEAMIDASE COMPOSITIONS
abstract: The invention provides high-strength liquid deamidase compositions having improved enzymatic stability after storage.

title: STABILIZED LIQUID DEAMIDASE COMPOSITIONS
abstract: The invention provides methods for stabilizing liquid enzyme compositions by incubating the liquid compositions at a temperature of at least 40°C for at least 24 hours, and subsequently removing precipitated solids.

title: MICROORGANISM PROTEIN ISOLATE
abstract: The present application relates to protein derived from microorganisms, and more specifically derived from yeasts, that possess low RNA content and high gelling capacity. This application also relates to an industrial process and industrial uses of such single cell proteins for human and animal nutrition, health and well-being.

title: IMPROVER COMPOSITION FOR A FREEZER-TO-OVEN BAKERY PRODUCT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for preparing a frozen laminated dough product, comprising the use of fungal alpha-amylase, bacterial alpha-amylase, xylanase, yeast and an oxidising agent, such as ascorbic acid. The invention further relates to a dough product comprising said enzymes, to a bakery product improver comprising said enzymes and to a baked product made from said dough product.

title: COMPOSITION OF SILICON AND CALCIUM FOR ENHANCING BONE STRENGTH AND TOUGHNESS AND IMPROVING OSTEOPOROSIS
abstract: Disclosed is a composition comprising silicon and calcium, and its use in enhancing calcium absorption, promoting collagen formation, repairing cartilage, increasing bone toughness, improving osteoporosis, bone mineral density and strength, and relieving leg pain and cramps. The composition can synergistically enhance the absorption, utilization, and conversion of calcium in the human body, improve calcium absorption and calcium absorption rate, promote collagen formation, increase bone toughness, and relieve leg pain and cramps.

title: FOAMING LIQUID CREAMERS FOR AEROSOL PACKAGING, AND METHODS OF MAKING AND USING SUCH FOAMING LIQUID CREAMERS AND AEROSOL PACKAGINGS
abstract: A foaming liquid creamer contains water, a lipid, a buffer salt, a stabilizer, and a dairy protein. Optionally the foaming liquid creamer further contains a sugar and/or a flavor. The buffer salt may include at least one of sodium bicarbonate or dipotassium phosphate. The stabilizer may include at least one of carrageenan, carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), microcrystalline cellulose (MCC), or guar gum. The dairy protein may include at least one of micellar casein or sodium caseinate. The emulsifier may include mono- and di-glycerides. The lipid may include an oil. The foaming liquid creamer may additionally include an emulsifier such as mono- and di- glycerides. Another aspect is an aerosol packaging which includes the foaming liquid creamer in a pressurized container, and the aerosol packaging has an actuator nozzle.

title: ACTUATOR NOZZLE FOR AEROSOL PACKAGING, AND METHODS OF MAKING AND USING SUCH ACTUATOR NOZZLES AND AEROSOL PACKAGINGS
abstract: An actuator nozzle has a lower portion comprising a base configured to connect to a container, and the base includes a lower orifice. The actuator nozzle also has an upper portion including a tapered section on one side of the upper portion, the tapered section tapers inward as the tapered section extends upward from the lower portion, the upper portion further having a substantially vertical section on an opposite side of the upper portion from the tapered section. The actuator nozzle also has an upper orifice in fluid communication with the lower orifice by an interior channel of the actuator nozzle, the upper orifice angled downward from a top of the tapered section of the upper portion to a top of the substantially vertical section of the upper portion.

title: Method for preparing food ingredient and formed meat analogue, increasing oil droplet size, and using starch as a stabilizer or emulsifier
abstract: A method for preparing a food ingredient, a method for increasing the oil droplet size of a fat substitute analog, a food ingredient, a formulated meat analog, a method for preparing a formulated meat analog, and a method for using starch as a stabilizer, a Pickering emulsion particle-type emulsifier, or a particle emulsifier. To improve the mouthfeel of a food ingredient, which is preferably a fat imitation, liquid oil droplets are provided that are encapsulated in a starch gel matrix formed with water or an aqueous liquid, such that the gel matrix substantially entraps the liquid oil droplets in a controlled release manner. The patent application contains parallel method and product patent claims.

title: Method for preparing food ingredient and formed meat analogue, increasing oil droplet size, and using starch as a stabilizer or emulsifier
abstract: Method of preparing a food ingredient, method of increasing oil droplet size in a fat mimicking analogue, food ingredient, formed meat analogue, method for manufacturing a formed meat analogue, and method of using starch as a stabilizer, Pickering emulsion particle-type emulsifier or particle-emulsifier. To improve mouthfeel of a food ingredient that is preferably a fat imitate, liquid oil droplets encapsulated within a gel matrix of starch formed with water or a water-based liquid is provided, such that the gel matrix substantially entraps the liquid oil droplets in a controllably releasable manner. The patent application contains parallel method and product claims.

title: NON-HEATED FERMENTED MEAT ANALOGUE PRODUCT PREPARED WITH VEGETABLE PROTEIN TRANSGLUTAMINASE AND PEDIOCOCCUS STRAINS
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for providing a fermented food using a transglutaminase and culture, and a fermented food product obtained by this method.

title: SYNTHETIC CARBOHYDRATE COMPOSITION
abstract: The present invention relates to a synthetic carbohydrate composition, methods and uses of the synthetic carbohydrate composition.

title: INTERFACE MODULE FOR AN ADSORPTION SYSTEM
abstract: The invention relates to an interface module. The invention further relates to an adsorption system for recovering a flavor phase from a fluid comprising flavor substances. Further aspects of the invention relate to a method for operating an interface module, to a method of operating an adsorption system, and to a low-alcohol beverage.

title: Wettman's coagulation for promoting skin health
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of spore probiotics for improving collagen bioavailability. The invention also relates to compositions comprising such spore probiotics and to the use of such compositions for improving skin health of a mammalian subject.

title: METHOD FOR SLICING FOOD PRODUCTS AND SLICING MACHINE
abstract: The disclosure relates to a method for slicing food products formed as product calibers using a slicing machine, comprising: arranging multiple product calibers on a feeding unit, wherein at least two of the product calibers have different lengths, feeding, by the feeding unit, the at least two product calibers along a feeding direction to a cutting unit, and slicing, by the cutting unit, the at least two product calibers into slices to form portions, wherein each portion comprises one or more slices. The method further comprises determining, based on length of at least two product calibers a first slice thickness for a first product caliber of the at least two product calibers and a second slice thickness for a second product caliber of the at least two product calibers, wherein the first product caliber before slicing has a greater length than the second product caliber, and wherein the first slice thickness is determined to be greater than the second slice thickness, so that after slicing an equal number of portions from the first product caliber and the second product caliber a length difference between the first product caliber and the second product caliber is less than before slicing. The disclosure further relates to a slicing machine.

title: METHOD FOR SLICING FOODSTUFFS AND SLICING MACHINE
abstract: The invention relates to a method for slicing foodstuffs in the form of product calibers (K1, K2) using a slicing machine (100), comprising: arranging at least two product calibers (K1, K2) on a feeding unit (102), wherein at least two of the at least two product calibers (K1, K2) have different lengths (L1, L2), feeding the at least two product calibers (K1, K2) by means of the feeding unit (102) along a feeding direction (10) to a cutting unit (110), and slicing the at least two product calibers (K1, K2) into slices (S1, S2) to form portions (P1, P2) by means of the cutting unit (110), wherein each portion (P1, P2) comprises one or more slices (S1, S2), the method further comprising: determining, based on the length (L1, L2) of the at least two product calibers (K1, K2) a first slice thickness (d1) for a first product caliber (K1) of the at least two product calibers (K1, K2) and a second slice thickness (d2) for a second product caliber (K2) of the at least two product calibers (K1, K2), wherein the first product caliber (K1) has a greater length (L1) than the second product caliber (K2) before slicing, and wherein the first slice thickness (d1) is determined to be greater than the second slice thickness (d2), so that after slicing an equal number of portions (P1, P2) from the first product caliber (K1) and the second product caliber (K2), the difference in length between the first product caliber (K1) and the second product caliber (K2) is less than before slicing. The invention further relates to a slicing machine (100).

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A NATURAL COLORANT FROM COFFEE SILVER SKIN
abstract: An extraction of brown colorants from coffee silver skin is carried out using ultrasound-assisted extraction and water as an environmentally friendly solvent. Extraction efficiency is achieved by optimizing the factors of duration, temperature, amplitude and solvent-to-solid ratio. The characteristics of the final product are determined by the application of optimum conditions during the extraction of brown colorants. The product of the present invention finds applications as a natural brown colorant in food and beverage formulations, as its properties are comparable to commercial caramel color E150d.

title: METHOD FOR PRODUCING A NATURAL COLORANT FROM COFFEE SILVER SKIN
abstract: The extraction of brown pigments from coffee seed coat is carried out by ultrasonic extraction with water as an environmentally friendly solvent. The efficiency of the extraction is achieved by optimizing the factors of duration, temperature, intensity of the ultrasonic pulses and the solvent to solid ratio. The characteristics of the final product are determined by the application of the optimal conditions during the extraction of brown pigments. The product of the present invention finds applications as a natural brown pigment in food and beverage formulations, as its properties are comparable to the commercial caramel color E150d.

title: A PUMPING DEVICE FOR PUMPING FISH
abstract: It is described a pumping device (10) for pumping of fish and/or other marine organisms in a volume of water, which pumping device (10) comprises a first rotor housing (27), a pump channel (12) comprising a pump channel section (18) having a top wall (22) and a bottom wall (23), and a first rotor unit (41) arranged in the first rotor housing (27) and is rotatably about a first rotational axis in relation to the pump channel (12) and the first rotor housing (27). The first rotor unit (41) is arranged adjacent the top wall (22) of the pump channel section (18), and the top wall (22) of the pump channel section (18) is planar. Further, the top wall (22) lies in a plane arranged perpendicular to the rotational axis of the first rotor unit (41), and the pump channel section (18) has a plurality of thorough water through flow openings (24) arranged in the top wall (22) of the pump channel section (18) such that water can flow between the pump channel section (18) and the first rotor housing (27).

title: Frozen extruded plant-based meat substitutes and method of producing frozen extruded plant-based meat substitutes
abstract: The invention relates to frozen extruded plant-based meat substitutes produced without soy, containing whole-grain flours, especially from the seeds of domestic high-protein legumes and/or oil plants as single flours and/or in mixtures in various proportions, allowing to obtain meat substitutes with a high protein content, fiber and high firmness. Frozen, plant-based, extruded soy-free meat substitutes obtained by extruding a composition of ingredients containing pea protein isolate or wheat protein isolate, high-protein legume flour and/or oilseed flour, as individual flours or in mixtures, with or without additives, are characterized in that they contain legume flour and/or oilseed flour in a total amount of not less than 30% of the amount of bulk components relative to the weight of bulk components, wherein the number of individual ingredients in the mixtures is arbitrary, and furthermore they contain pea protein isolate and/or wheat protein isolate in an amount from 10% to 70% of the weight of bulk components. Preferably, the legume flour contains lupin flour, chickpea flour, red lentil flour, bean flour, and the oilseed flour contains flaxseed flour and sunflower flour. Preferably, they contain beetroot powder and/or paprika powder and/or tomato powder and/or turmeric powder and/or inactive yeast powder and/or grape seed extract powder. The method for producing frozen, plant-based extruded meat substitutes according to the invention consists in extruding a mixture of ingredients containing pea protein isolate and/or wheat protein in an amount of 10% to 70% of the mass of bulk components, flour from high-protein legumes and/or oilseeds as individual flours or in mixtures in a total amount of not less than 30% of the amount of bulk components in relation to the mass of the raw materials of the final product, wherein the number of individual ingredients in the form of domestic flours in the mixtures is arbitrary, and the resulting products are frozen at a temperature of -30°C to -40°C. Preferably, lupin flour and/or chickpea flour and/or red lentil flour and/or bean flour is used as the legume seed flour, while flaxseed flour and/or sunflower flour is used as the oil seed flour. Preferably, the extrusion process is carried out with the addition of water greater than the share of dry ingredients. Preferably, native starches are added to the mixture during mixing in an amount of 0.1% to 5.0% of the bulk components relative to the total weight of the raw materials. Furthermore, beetroot powder and/or paprika powder and/or tomato powder and/or turmeric powder and/or powdered inactive yeast and/or powdered grape seed extract are preferably added as coloring additives or mixtures thereof.

title: Dried extruded plant meat substitutes and method of producing dried extruded plant meat substitutes
abstract: The aim of the invention is to provide dried, extruded, soy-free plant-based meat substitutes containing whole-grain flours from seeds, particularly domestic high-protein and/or legume plants, as single flours and/or in blends in any proportions, enabling meat substitutes with high protein and fiber content and high water absorption. The aim is also to develop a method for their production. The invention concerns dried, extruded, soy-free plant-based meat substitutes obtained by extruding a composition of ingredients containing pea protein isolate, flour from high-protein legumes and/or oilseeds as individual ingredients or in blends, and optionally the addition of natural colorants. These substitutes contain flour from high-protein legumes and/or oilseeds as individual ingredients or in blends in an amount of no less than 30% of the total weight of the raw materials. Preferably, dried, extruded plant-based meat substitutes contain lupin flour, chickpea flour, red lentil flour, and bean flour as legume seed flour, while the oilseed flour contains flaxseed flour, hemp flour, and sunflower flour, and as coloring ingredients, they contain beetroot powder and/or paprika powder and/or tomato powder and/or turmeric powder and/or powdered inactive yeast. Preferably, they contain rosemary extract as an oxidizing additive. The invention also relates to a method for producing dried extruded plant meat substitutes, which consists in mixing a protein isolate with legume seed flour and/or oil seed flour with the addition of water, wherein a single ingredient or a mixture of ingredients is present in an amount of not less than 30% of the amount of bulk components in relation to the total weight of the raw materials, is subjected to extrusion and then shaped in a forming die to a specific shape and cut to the desired size and dried, wherein the legume seed flour preferably comprises lupin flour, chickpea flour, red lentil flour, bean flour, and the oil seed flour comprises linseed flour, hemp flour, and sunflower flour. Preferably, beetroot powder and/or paprika powder and/or tomato powder and/or turmeric powder and/or inactive yeast powder are used as coloring ingredients, and rosemary extract is used as an oxidizing additive.

title: PLANT PROTEIN EXTRUDATE
abstract: The present invention relates to the field of food technology and describes a protein-rich plant protein extrudate, a process for its production and its use as a food product, in particular for the production of meat substitutes.

title: CULTURE MEDIA BASED ON PROTEIN HYDROLYSATE AND A PROCESS FOR PREPARING THEREOF
abstract: of the Disclosure The invention relates to culture media suitable for cell cultivation, and the processes for preparation thereof. The culture media may be prepared essentially by dissolving or mixing the individual media components in water or in a suitable aqueous buffer. The important step of media preparation is the step of sterilization. The culture media according to present invention may comprise protein hydrolysate as amino acids source. The advantageous process of protein hydrolysis into shorter peptide chains and/or single amino acids is also provided by the present invention.

title: Protein hydrolysate-based culture medium and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a culture medium suitable for cell culture and a method for preparing the same. The culture medium can be prepared essentially by dissolving or mixing individual medium components in water or a suitable aqueous buffer. A critical step in medium preparation is sterilization. The culture medium according to the present invention may include a protein hydrolysate as a source of amino acids. The present invention also provides an advantageous method for hydrolyzing proteins into shorter peptide chains and/or single amino acids.

title: MEAT SUBSTITUTE AND PRODUCTION METHODS
abstract: The invention relates to a meat substitute product (1), comprising: an imitation muscle component (2) having a number of imitation muscle fibre types (21.1, 21.2) which are designed to reproduce at least a first muscle region (2a) and a second muscle region (2b), wherein the imitation muscle fibre types (21.1, 21.2) have imitation muscle fibres (21) which are produced by a spinning method. The invention proposes an imitation connective tissue component (4) having imitation connective tissue fibres (41) which extend in portions between the first muscle region (2a) and the second muscle region (2b), wherein the imitation muscle fibres (21) have an imitation muscle fibre tensile strength (TM) and the imitation connective tissue fibres (41) have an imitation connective tissue fibre tensile strength (TB) which is greater than the imitation muscle fibre tensile strength (TM), such that, in the event of a rupture of the imitation muscle fibres (21), until imitation connective tissue fibre tensile strength (TB) is achieved, binding in the meat substitute product (1) is provided by the imitation connective tissue fibres (41).

title: Meat substitute product and manufacturing process
abstract: The invention relates to a meat substitute product (1) comprising: a muscle component (2) with a number of muscle imitation fiber types (21.1, 21.2) which are configured to replicate at least a first muscle region (2a) and a second muscle region (2b), wherein the muscle imitation fiber types (21.1, 21.2) comprise muscle imitation fibers (21) with different muscle imitation fiber diameters (dM) which are within a tolerance range of ± 15%, and the muscle imitation fibers (21) are produced by a spinning process, such that 68% of the muscle imitation fibers (21) of the meat substitute product (1) can be assigned to a maximum of 10, in particular a maximum of 3, different muscle imitation fiber types (21.1, 21.2). The invention proposes a connective tissue component (4) with connective tissue imitation fibers (41) which extend section by section between the first muscle region (2a) and the second muscle region (2b), wherein the muscle imitation fibers (21) have a muscle imitation fiber tensile strength (TM) and the connective tissue imitation fibers (41) have a connective tissue imitation fiber tensile strength (TB) which is greater than the muscle imitation fiber tensile strength (TM), such that in the event of failure of the muscle imitation fibers (21) until the connective tissue imitation fiber tensile strength (TB) is reached, cohesion in the meat substitute product (1) is provided by the connective tissue imitation fibers (41).

title: FERMENTED DIETARY PRODUCT, METHOD OF ITS PREPARATION AND APPLICATION
abstract: The invention relates to a fermented dietary product, a method for its preparation using plant raw materials and a set of specific, specific in their characteristics, strains of probiotic microorganisms, which has a pronounced health effect and is suitable for a vegetarian or vegan diet, as well as consistent with religious concepts of nutrition, for the purposes of healthy eating. The fermented dietary product includes the plant raw materials pea protein, coconut flour, coconut milk, pectin and carrageenan, as well as strains of Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus and Streptococcus thermophillus, isolated from sources on the territory of Bulgaria and selected from the group including: Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DXB, registered in CCM with No. 9196, Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DXA, registered in CCM with No. 9197, Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DSW, registered in CCM with No. 9198, Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DLP, registered in CCM with No. 9199, Strain Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus DDM1 registered in CCM with No. 9200 and Streptococcus thermophilus strain DWT4 registered in CCM with No. 7992.

title: INSECT OIL AS A SOURCE OF FAT IN MILK REPLACEMENTS FOR YOUNG RUMINANTS
abstract: INSECT OIL AS A FAT SOURCE IN MILK REPLACEMENTS FOR YOUNG RUMINANTS. The present invention relates to a sustainable fat source that can replace coconut oil, which has disadvantages from a sustainability perspective, as an additive in milk replacers for young ruminants. Milk replacers for young ruminants must provide not only high-quality proteins but also energy for maintenance and growth. A substantial portion of the energy in milk replacers comes primarily from fat. This fat typically comes from coconut oil, a significant portion (between 18% and 40%). Until now, reliance on coconut oil has been high, making the system vulnerable to disruptions. The sustainable solution according to the present invention involves the use of insect oil.

title: ALTERNATIVE FOR PALM OIL REPLACEMENT AS A SOURCE OF FAT IN MILK REPLACEMENTS FOR YOUNG RUMINANTS
abstract: ALTERNATIVE FOR PALM OIL REPLACEMENT AS A FAT SOURCE IN MILK REPLACEMENTS FOR YOUNG RUMINANTS. Milk replacers for young ruminants must provide not only high-quality proteins but also energy for maintenance and growth. The energy in milk replacers comes largely from fat. This fat is primarily derived from the oil palm. Palm oil is a readily available raw material with an attractive price. Furthermore, it has good digestibility and a suitable fatty acid profile similar to animal fat, with a relatively high proportion of C16:0 as a saturated long-chain fatty acid. The dependence on palm oil is high, making the system vulnerable to disruptions. The alternative product according to the present invention eliminates this vulnerability while also being highly digestible and having a suitable fatty acid profile.

title: DEPALLETIZING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SELECTIVE TRANSFER OF FROZEN GOODS
abstract: A depalletizing system for removing frozen blocks of goods stacked in layers on a pallet comprises a receiving surface, a detaching unit configured to detach a top layer of frozen blocks from an underlying layer, and a transport unit configured to push all or part of the detached top layer across the underlying layer and onto the receiving surface. The transport unit includes a first row of individual carrier arms, each being independently movable between a lifted and a lowered configuration. A control unit is configured to instruct each carrier arm to assume a specific configuration.

title: Particles to reduce brood damage during Varroa control in honey bees
abstract: The present invention relates to the use of a composition comprising a particle containing an active agent against Varroa mites for the treatment and/or prevention of Varroa mite infestation in honey bees, wherein the particle can be transported from the honey sac to the midgut by the valve funnel. title: FUNCTIONAL EXTRACTION OF PROTEIN
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for producing functional proteins, and in particular, functional soy protein concentrate (FSPC). This method bypasses the multi-step processes of conventional techniques by integrating the functionalization step directly into the alcohol extraction process. The process involves treating a protein source, such as soy white flakes or soy protein concentrate powder, with an alcohol solution comprising alcohol, an alkali hydroxide, and a reducing agent. This treatment process eliminates the need for separate hydration, pH adjustment, high-temperature short-time (HTST) treatment, and separate drying steps, notably removing spray drying in general. This disclosure also encompasses the functional soy protein produced by the disclosed method and its use in various food applications.

title: IMPROVED AROMATASE INHIBITOR DOSING SCHEDULES AND COMPOSITIONS
abstract: Provided are improved dosing schedules and compositions for the intramuscular administration of compositions containing aromatase inhibitors such as letrozole, for use in treating letrozole-sensitive diseases, conditions or disorders. In the dosing schedules, a first dose of long-acting injectable composition is administered and after a delay period, a second dose of long-acting injectable composition is administered, which provides overlapping dosing periods and improves oestrogen suppression.

title: GENETIC ELIMINATION OF AMMONIA FROM CULTURED MAMMALIAN CELLS
abstract: This disclosure provides methods and compositions for the production of engineered eukaryotic cells wherein the production of both glutaminase isozymes (Gls and Gls2) and asparaginase (Aspg) is reduced such that ammonia production is almost entirely eliminated before stationary phase and substantially decreases it over the course of culture, even when grown in glutamine-containing medium.

title: ANIMAL-FREE SUBSTITUTE DAIRY FOOD PRODUCTS AND METHODS
abstract: Methods of producing substitute dairy food product that are animal-free are provided. The methods include preparing an aqueous protein solution using a recombinant protein, selectively denaturing the recombinant protein under conditions that cause an increase in viscosity, and acidifying the mixture to thereby produce a substitute dairy food product. Such substitute dairy food products can be further optimized with nutrients, fats and minerals to produce animal-free dairy foods that substantially mimic animal-derived dairy foods.

title: Pulse seed-based non-dairy composition and associated methods
abstract: Methods of removing plant tone of starchy Fabaceae pulses are disclosed. The pulses are selected from chickpea (Cicer arietinum), yellow pea (Pisum sativum), common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) and fava bean (Vicia faba), and can be hulled or de-hulled pulses, whole pulses, split pulses or chopped solids having a Feret diameter of 1 to 4 mm. The pulses are transformed in an emulsifying and emulsion stabilizing manner suitable for fermentation. The emulsion thereof may be used in fermented milk derivatives that have a desirable texture or form that melts or self-disintegrates in-mouth. To achieve these technical effects, the pulses are pretreated with an aqueous bicarbonate (MHCO3) solution or bicarbonate/carbonate (M2CO3) solution of bicarbonate salt, bicarbonate salt and carbonate salt, or bicarbonate salt and hydroxide salt (MOH), wherein M is an alkali metal cation, and having a pH between pH 7 and 10, preferably between 7.5 and 10.

title: PROBIOTIC AND ANTIOXIDANT KEFIR DRINK
abstract: The kefir drink (40) comprises a fermented liquid obtained by using natural, unpasteurised red berry juice (26) as a fermentation substrate. Preferably, the kefir drink (40) is fermented by the addition of at least 40 grams of kefir granules (16) and at least 5 grams of sugar (31a) per litre of natural, unpasteurised red berry juice (26), undiluted or diluted up to 50% by volume, for 12 to 48 hours at a temperature between 18 and 28°C, wherein the kefir granules (16) have been removed from the fermented liquid obtained.

abstract:

(a) a paste is extruded through an extrusion plate (24) and an adjacent attachment plate (22) with aligned nozzle openings (42, 44) into a space (58) downstream of the second nozzle plate (22),(b) paste located in said space (58) or in the attachment plate (22) is hardened,(c) said paste is continued to be extruded through said extrusion plate (24) while the distance between the attachment plate (22) and the extrusion plate (22) is increased under formation of said elongated, e.g. microfibril structure between said plates (22,24).

title: Method for operating a bioreactor for growing meat and corresponding bioreactor
abstract: A method of operating a bioreactor for growing meat and a corresponding bioreactor. The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing an elongated structure, typically a fiber, preferably a microfiber structure. A method for producing an elongated, for example microfibre structure for growing meat, wherein (a) paste is extruded into a space (58) downstream of a second nozzle plate (22) by means of an extrusion plate (24) having aligned nozzle openings (42, 44) and an adjacent attachment plate (22), (b) the paste located in the space (58) or the attachment plate (22) is hardened, and (c) the paste is extruded continuously by means of the extrusion plate (24) while increasing the distance between the attachment plate (22) and the extrusion plate (22) in the case of the elongated, for example microfibre structure being formed between the plates (22, 24).

Device, method and use of a device for separating a starting material
abstract: Shown and claimed is a device for separating a starting material into components of different flowability by means of a perforated drum and a rotating functional belt. The functional belt is guided over a plurality of rollers, of which a tension roller keeps the functional belt taut and a pressure roller presses the functional belt against the perforated drum with an adjustable force. The device comprises a lever arrangement and a pressure pneumatic cylinder. By pivoting the lever arrangement using the pressure pneumatic cylinder, the position of the pressure roller can be changed and thus the force with which the functional belt presses against the perforated drum can be adjusted. Furthermore, a method for separating a starting material into components of different flowability and the use of a device for separating a starting material into components of different flowability are shown and claimed.

A process for reducing energy consumption in the storage of fruits and vegetables in cold rooms
abstract: A process for reducing energy consumption in the storage of fruits and vegetables in cold rooms, where the cold used for storage is supplied by a given source, for example by mechanical refrigeration, is characterized by the fact that, in replacement of all or part of said source, liquid nitrogen is injected into the cold room where the products are stored, in order to effect a very rapid decrease in the temperature of the stored products, a decrease which, depending on the products considered, is within a chosen range of rate of decrease, the injection of nitrogen also making it possible to replace the air present in the cold room around the products with the gaseous nitrogen resulting from the vaporization of the injected cryogen.

title: Process for reducing energy consumption in the storage of fruits and vegetables in cold rooms
abstract: A method for reducing energy consumption in the storage of fruit and vegetables in a cold room, where the cold used for storage is provided by a given source, for example using mechanical cold, characterized in that, in replacement of all or part of said source, liquid nitrogen is injected into the cold room where the products are stored, to bring about a very rapid drop in the temperature of the stored products, a drop being, depending on the products considered, within a chosen range of decrease speed, the injection of nitrogen also making it possible to replace the air present in the cold room around the products with gaseous nitrogen resulting from the vaporization of the injected cryogen.

title: Chicken egg substitute that does not contain any animal-derived ingredients
abstract: The subject of the invention is a chicken egg substitute that does not contain ingredients of animal origin (suitable for people on a vegan diet) for use in food products. The purpose of the invention is to present the composition and proportions of a dry composition of ingredients intended for mixing (mixing) with water, allowing for obtaining constant organoleptic properties and reproducing most of the physical and chemical properties of a chicken egg. The egg replacer containing no animal-derived ingredients is in the form of a dry powder consisting of hydrophilic polymers in the form of polysaccharides or polysaccharide-derived substances (from 6% to 10% by weight of the dry composition), vegetable protein (from 8% to 15% by weight of the dry composition), inactive yeast (4% by weight of the dry composition), guar gum (3.5% by weight of the dry composition), tapioca starch (from 70% to 78.5% by weight of the dry composition), and in another version of the invention carrageenan (from 3% to 5% by weight of the dry composition), vegetable protein (from 8% to 15% by weight of the dry composition), inactive yeast (4% by weight of the dry composition), guar gum (3.5% by weight of the dry composition), tapioca starch (from 72.5% to 80% by weight of the dry composition), and before use It is mixed with water in a ratio of 10% powder to 90% water.

DEVICE, METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETECTING THE BEHAVIOUR OF FISH IN ORDER TO IMPROVE THE FEEDING PROCESS THEREOF
abstract: The present invention proposes a device, method and system for detecting the behaviour of a group of fish in order to improve the feeding process thereof, based on passive acoustics of hydrodynamic noise produced by the school of fish and the use of artificial intelligence. Specifically, a method, device and smart system is proposed, which, by means of at least one acoustic sensor, collects the acoustic signal generated by the movement of the fish during feeding, processes the signal and implements models developed using artificial intelligence in order to determine the feeding status of the fish. By means of these models, the efficiency of the feeding process of the population being farmed is detected, enabling, among other advantages real-time decision-making in order to manage the feeding process and reduce the amount of wasted food, thereby optimising feed conversion rates.

title: SLICING MACHINE, SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: The disclosure relates to a slicing machine for slicing foods, comprising: a feed unit adapted to feed at least one product caliber in a feed direction, a cutting unit, and a control unit adapted to control at least the feed unit and the cutting unit. The control unit is adapted to be in signal connection with a processing apparatus separate from the slicing machine. The processing apparatus is adapted to process the product caliber before it is sliced by the slicing machine. The control unit is further adapted to receive at least one dimension and/or a weight and/or a density of the at least one product caliber or data representative thereof from the processing apparatus and to control the feed unit and/or the cutting unit based on the at least one dimension and/or the weight and/or the density. The disclosure relates further to a system and to a method.

title: Method for producing a cheese substitute product and cheese substitute product
abstract: The invention relates to a method for producing a cheese substitute, wherein a raw mass is heated and then cooled. An intermediate mass is then produced by adding a bacterial mass to the raw mass. The mass thus produced is fermented, resulting in the finished cheese substitute. The invention further relates to a cheese substitute produced by such a method.

title: Object freshness detection method and refrigerator
abstract: A freshness detection method of an object and a refrigeration appliance comprise the steps of collecting gas data in a cavity, inputting the gas data into a preset model group to obtain a candidate result group, wherein the preset model group comprises a plurality of preset models, the candidate result group comprises a plurality of candidate prediction results, the preset models are used for predicting the freshness of the object according to the input gas data, training sets for training different preset models are at least partially derived from different experimental batches, the training sets comprise gas data of the object with single dimension under a plurality of freshness, and a voting method is adopted to obtain the freshness detection result based on the candidate result group. According to the scheme, detection deviation caused by different object batches can be avoided, and the freshness of objects in the refrigeration appliance can be detected stably and reliably.

title: Modular unit for automatically preparing beverages in a vehicle and vehicle
abstract: The utility model relates to a modular unit (1) for automatically preparing a beverage in a vehicle, characterized in that the modular unit (1) is configured for installation in an upper space in a trunk (2) of the vehicle, the modular unit (1) comprising a beverage outlet in a rear seat (3). The modular unit (1) according to the utility model makes it possible to provide fresh beverages on hand to the vehicle occupants, does not have a great influence on the vehicle structure and facilitates the handling of the vehicle occupants. The utility model further relates to a vehicle comprising a modular unit according to the utility model.

title: Milk frothing device for a beverage vending machine, beverage vending machine and method for operating a milk frothing device
abstract: A milk frothing device (140) for a beverage dispenser comprises a storage chamber (400) and a preparation chamber (410), which is connected to the storage chamber (400) via a first transfer port. A first compressed air connection (430) is configured to supply compressed air to the storage chamber (400) in order to convey milk from the storage chamber (400) via the first transfer port into the preparation chamber (410). A steam connection (450) is configured to supply steam via a steam channel (480) to the preparation chamber (410) in order to convert the milk in the preparation chamber (410) into prepared milk. A second compressed air connection (435) is configured to supply a defined quantity of air to the preparation chamber (410) in order to discharge the prepared milk from the preparation chamber (410) via a second transfer port (495).

title: Kitchen appliance and interior divider for a kitchen appliance
abstract: The present invention relates to a kitchen appliance with an interior divider (7) that can be inserted into a pot (1) of the kitchen appliance. In order to simplify the further processing of food with such a kitchen appliance, it is proposed to divide an interior (4) of the pot (1) into an upper usable space (8) and a lower usable space (9) by means of an interior divider (7).

title: PROCESSING OF STARCH-PROTEIN PULSES
abstract: This disclosure relates generally to removing the plant tones of starch-protein Fabaceae pulses consisting of chickpea (Cicer arietinum), yellow pea (Pisum sativum), common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris), and/or fava bean (Vicia faba) as hulled or de-hulled pulses whole pulses, as split pulses or as chopped solids thereof with a Feret diameter (Dmax) of 1 to 4 mm while transforming these in an emulsifying and emulsion stabilizing manner suitable for fermentation or emulsion thereof in fermented milk derivatives with a desired texture or form, and fermenting such hulled or de-hulled pulses whole pulses or split pulses into melt-in-mouth or self-disintegrating-in-mouth snacks or breakfast cereal analogues. To achieve these technical effects the pulses were pre-treated with an aqueous bicarbonate solution or bicarbonate/carbonate solution made of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3), of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3) and carbonate salt (M2CO3), or of bicarbonate salt (MHCO3) and hydroxide salt (MOH), wherein M is an alkali metal cation, and with a pH between pH 7 and 10, preferably a pH between 7.5 and 10.

title: IMPROVED AROMATASE INHIBITOR DOSING REGIMENS
abstract: An improved method of administering aromatase inhibitor and an improved method of treating aromatase inhibitor responsive disease, condition, or disorder are provided. A first dose of long-acting injectable composition is administered, and after a delay period, a second dose of long-acting injectable composition is administered, thereby providing overlapping dosing periods and improved estradiol suppression.

title: Beverage makers and their use
abstract: A beverage maker is provided, comprising a frothing unit for frothing milk, a milk line connected to the frothing unit and featuring a mixing chamber, a control unit, a mixing line, and an input unit. The mixing line connects the milk line to a source of the beverage maker containing a liquid with a lower fat content and/or a lower carbon footprint than milk, and the mixing line includes a valve. The beverage maker's control unit is configured to control or regulate the mixing line's valve based on a signal received from the beverage maker's input unit. This allows a user of the beverage maker to select a beverage from a variety of different options based on its cost, lightness (in terms of fat content), and carbon footprint.

title: MANUFACTURING METHOD FOR GEL-LIKE VEGETABLE PROTEIN COMPOSITION, AND APPLICATION THEREOF
abstract: The present invention addresses the problem of providing a vegetable protein composition based on a protein derived from a vegetable raw material, with said vegetable protein composition being sufficiently gelled. The present invention relates to: a manufacturing method for a gel-like vegetable protein composition including causing a filamentous fungus–derived protease to act on a vegetable protein–containing raw material, and performing heat treatment after the action of the filamentous fungus–derived protease; and a gelling method for a vegetable protein–containing raw material.

title: COAGULUM AND LIQUID PERMEATE FROM FUNGAL PARTICLES AND METHODS OF MAKING SAME
abstract: A method of making a non-dairy coagulum, comprising coagulating a liquid dispersion of filamentous fungal particles to produce the coagulum and a liquid permeate, wherein the liquid dispersion comprises about 1 to about 15% (w/w) protein.

title: USE OF OLEUROPEIN AND HYDROXYTYROSOL TO PREVENT NEONATAL HYPOXIC-ISCHEMIC ENCEPHALOPATHY
abstract: The invention relates to the use of oleuropein (Ole) and the active metabolite thereof, hydroxytyrosol (Htyr) to prevent neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE). Pretreatment with Ole and/or Htyr provides dose-dependent neuroprotection in an in vivo model of neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy. Described are compositions comprising oleuropein and/or hydroxytyrosol for use in preventing this disease, both for direct administration to the foetus and/or newborn, and for administration via the mother during pregnancy and/or breastfeeding.

title: ARTIFICIAL DNA MOLECULES, CELLS, TRANSGENIC PLANTS, AND USE OF SAME FOR PREPARING MILK-LIKE MICELLES
abstract: The present invention provides a system of polynucleotides including: (a) a first polynucleotide including a nucleic acid sequence encoding a sorting signal sequence selected from an apoplast sorting signal sequence or a vacuole sorting signal sequence and a milk protein; (b) a second polynucleotide including a nucleic acid sequence encoding a sorting signal sequence selected from an apoplast sorting signal sequence or a vacuole sorting signal sequence and a first copy of a mammalian kinase; and (c) a third polynucleotide including a nucleic acid sequence encoding a Golgi sorting signal sequence and a second copy of said mammalian kinase, wherein the first polynucleotide, the second polynucleotide, and the third polynucleotide are operably linked. Further provided are cells and compositions including the system of polynucleotides, as well as methods of suing same, such as for producing a recombinant milk protein or a plurality thereof.

title: POWDER MIX FORMULATIONS WITH IMPROVED SENSORY PROFILE
abstract: The invention relates to a powder preparation for beverages comprising a leguminous protein extract, wherein the leguminous protein extract has a protein content, expressed on dry weight basis of the extract, of 75% or higher, a dry matter ranging from 90 to 100%, wherein the protein extract has a Turbiscan Stability Index TSI at the Middle Region TSIMR below 5.0 and a rheometer viscosity going from 0.40 to 0.75 Pa.s, the viscosity being determined at 20°C, with a shear rate of 40s-1, on an aqueous suspension having 15% weight of dry matter.
